summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Sungkyunkwan University, University of Arizona, and Duke University. Yiran Chen is known for work on efficient AI systems and hardware.

recommendation.zh: 只看动态 bit 日程和硬件映射部分即可；它验证了 diffusion 去噪步敏感性不均匀，但离 LLM 预训练较远。
recommendation.en: Read only the dynamic bit schedule and hardware mapping; it usefully shows uneven denoising-step sensitivity, but it is far from LLM pretraining.

paper.title: Conformalized Large Language Models under Configuration Shift
paper.abstract: Conformal prediction (CP) is a distribution-free framework for uncertainty quantification that has recently been adapted to large language models (LLMs), providing prediction sets with finite-sample coverage guarantees under exchangeability. Yet for LLMs, nonconformity scores are often induced by an inference pipeline, not just a fixed model, making them depend not only on the data distribution but also on configurable factors such as the prompt template, decoding parameters, and deployment sett

summary.core_problem: 该工作研究 conformal prediction 用在 LLM 系统时的一个常见失效源：校准集和测试集的数据分布可以不变，但 prompt 模板、解码温度、量化配置等推理配置发生变化后，同一个样本会被映射到不同的 nonconformity score 分布。CP 的覆盖率保证依赖 score 的 exchangeability，而不是只依赖原始样本的 exchangeability，因此这种 configuration shift 会直接破坏有限样本覆盖率保证。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对大模型部署评估、uncertainty quantification 和 verifier/judge 类系统有清晰启发。LLM 的“模型”在实践中常常是模型权重、prompt、decoding、部署精度的组合；如果只校准权重而忽略配置，统计保证会被高估。对基座研究员的价值在于提醒：后训练和推理 recipe 的小改动会改变 score 分布，评测和安全阈值不能默认跨配置复用。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上先把 configuration shift 明确定义为 score map 的变化：输入标签分布不变，但 s(x, y) 由于 prompt、temperature 或 quantization 改变而变化。实验部分系统扫描 3 类配置轴、9 个 LLM、4 个数据集和 4 种 nonconformity score，观察 CP 覆盖率和 prediction set size 的变化。理论部分给出覆盖率下界，把 calibration score 分布和 test score 分布之间的 discrepancy 显式放进保证项中；同时推导 label-free 版本，只依赖模型预测而不需要测试标签，便于部署前诊断。修正策略包括基于 discrepancy 的 threshold correction，以及对容易 undercoverage 的配置加权更高的 calibration ensembling。
summary.experiments: 关键现象是 validity 受损明显，而 efficiency 受损相对小。配置变化后，经验覆盖率会低于目标覆盖率；在一些设置中，增加 calibration 数据并不会修复问题，反而让偏差更稳定地暴露出来，因为有限样本噪声减少后，校准分布和测试分布的不匹配成为主导误差。作者检查的配置包括 prompt template、decoding temperature、weight quantization；覆盖 9 个 LLM、4 个数据集、4 种 nonconformity score。可操作结果是：下界中的 discrepancy 项可用于阈值修正，fragility profile 可用于设计偏向脆弱配置的 calibration ensemble。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 对 configuration shift 的定义，确认它和传统 covariate/domain shift 的区别。然后看实验设置表，重点关注 3 个配置轴、4 种 score 的构造方式，以及 coverage 与 set size 的分离结果。理论部分不必逐行推导，但应看覆盖率下界中 discrepancy 项如何进入保证；这决定了后面的 label-free diagnostic 和 threshold correction 是否合理。最后看 calibration ensembling 的消融，判断它是在修复真实失配，还是只是在保守化 prediction set。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies a failure mode of conformal prediction for LLM pipelines: the data distribution may stay fixed, while the inference configuration changes the nonconformity scores. Prompt templates, sampling temperature, and quantization can all alter the score assigned to the same labeled example. Since conformal coverage depends on exchangeability of the scores, not just exchangeability of the raw examples, these configuration changes can invalidate the nominal guarantee.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to LLM evaluation and deployment-time calibration. In practice, an LLM system is a combination of weights, prompts, decoding rules, and serving precision. A calibration threshold obtained under one configuration should not be assumed valid under another. The useful lesson for foundation-model research is that post-training and inference recipes can shift score distributions enough to break statistical guarantees used by uncertainty, verification, or safety layers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes configuration shift as a change in the score map s(x, y), while keeping the example distribution fixed. It then runs a systematic empirical sweep over prompt templates, decoding temperature, and weight quantization, across 9 LLMs, 4 datasets, and 4 nonconformity scores. On the theory side, it derives coverage lower bounds where the discrepancy between calibration-score and test-score distributions appears explicitly. It also gives label-free variants based only on model predictions, enabling diagnostics without test labels. The proposed mitigations follow from this analysis: threshold correction using the discrepancy term and calibration ensembling that upweights configurations prone to undercoverage.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical finding is that configuration shift primarily harms validity rather than efficiency. Empirical coverage can fall below the target level, while prediction-set sizes remain close to the i.i.d. baseline in runs that remain valid. More calibration data does not necessarily help; it can make the bias more apparent because sampling noise shrinks and the score-distribution mismatch dominates. The study covers three practical shift axes—prompting, temperature, and quantization—and shows that the derived diagnostics and corrections are actionable rather than only descriptive.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Start with the definition of configuration shift and how it differs from covariate or domain shift. Then inspect the experimental setup: the three configuration axes, the four nonconformity scores, and the separation between coverage and set size. The theoretical section is worth reading for the form of the discrepancy term in the coverage bound; the full proof can be skipped unless CP theory is the focus. End with the threshold-correction and calibration-ensemble results, especially the ablations showing when they recover coverage and when they simply make sets more conservative.

recommendation.zh: 配置漂移影响保形预测覆盖率的实证结论对部署校准有参考，但与预训练方法论关系弱；看摘要和主表即可，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Empirical finding that configuration shift erodes CP coverage is useful for deployment calibration but weakly connected to pretraining methodology. Read abstract and main tables only.

paper.title: Flat Score, Amplified Failures: How the Error Budget Masks Damage in Quantized LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization to 4-bit weights is widely reported to be nearly lossless. We test this claim for multi-turn, tool-calling agents, where it now matters most. On $τ^2$-bench, across two open-weight model families in dense and MoE variants and two domains (eight cells, 456 episodes each, at 16-, 8-, and 4-bit weights), quantization indeed looks free on the standard metric. No cell shows a score change that survives multiple-comparison correction, and in the cell that carries the largest

summary.core_problem: 现有4bit量化的“近无损”结论均基于单轮评测，需验证其在多轮工具调用Agent场景下的有效性，并明确量化损伤的发生机制与评测盲区。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有三点：一是Agent场景的量化评测需拆解到单步工具调用维度，不能仅依赖最终任务得分；二是预训练阶段降低工具幻觉等固有错误倾向，可直接减少后续量化损伤的风险；三是模型大小、稠密/MoE架构并非量化损伤的核心决定因素，为Agent适配型量化算法提供了明确的设计方向。
summary.technical_approach: 实验基于τ²-bench工具调用基准开展，覆盖2个开源模型族（稠密+MoE变体）×2个任务领域共8组实验单元，每组456个episode，分别测试16/8/4bit精度下的表现。除常规最终任务成功率外，还将轨迹拆解到单步工具调用的错误分布、错误类型维度，通过收紧错误预算、反事实分析、错误修复prompt验证等方法分离“环境容错掩盖损伤”与“模型本身退化”的效应，最后用logit margin（对数似然边际）解释损伤的发生条件。
summary.experiments: 1）最终聚合指标层面：所有单元的量化分差经多重比较校正后均不显著，最大分差2.0分仅为运行噪声的1.3倍，呈现完全无损的假象。2）单步错误拆解层面：量化不改变错误类型集合（全精度与4bit的幻觉工具名分布相关度0.97，仅0.18%的全新错误），但会放大错误频率：跨单元放大倍数1×至4.6×，Gemma-4稠密模型在电信领域的工具名幻觉从649次升至1646次（2.5×）。3）错误预算掩盖机制验证：将每episode允许的失败调用次数从10次收紧至2次后，INT4分差从1.3分扩大至16.7分，15.4分的显著分差仅出现在错误量被放大的单元（其余单元分差最高0.2分）；针对性错误修复prompt也仅在该受损单元提分。4）损伤预测因子验证：核心决定因素是全精度固有错误倾向，与模型大小、架构无关——全精度下几乎无工具幻觉的Qwen-3.6未出现放大效应，有固有幻觉倾向的Gemma-4被显著放大，符合“量化噪声仅翻转薄边际决策”的机制。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第3节的错误拆解实验和图1（最终分数与单步错误量的对比）、第4节的错误预算反事实分析，预计阅读时间20分钟；重点关注“最终聚合指标失效机制”和“量化损伤前置预测因子”两个核心结论，无需深究统计检验推导细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing 4-bit post-training quantization "near-lossless" claims are derived exclusively from single-turn evaluations, so this work verifies their validity in multi-turn tool-calling agent settings and identifies quantization damage mechanisms and evaluation blind spots.
summary_en.importance: Key implications for pretraining research: First, quantization evaluation for agent settings must decompose to per-tool-call granularity instead of relying solely on final task scores. Second, reducing inherent failure propensities (e.g., tool name hallucination) during pretraining directly reduces downstream quantization damage risk. Third, model size and dense/MoE architecture are not core determinants of quantization damage, providing a clear design direction for agent-tailored quantization algorithms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Experiments run on the τ²-bench tool-calling benchmark across a grid of 2 open-weight model families (dense + MoE variants) × 2 task domains, with 456 episodes per cell at 16-, 8-, and 4-bit precision. Beyond standard final task reward, trajectories are decomposed to per-tool-call error distributions and type sets. Counterfactual error budget tightening, targeted error-repair prompt ablations, and logit-margin analysis separate environment tolerance masking from actual model degradation, with logit margin theory explaining damage occurrence conditions.
summary_en.experiments: 1) Aggregate final scores show no statistically significant quantization gap after multiple-comparison correction; the largest 2.0-point gap is only 1.3× run-to-run noise, creating a false lossless appearance. 2) Per-step decomposition reveals quantization does not alter failure mode sets (0.97 correlation between BF16 and INT4 hallucinated tool names, only 0.18% novel errors) but amplifies frequency: 1× to 4.6× across cells, with Gemma-4 dense in telecom showing 2.5× more out-of-list calls (649 → 1,646). 3) Error budget masking is verified: tightening allowed failed calls from 10 to 2 per episode widens the INT4 gap from 1.3 to 16.7 points, with the full 15.4-point significant gap localized exclusively to the high-amplification cell (max 0.2 points elsewhere); a targeted repair prompt only improves scores in that cell. 4) Damage is gated by full-precision failure propensity, not size or architecture: Qwen-3.6 with rare BF16 hallucinations shows no amplification, while Gemma-4 with inherent hallucination tendency is significantly amplified, consistent with quantization noise only flipping thin-margin argmax decisions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim priority: Section 3 for per-step error decomposition results and Figure 1 (flat aggregate scores vs. rising per-step errors), Section 4 for counterfactual error budget analysis. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes. Focus on the two core conclusions (aggregate metric failure mechanism, pre-quantization damage predictor) and skip detailed statistical test derivations if unnecessary.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会修正“4-bit 对 Agent 免费”的先验；只看失败分解和等价性检验，别只看总分。
recommendation.en: This should weaken the prior that 4-bit is free for agents; read the failure decomposition and equivalence tests, not just the headline score.

paper.title: Bits and Memories: Measuring Verbatim Extraction Across LLM Quantization
paper.abstract: Language models are almost always quantized before they are deployed, and a growing line of work asks whether quantization also lowers their privacy risk. That work measures privacy almost entirely with membership inference. We think this is the wrong thing to measure for the risk that most people actually worry about, namely a model reproducing its training data word for word, and we measure that directly. Using the Pythia models and the public set of sequences each of them is known to have mem

summary.core_problem: 量化是否会减少 LLM 逐字复现训练数据的风险，而不只是降低成员推断攻击的成功率。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是隐私与记忆机制分析。它把隐私风险的测量对象从 membership inference 转向 verbatim extraction，更贴近预训练数据泄露的实际风险；同时检验量化对能力和记忆的相对影响。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 Pythia 系列模型和公开的已知记忆序列集合，在多个模型尺寸、五种精度设置和两种量化算法下，直接测量模型能否逐字抽取训练样本，并同步记录困惑度作为通用能力代理指标。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Pythia 的三个模型尺寸，精度从 full precision 到 4-bit，并在两个评测语料上复核。核心发现是：量化会选择性削弱逐字记忆，且记忆下降速度快于 perplexity 恶化；但这种下降不足以把量化视为可靠隐私防御。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLM quantization reduces the risk of verbatim training-data extraction, rather than merely lowering membership-inference signals.
summary_en.importance: This is a privacy and memorization analysis contribution. It shifts the measurement target from membership inference to direct extraction, which is closer to the leakage risk that matters for pretraining data governance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses Pythia models and a public set of sequences known to be memorized by those models, then measures verbatim extraction across five precision levels, three model sizes, two quantization methods, and two evaluation corpora while tracking perplexity.
summary_en.experiments: Across the tested Pythia sizes and quantization settings from full precision to 4-bit, memorization drops faster than general capability as measured by perplexity. The effect is robust across two quantizers and corpora, but not strong enough to make quantization a dependable privacy defense.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验表和量化曲线即可；它提醒预训练侧别用 membership inference 代替抽取风险评估。
recommendation.en: Skim the tables and quantization curves; the useful point is that membership inference is a weak proxy for extraction risk.

paper.title: MixQuant: Adaptive Mixed-Precision Quantization for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Mixed-precision quantization improves the accuracy of post-training quantization by allocating higher bitwidths to sensitive layers, but existing methods solve the allocation for a single fixed memory budget. In practice the budget varies across deployments and is unknown at calibration time. Adaptive quantization addresses this with one offline calibration that serves any budget, yet current methods score layer sensitivity in a manner that does not consider its dependency on quantization levels

summary.core_problem: 现有的混合精度量化方法通常针对单一且已知的内存预算进行离线校准。但在实际部署中，模型可能面临多种未知的内存限制。现有的自适应量化方法在计算层敏感度时，依赖于上游层保持在 FP16 精度，这与实际部署时所有层都被量化的上下文不符，导致位宽分配次优。
summary.importance: 提出了一种与底层量化技术无关的自适应后训练量化（PTQ）框架 MixQuant。它通过一次离线校准即可适应部署时的任意内存预算，解决了自适应量化中“部署上下文不匹配”的问题，提升了量化模型在不同内存限制下的精度。
summary.technical_approach: MixQuant 的核心创新在于计算层敏感度（失真分数）时，不依赖 FP16 的上游层，而是通过蒙特卡洛采样，在随机混合精度配置的上游层下测量当前层的输出失真，并进行边缘化处理。这样得到的失真分数与部署时的上下文无关。此外，MixQuant 在实际分配产生的激活上估计量化技术参数（如 AWQ 的缩放因子），并引入尾部正则化来保护低位宽层。最后，将位宽分配转化为多重背包问题，使用贪心算法在部署时快速求解。
summary.experiments: 在多个模型和数据集上评估，MixQuant 在不同内存预算下均优于现有的自适应和混合精度基线方法。实验表明，其贪心分配算法的下游精度与整数线性规划求解器相当，且计算成本极低，适合在部署时动态运行。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Introduction 中对“部署上下文不匹配”问题的分析（Figure 2），以及 Problem Setup 和方法部分关于边缘化失真分数和尾部正则化的具体实现。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing mixed-precision quantization methods optimize bit allocation for a single, known memory budget during offline calibration. However, in practice, models face various unknown memory constraints at deployment. Current adaptive methods compute layer sensitivity assuming upstream layers are in FP16, which mismatches the fully quantized context at deployment, leading to sub-optimal bit allocation.
summary_en.importance: Introduces MixQuant, a technique-agnostic adaptive post-training quantization (PTQ) framework. It enables a single offline calibration to serve any memory budget at deployment, solving the 'deployment-context mismatch' in adaptive quantization and improving model accuracy under varying memory constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core innovation of MixQuant is computing layer sensitivity (distortion scores) without relying on FP16 upstream layers. Instead, it measures the output distortion of a layer under random mixed-precision configurations of its upstream layers and marginalizes it via Monte Carlo sampling. This yields context-independent distortion scores. Furthermore, MixQuant estimates quantization technique parameters (e.g., AWQ scales) on activations induced by actual allocations and introduces tail regularization to protect low-bitwidth layers. Finally, bit allocation is formulated as a multiple-choice knapsack problem and solved efficiently at deployment using a greedy algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across multiple models and datasets, MixQuant consistently outperforms existing adaptive and mixed-precision baselines under various memory budgets. Experiments show its greedy allocation algorithm matches the downstream accuracy of an integer linear programming solver while being computationally cheap enough for dynamic deployment.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction for the analysis of the 'deployment-context mismatch' (Figure 2), and the Problem Setup and method sections for the implementation of marginalized distortion scores and tail regularization. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 量化里少见地把“层间耦合”讲清并做成预算无关校准；先看敏感度边缘化那段，能直接改你现有PTQ流程。
recommendation.en: One of the few PTQ papers that treats inter-layer coupling seriously; read the sensitivity marginalization idea—it can directly patch your PTQ pipeline.

paper.title: Bigger or Cheaper? Scale and Quantization Effects on Uncertainty Signals in Vision-Language Models Under Image Degradation
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) deployed on consumer hardware must decide when to answer and when to defer, and that decision depends on having a confidence signal that tracks correctness. A practitioner with a fixed memory budget faces a choice between a small model at full precision, the same small model quantized, and a larger model quantized into the same footprint -- three configurations that push the confidence signal in opposing directions. We measure, on identical inputs, how model scale a

summary.core_problem: 研究固定显存预算下，VLM 的模型规模与 4-bit 量化如何影响图像退化场景中的不确定性信号。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态模型校准与部署侧分析，不是新的预训练方法。对基座研究的价值在于提醒：模型内部 token probability 与自然语言自信表述不是同一种信号，量化和规模对二者影响可能不同。
summary.technical_approach: 在 Qwen2-VL 系列中比较三类配置：小模型全精度、小模型 4-bit 量化、同显存预算下更大模型量化。作者测量两个信心信号：模型用自然语言声明的 confidence，以及生成答案 token 的平均概率，并在相同输入上比较其错误检测能力。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5700 次预测、6 类真实摄影退化、3 个严重程度。摘要报告从 2B 到 7B，内部不确定性信号的平均错误检测 AUROC 从 0.80 提升到 0.98；但 verbalized confidence 较弱，平均约 0.61 到 0.69，很多情况下接近随机。
summary.authors_note: 作者为独立研究者；论文围绕 Qwen2-VL 系列做部署与校准分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how model scale and 4-bit quantization affect uncertainty signals in VLMs under realistic image degradation when memory budget is fixed.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an empirical calibration and deployment analysis rather than a pretraining method. Its useful signal for foundation-model researchers is that token-probability confidence and verbalized confidence behave very differently under scale and quantization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study compares three deployment choices within the Qwen2-VL family: a small full-precision model, the same model quantized to 4-bit, and a larger model quantized into the same memory footprint. It evaluates two confidence signals on identical inputs: natural-language confidence statements and mean token probability over generated answers.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses 5,700 predictions across six realistic photographic degradations and three severity levels. The abstract reports that scaling from 2B to 7B improves mean error-detection AUROC for the internal uncertainty signal from 0.80 to 0.98, while verbalized confidence remains weak, around 0.61 to 0.69 on average.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is listed as an independent researcher; the study is centered on Qwen2-VL deployment and calibration behavior.

recommendation.zh: 只看结果表即可：它支持“读 token 概率比听模型自报 confidence 更可靠”，但 setup 偏部署分析。
recommendation.en: Skim the result tables only: it reinforces that token probabilities beat self-reported confidence, but the setup is mainly deployment-side.

paper.title: GaugeQuant: Online Learning of Quantization-Optimal Bases from LLM Symmetries
paper.abstract: Transformers are known to have internal continuous symmetries that leave outputs invariant, while modifying quantization. GaugeQuant leverages this in-training by introducing a LogSumExp term to the loss that breaks the symmetries, thus selecting a basis that minimizes activation outliers. A stop-gradient operator ensures that only rotation matrices are updated, yielding the language modeling objective completely unaltered. Our requires no specific calibration data, no quantization simulation, a

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是低比特量化中的一个具体但重要的问题：Transformer 在全精度下有一批不改变输出的连续对称自由度，但这些自由度会显著影响量化后的误差。常规 PTQ 在模型训练完成后，用校准集寻找较好的旋转或缩放来缓解 activation outlier；GaugeQuant 的目标是在训练过程中直接学习一个更适合量化的内部基，而不是等模型冻结后再补救。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响主要在两个层面。第一，它把量化友好的表示学习前移到训练阶段，但不改变语言建模目标本身，因此更像是一种训练时的坐标系选择，而不是 QAT 那种把量化噪声显式放进主训练目标。第二，它利用 Transformer 的精确对称性来做优化，说明一部分部署性能可以通过训练动态中的“无损自由度”来提前处理。这对大模型预训练后期、cooldown、continued pretrain、量化感知训练 recipe 都有参考价值。贡献量级不是新的基座训练范式，但对 4-bit 权重和激活量化很实用，尤其适合关注 pretrain-serving 接口的人。
summary.technical_approach: 核心做法是学习正交旋转矩阵，把激活分布中的大 outlier 分散到更多维度上。论文先分析 Transformer 中可用的 gauge symmetry：attention 的 value 子空间可以做 SO(d_k) 旋转，并通过相应调整 W_V 和 W_O 保持输出不变；GQA 下每个 KV head 共享一个旋转。query/key 方向受 RoPE 约束，允许的旋转必须与 RoPE 矩阵对易，只剩 U(1)^{d_k/2} 这样较小的自由度，作者认为不值得使用。MLP 的 down projection 也有类似不变性，但由于 SwiGLU 的 SiLU 和 Hadamard product 不与一般旋转交换，旋转不能完全吸收到上游权重中，H·R 需要作为运行时操作保留，R^T 可以融合到 W_down。训练目标是在常规 cross-entropy 之外，加一个 LogSumExp 形式的 outlier 惩罚。LogSumExp 是 L_infinity 的平滑近似，比直接惩罚最大值更稳定，因为梯度会分配到所有维度，而不是只打到当前最大 outlier。关键细节是 stop-gradient：辅助项只更新旋转矩阵，不反向更新主模型权重。因此语言建模目标没有被这个正则项重新定义，主参数仍然只按 CE 学习。与 SpinQuant 这类 post-training rotation 方法相比，GaugeQuant 不需要冻结模型、不需要校准数据、不需要在训练中模拟不可微的量化算子；它用可微的 outlier proxy 替代显式 quantization error。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen-2.5 0.5B 和 LLaMA-2 7B，并用 WikiText-2 困惑度评估量化后的语言建模质量。摘要中给出的关键数字是：在 LLaMA-2 7B、W4A4、group size 128 设置下，perplexity 从 8.22 降到 6.73，接近需要冻结模型和校准集的 post-training 方法；在 W4A16 设置下，perplexity 从 11.16 降到 5.45。这个结果说明它主要改善的是 activation outlier 导致的动态范围浪费，特别是在 activation 也被压到 4 bit 时收益更直接。实验设计的重点不是提高全精度模型，而是保持全精度训练目标不变，在量化后得到更好的坐标基。需要注意的是，论文展示的评估主要集中在 WikiText-2 perplexity 和有限模型规模，是否能稳定推广到更大模型、更复杂数据混合、更长上下文和实际 serving kernel，还需要更多验证。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读三个部分。第一是 symmetry 分析部分，尤其是 value rotation、RoPE 对 query/key rotation 的限制、SwiGLU MLP 中为什么旋转不能完全融合。这部分决定了方法能放在哪些边界上，也决定了推理时是否有额外矩阵乘。第二是 in-training gauge optimization，重点看 LogSumExp surrogate、stop-gradient 设计、旋转矩阵的参数化和约束维护方式。这里的核心问题是：辅助 loss 如何只选择基，而不改变模型函数。第三是实验表格和消融，重点看不同 bit-width、group size、是否使用不同边界旋转、不同 penalty 强度对 perplexity 的影响。值得深挖的是它能否作为 pretrain late-stage 的一个轻量目标：例如只在 annealing/cooldown 阶段打开，或者和 SmoothQuant/AWQ/GPTQ 一类 PTQ 方法组合。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode of low-bit LLM quantization: transformers have continuous internal symmetries that leave full-precision outputs unchanged, but element-wise quantization is not invariant to those basis choices. GaugeQuant asks whether the model can learn a quantization-friendly basis during training, rather than relying on a frozen model and a calibration set after training.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining is the shift from post-hoc quantization repair to training-time basis selection. The language-modeling objective is kept intact; the auxiliary objective only uses symmetry directions that do not change the exact full-precision function. This makes the method closer to gauge fixing than to standard quantization-aware training. It is useful for the pretrain-to-serving interface: some deployment robustness can be prepared during training by exploiting null directions in parameter space. The contribution is not a new foundation-model training paradigm, but it is a clean and practical mechanism for making 4-bit weight and activation quantization less fragile.
summary_en.technical_approach: GaugeQuant learns orthogonal rotations at transformer boundaries so that activation mass is spread more evenly across dimensions. The paper identifies usable symmetries in attention and MLP blocks. Value vectors in attention admit an SO(d_k) rotation, with corresponding transformations of W_V and W_O preserving the exact output; under GQA, each KV head group shares its rotation. Query/key rotations are constrained by RoPE: they must commute with the RoPE matrix, reducing the available symmetry to U(1)^{d_k/2}, which the paper does not exploit. In the SwiGLU MLP, the down-projection boundary also admits an invariance, but the rotation cannot be fully absorbed upstream because SiLU and the element-wise product do not commute with a general dense rotation. As a result, H·R remains a runtime operation while R^T can be fused into W_down. Instead of simulating quantization, the method adds a LogSumExp penalty on rotated boundary activations. LogSumExp acts as a smooth dense proxy for the infinity norm, which matters because the uniform quantization step size is driven by the largest outlier. A stop-gradient operator ensures that this auxiliary term updates only the rotation matrices, while the base model parameters are still trained only by cross-entropy. Compared with SpinQuant-style post-training rotation search, GaugeQuant does not require calibration data, a frozen model, or a non-differentiable quantization operator in the optimization loop.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are reported on Qwen-2.5 0.5B and LLaMA-2 7B, with WikiText-2 perplexity as the main metric after quantization. The headline LLaMA-2 7B results are: under W4A4 quantization with group size 128, perplexity improves from 8.22 to 6.73; under W4A16, perplexity improves from 11.16 to 5.45. These numbers support the central claim that learning a better basis reduces the effect of activation outliers and improves low-bit quantized performance without changing the full-precision language-modeling objective. The current evidence is strongest for perplexity-based quantization evaluation on a limited set of model sizes. More evidence would be needed for larger pretraining runs, long-context settings, broader downstream evaluations, and real serving kernels where the cost of any unfused runtime rotation matters.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the symmetry section carefully first. The most useful details are the value-rotation invariance, the RoPE restriction on query/key rotations, and the SwiGLU argument explaining why some rotations can be fused while others remain as runtime operations. Then read the in-training gauge optimization section, focusing on the LogSumExp surrogate, the stop-gradient design, and how orthogonality is maintained for the rotation matrices. Finally, inspect the quantization tables and ablations across bit-widths, group sizes, rotation locations, and penalty strengths. The most interesting follow-up question is whether this objective should be enabled only during late pretraining or cooldown, and whether it composes cleanly with SmoothQuant, AWQ, GPTQ, or SpinQuant-style post-training procedures.

recommendation.zh: 做低比特训练或量化感知预训练的团队应立刻复现正则项+stop-gradient的组合，它把“量化友好基”从后处理问题变成了训练内原生问题。
recommendation.en: Teams doing low-bit training or quantization-aware pretraining should immediately reproduce the regularizer + stop-gradient combination; it turns "quantization-friendly basis" from a post-hoc problem into a native in-training concern.

paper.title: Break Through the Compression Bottleneck: From Theory to Practice
paper.abstract: As the parameter size of language models continues to grow, effective model compression is required to reduce their computational and memory overhead. Existing compression methods suffer from bottleneck issues: when the compression ratio is increased, performance degrades significantly. Low-rank decomposition and quantization are two prominent compression methods that have been proven to significantly reduce the computational and memory requirements of Large Language Models (LLMs) while maintain

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是一个很具体但常被处理得过于粗糙的问题：低秩分解和量化能否无代价叠加，用来继续压缩已经接近瓶颈的 LLM。作者给出的结论是否定的。全文的核心不是再提一个压缩技巧，而是先证明两者并不正交，组合后会产生额外复合误差；再进一步说明压缩顺序会显著影响误差传播；最后针对组合压缩后激活离群值被放大的问题，提出一个低成本补偿方法 DAM。换句话说，它解决的是“为什么现有组合压缩在高压缩率下掉点很快，以及怎样把这个掉点收回来”这个问题。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练本身，而在部署侧和训练后模型形态控制。很多团队默认低秩和量化是两种近似独立的压缩轴，因此会把 rank 降低和 bit 降低当成可简单相乘的收益来源。作者用理论和实验都指出，这个假设在权重-激活乘法层面并不成立，尤其当激活存在明显离群值时，误差会耦合放大。这一点对做高压缩 serving、边缘部署、蒸馏后再压缩、以及训练阶段考虑可压缩性的研究都有启发。贡献量级属于中等：不是新的基础建模范式，但对“组合压缩 recipe 应该怎么排顺序、怎么补误差”给出了较完整的解释框架。
summary.technical_approach: 技术路线分三层。第一层是非正交性分析。作者从张量近似和点积误差两个视角写出量化误差与低秩近似误差的组合形式，指出组合后的误差项不是简单相加，而会出现交叉项；因此“先做 A 再做 B”和“分别做 A、B 后叠加理解”不是一回事。第二层是顺序分析。论文推导认为应先做低秩分解，再对分解后的矩阵做量化。原因是若先量化，量化噪声会进入后续低秩拟合过程，低秩分解会被迫去拟合已经失真的矩阵，导致主子空间估计偏移；而先低秩再量化，相当于先提取主要能量方向，再对更小、更规整的矩阵做离散化，误差更可控。第三层是 DAM。全文强调组合压缩后性能下降的关键诱因之一是 activation outlier。低秩分解会改变层内表示分布，使少量大幅值通道更容易主导 block quantization 的 scale，进而压缩掉大多数正常值的有效分辨率。DAM 的思路是引入一个对角形式的“粘合”补偿，把一部分难以被低秩项和低比特量化共同表达的尺度信息单独保留下来。对角结构的好处是参数和计算开销都很低，不破坏原有矩阵乘法主干，也容易插入现有 low-rank + quant pipeline。就方法性质看，它更像一种误差重分配与尺度校正，而不是重新设计量化器。
summary.experiments: 从给出的全文内容看，实验重点不是追求某个单点最优，而是验证三个判断：一，低秩与量化组合确实比“独立误差假设”更差；二，先低秩后量化优于反过来；三，DAM 能在高压缩区间把损失拉回一截。文中把现有经验瓶颈概括为量化在 W4A4KV4 以上还能维持较好性能，再往下掉点明显；低秩分解在压缩率超过 50% 后性能显著恶化。作者的实验就是围绕突破这两个瓶颈展开。虽然你提供的正文片段没有完整表格数字，但可以确认论文做了大量顺序对比、误差分析和 DAM 消融，并强调 DAM 在保持低成本和高速度的前提下显著改善组合压缩性能。阅读时应特别留意：是否覆盖不同模型规模、不同 block size、不同 rank、是否同时量化权重/激活/KV cache，以及 DAM 对 activation outlier 分布的具体改善证据。如果这些实验做得完整，这篇文章的说服力主要来自“误差机制 + 顺序实验 + outlier 诊断”三者闭环，而不只是最终精度数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议按“理论结论是否真的支撑工程 recipe”这个问题来读。先看 Introduction，明确作者要推翻的假设是什么。然后重点看 Non-orthogonality 部分，尤其是误差上界推导和交叉误差项出现的位置；这里决定了论文是否只是经验观察，还是确实说明了两种压缩操作不可交换。接着看顺序分析，确认作者为什么得到 low-rank first 的结论，以及这个结论依赖哪些假设。最后看 DAM 章节和对应消融：一要看它补偿的是权重尺度、通道尺度还是激活统计；二要看它是否只在某一类模型或某一组 bit/rank 设置下有效。泛读大约 25–35 分钟；如果你在做量化、LoRA/低秩、或可压缩训练，值得把公式和实验图一起精读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical question that is often hand-waved in LLM compression: can low-rank decomposition and quantization be stacked as if they were independent compression axes? The answer given by the full paper is no. Its central contribution is not merely another compression trick, but a structured argument that the two operations are non-orthogonal, their composition introduces extra compound error, the application order matters, and activation outliers become a major failure mode in the combined regime. DAM is then proposed as a lightweight correction mechanism for that failure mode.
summary_en.importance: This is more relevant to deployment and model-form control than to pretraining itself, but it matters for foundation-model research because many teams implicitly assume that rank reduction and bit reduction can be traded almost independently. The paper argues that this assumption breaks once weight approximation and activation quantization interact inside matrix multiplications. That has implications for aggressive serving compression, post-distillation compression, and even training-time design if one cares about downstream compressibility. The contribution is moderate in scope: it does not introduce a new modeling paradigm, but it gives a clearer recipe-level understanding of how combined compression should be ordered and corrected.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three layers. First, the paper analyzes non-orthogonality from both tensor approximation and dot-product error perspectives. The key point is that the error of low-rank approximation composed with quantization is not just the sum of two independent errors; cross terms appear, so the composition cannot be treated as harmless stacking. Second, it studies ordering and derives that low-rank decomposition should be applied before quantization. The intuition is sensible: if quantization is applied first, the subsequent low-rank fit is performed on an already distorted matrix, so the principal subspace estimate itself is biased by quantization noise. If low-rank decomposition comes first, the dominant structure is extracted before discretization, and the later quantization acts on a more compact and regularized representation. Third, the paper introduces DAM, a Diagonal Adhesive Method, motivated by activation outliers. After low-rank decomposition, representation statistics can shift so that a few large-magnitude channels dominate block-wise quantization scales, reducing effective resolution for the majority of values. DAM keeps a diagonal-form corrective component to preserve scale information that is poorly captured by the joint low-rank-plus-low-bit approximation. The diagonal structure is important: it adds little compute and memory overhead and can be inserted into existing pipelines without redesigning the main matrix multiplication path.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided full-text content, the experiments are organized around validating three claims rather than chasing a single best number: combined low-rank plus quantization is worse than an independence assumption would predict; low-rank-then-quantize is better than the reverse order; and DAM recovers a meaningful portion of the loss in the high-compression regime. The paper frames current empirical bottlenecks as roughly W4A4KV4 for quantization and around 50% compression ratio for low-rank decomposition, beyond which quality drops sharply. The reported experiments are designed to push beyond those bottlenecks. The excerpt does not include the full result tables, so exact benchmark deltas cannot be quoted reliably here, but the paper repeatedly claims that DAM improves compressed-model performance while preserving low cost and high speed. When reading, check whether the study spans multiple model sizes, block sizes, rank settings, and whether it quantizes only weights or also activations and KV cache. The strongest part of the paper is likely the closed loop between theory, order ablation, and outlier diagnosis, not just the final accuracy numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it with one question in mind: does the theory genuinely justify an engineering recipe? Start with the introduction to identify the assumption being challenged. Then focus on the non-orthogonality section, especially where the cross-error terms arise and how the error bound is derived. That determines whether the paper is making a real compositional argument or just reporting an empirical interaction. Next, inspect the ordering analysis and note what assumptions are needed for the low-rank-first conclusion. Finally, read the DAM section together with its ablations: what exactly is being corrected, weight scale, channel scale, or activation statistics, and how robust is the gain across bit-width and rank settings? A quick pass should take 25–35 minutes; a careful read is worthwhile if you work on quantization, low-rank adaptation, or compression-aware training.

recommendation.zh: 压缩论文里少见地先把“误差独立”这个偷懒假设拆了；读理论部分和交互实验，别只看最终压缩率。
recommendation.en: Unusually useful for a compression paper because it attacks the lazy independence assumption; read the theory and interaction ablations, not just the final compression ratio.

paper.title: Codec-Gauge: Learning Compression-Friendly Gauges for Transformer KV Caches
paper.abstract: Long-context Transformer inference increasingly relies on KV-cache compression or quantization. Prior rotation and transform-coding results suggest that the channel basis of each key/value vector affects how faithfully a fixed backend preserves model behavior. We introduce Codec-Gauge, a post-training cache-coordinate layer that learns small orthogonal channel transforms around existing compression and quantization backends. Its frequency-distribution objective combines a token-channel DCT spect

summary.core_problem: 长上下文LLM推理中KV缓存的压缩/量化保真度受KV通道基的几何结构约束，现有方案要么修改模型权重、注意力逻辑，要么改动压缩后端实现，始终未将KV表示的坐标基作为独立优化变量挖掘。
summary.importance: 该工作将KV缓存的坐标几何明确为后训练阶段可独立调优的维度，不需要改动预训练权重、注意力语义或现有压缩/量化后端的代码实现，即可在相同比特预算下提升压缩保真度，对长上下文推理部署有直接工程参考价值，也为KV压缩方向提供了新的设计轴。
summary.technical_approach: 在冻结模型和固定压缩后端之间插入可学习的正交通道变换层（gauge），变换仅在每个KV头的通道组内做基混合，不跨token、头、层操作，无误差路径下完全可逆。训练该变换不需要重建损失、语言建模损失或下游任务监督，仅使用两个面向压缩后端的频率分布目标：一是DCT谱质心损失将KV能量集中到低频系数，二是平滑率代理损失减少显著变换系数的数量，适配zfp这类块变换压缩的特性。推理时KV张量先经过gauge变换再压缩，解压后逆变换回原基再送入注意力计算。
summary.experiments: 在6个不同规模的语言模型上，3/4/6比特设置下，对比恒等变换、随机正交变换、Hadamard/DCT固定变换、PCA/KLT数据驱动变换，学习到的gauge让zfp压缩的KL散度降低44.0%，logit MSE降低43.3%，top1 logit翻转率降低24.5%，KV归一化均方根误差降低18.3%。相同变换对块均匀量化、KIVI风格量化也有一致提升，27B参数模型验证、长上下文序列化存储测试均复现了效果，变换本身的计算开销已计入时延测量。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言中对坐标几何作为独立优化变量的动机阐述、方法部分的损失设计，以及实验中区分通用正交旋转收益和面向压缩的定向学习收益的对照设置，预计阅读时间20分钟。不需要深入推导细节，核心收获是「表示几何适配后端特性」的设计思路。

summary_en.core_problem: The fidelity of KV cache compression/quantization for long-context LLM inference is constrained by the channel basis geometry of key/value vectors, while existing approaches require modifications to model weights, attention semantics, or compression backend implementations, leaving coordinate basis as an unexploited independent optimization variable.
summary_en.importance: This work formalizes KV cache coordinate geometry as a tunable post-training dimension that requires no changes to pretrained weights, attention logic, or existing compression/quantization backends, delivering higher compression fidelity under identical bit budgets. It provides practical engineering references for long-context inference deployment, and opens a new design axis for future KV compression research.
summary_en.technical_approach: A learnable orthogonal channel transform (gauge) is inserted between the frozen model and fixed compression backend. The transform only mixes channels within each KV head group, with no cross-token, cross-head, or cross-layer operations, and is exactly invertible under error-free paths. The gauge is trained without reconstruction loss, language modeling loss, or downstream task supervision, using two codec-facing frequency distribution objectives: a DCT spectral centroid loss that concentrates KV energy into low-frequency coefficients, and a smooth rate proxy that reduces the count of significant transform coefficients, aligned with the block-transform structure of codecs like zfp. At inference, KV tensors are mapped to the learned gauge before compression, and mapped back to the original basis after decompression prior to attention computation.
summary_en.experiments: Across 6 language models at 3, 4, and 6 bits per value, learned gauges outperform identity, random orthogonal, fixed Hadamard/DCT, and data-derived PCA/KLT baselines, reducing zfp KL divergence by 44.0%, logit MSE by 43.3%, top-1 logit flip rate by 24.5%, and KV NRMSE by 18.3%. The same learned coordinates also improve block-uniform quantization and KIVI-style quantization relative to raw-coordinate baselines. The effect is reproduced on a 27B parameter model, and serial context-length measurements confirm realized storage savings with transform overhead included in latency calculations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim this work. Focus on the motivation for coordinate geometry as an independent optimization variable in the introduction, the loss design in the method section, and the controlled ablation setup that separates generic orthogonal rotation benefits from codec-oriented targeted learning. Expected reading time: 20 minutes. No need to dive into detailed derivations; the core takeaway is the design principle of aligning representation geometry to backend characteristics.

recommendation.zh: KV压缩方向的扎实增量改进，只看§3方法和Table1的对比结果即可，无需细读全文。
recommendation.en: Solid incremental improvement on KV cache compression; only check §3 method and Table 1 comparison results, no need to read full text.

To preserve accuracy under aggressive compression, we employ a progressive quantization

summary.core_problem: 现有ASR模型在边缘CPU上实时推理难度大，激进压缩后精度损失严重的问题
summary.importance: 工程突破类贡献，针对边缘CPU场景设计ASR分阶段异质量化方案，实现了实时推理与精度的平衡
summary.technical_approach: 采用分阶段异质量化策略：VAE声学tokenizer用全流程INT8量化+内核融合与SIMD优化，AR语言模型采用BitNet风格三元权重量化；配合渐进式量化感知训练保留精度；基于ggml框架实现ARM/x86定制SIMD内核与融合算子
summary.experiments: 模型大小约1.6GB，3个CPU线程下RTF<1（达到实时）；与同规模Whisper.cpp相比速度提升1.6-2.3x，仅比FP16基线有轻微精度下降
summary.authors_note: 机构为微软亚洲研究院（MSRA），核心作者Furu Wei、Li Dong团队曾推出VALL-E系列语音大模型工作

summary_en.core_problem: Real-time inference of ASR models on edge CPUs is challenging, and aggressive compression often leads to severe accuracy degradation
summary_en.importance: Engineering breakthrough contribution: proposes a stage-specific heterogeneous quantization scheme for ASR models on edge CPUs, achieving a balance between real-time inference and accuracy
summary_en.technical_approach: Adopts heterogeneous quantization per module: VAE acoustic tokenizer uses full-pipeline INT8 quantization with kernel fusion and SIMD optimization, AR language model uses BitNet-style ternary weight quantization; combines progressive quantization-aware training to preserve accuracy; implements custom SIMD kernels and fused operators for ARM/x86 on ggml framework
summary_en.experiments: Model size ~1.6GB, achieves RTF < 1 (real-time) with 3 CPU threads; 1.6-2.3x faster than comparable-size Whisper.cpp, with only minor accuracy degradation compared to FP16 baseline
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliated with Microsoft Research Asia (MSRA). Core authors Li Dong and Furu Wei’s team previously developed the VALL-E series of speech large models

recommendation.zh: 异质量化+渐进QAT的工程实现细节可参考，仅看§3量化策略和§4性能对比即可，无范式创新
recommendation.en: Refer to §3 quantization strategy and §4 performance comparison for engineering details; no paradigm-level innovations

paper.title: C-PTQ: Fisher-weighted Channel-wise Sensitivity for Post-training Quantization of MLLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) require huge memory and computational costs, which limits their practical deployment. Post-training quantization (PTQ) techniques offer an efficient solution for model compression and inference acceleration. Yet, the quantized model faces performance degradation due to outlier channels, which are highly sensitive to quantization and substantially impair activation fidelity and task accuracy. To protect these salient channels during quantization, existing

summary.core_problem: MLLM 后训练量化中，少数敏感 outlier channel 会放大量化误差，导致激活保真度和任务性能下降。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理压缩方法改进。它把通道重要性从模态级或 token 级启发式指标，改成与任务损失扰动更直接相关的 Fisher 加权敏感度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 C-PTQ，一种通道级 PTQ 方法。方法利用二阶信息动机，用 Fisher 加权估计各 channel 对任务损失的敏感度，并将该敏感度与量化误差结合，用于指导 channel-wise scaling，保护关键通道。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、量化 bit 数、任务集和提升幅度。实验目标是比较 C-PTQ 与现有 MLLM PTQ/CWS 方法在任务准确率和激活保真度上的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles degradation in MLLM post-training quantization caused by outlier channels that are highly sensitive to quantization.
summary_en.importance: It is an inference-compression method contribution. The key change is to replace modality- or token-level heuristics with a Fisher-weighted channel sensitivity estimate tied more directly to task loss perturbation.
summary_en.technical_approach: C-PTQ estimates channel-wise sensitivity using a Fisher-weighted second-order motivation, then combines this with quantization error to guide channel-wise scaling and protect salient channels during PTQ.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, bit widths, benchmark names, or numeric gains. The intended comparison is against existing MLLM PTQ and channel-wise scaling methods on task accuracy and activation fidelity.

recommendation.zh: 量化论文里较干净地把 Fisher sensitivity 接到 CWS；看方法式子即可。
recommendation.en: A reasonably clean Fisher-sensitivity variant for CWS in PTQ; read the equations, not the whole paper.

paper.title: KroQuant: Kronecker-Structured Block Transforms for Efficient Post-Training Quantization of Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) of diffusion transformers (DiTs) to W4A4 severely degrades output quality, because activations entering each linear layer contain outliers that 4-bit formats cannot represent. The standard fix applies an invertible linear transform to the activations and its inverse to the weights before quantizing both. Normalization layers between blocks force this transform to run online at every denoising step, making its inference computation cost the binding design constrai

summary.core_problem: 扩散 Transformer 的 W4A4 后训练量化在激活 outlier 存在时显著掉质，而高质量的“激活变换+权重逆变换”方案又会引入每步在线计算开销。
summary.importance: 属于推理侧效率/量化工程：把“量化精度 vs 在线变换成本”的矛盾讲清，并给出结构化变换的折中点；对做多模态/扩散统一建模的部署有参考，但不直接推进 LLM 预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Kronecker 结构的 block 变换（可逆线性变换的结构化近似），试图在 SmoothQuant（便宜但精度差）与全维可学习变换（精度好但每层每步 dense GEMM 太贵）之间取得更优的质量-成本折中；动机来自归一化层导致变换需在每个 denoising step 在线执行。
summary.experiments: 面向 DiT 的 PTQ，目标 W4A4；对比 per-channel scaling、Hadamard、learned full-d transform 等路线，报告生成质量退化与推理开销权衡（摘要未给出具体模型/数据/指标数值）。

summary_en.core_problem: W4A4 post-training quantization of diffusion Transformers degrades quality due to activation outliers, while high-accuracy invertible activation/weight transforms are too expensive to run online at every denoising step.
summary_en.importance: Inference-efficiency/quantization engineering: clarifies the accuracy-vs-online-transform-cost trade-off and proposes a structured transform as a practical middle ground; indirectly relevant for deploying diffusion-style components, not for core LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: KroQuant uses Kronecker-structured block transforms as a structured approximation to learned full-d invertible transforms, aiming to retain quantization fidelity without paying a dense GEMM per layer per step; the need for online execution is driven by normalization layers between blocks.
summary_en.experiments: PTQ for DiTs at W4A4; compares against per-channel scaling (SmoothQuant), fixed Hadamard transforms, and learned full-d transforms, reporting quality vs inference cost trade-offs (no concrete numbers in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 量化论文里少见地把“归一化→每步在线变换”这个真实瓶颈点出来；只看方法动机和成本模型即可，别指望对预训练有直接增益。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for the very practical point that normalization forces per-step online transforms in DiTs; read the motivation/cost trade-off, but don’t expect pretraining insights.

paper.title: Beyond Independent Optimization: Compression, MoE Routing, and Quantization Interactions in Multimodal Edge Intelligence
paper.abstract: Efficient multimodal inference is increasingly constrained not only by model quality or FLOP count, but also by the cost of preserving, moving, routing, caching, and quantizing multimodal representations under latency, memory, and energy constraints. This paper reviews recent advances in efficient vision-language and multimodal large language models, covering visual token compression, video token management, KV-cache optimization, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing, low-bit quantization, edge depl

summary.core_problem: 多模态边缘推理优化中，视觉token压缩、MoE路由、量化、KV-cache等技术常被独立优化，忽略了彼此间的级联耦合效应，导致整体性能与效率次优。
summary.importance: 综述性工作，系统梳理了多模态边缘部署中各类效率优化技术的交互关系，指出独立优化的常见误区。
summary.technical_approach: 通过文献综述逐一分析各类优化技术的耦合路径：视觉token压缩改变下游特征分布进而影响MoE路由决策，路由行为影响专家利用率和量化敏感性，量化后的路由logits改变专家分配结果，KV-cache策略决定多模态证据留存，硬件约束使计算节省转化为内存/通信瓶颈。
summary.experiments: 为综述性工作，无原创实验，仅对现有研究中的优化交互效应做了定性梳理。

summary_en.core_problem: In multimodal edge inference, techniques such as visual token compression, MoE routing, quantization, and KV-cache optimization are often optimized independently, ignoring cascaded coupling effects that lead to suboptimal end-to-end performance and efficiency.
summary_en.importance: A survey that systematically reviews interactions between efficiency optimization techniques for multimodal edge deployment, pointing out the common pitfall of treating optimizations as independent.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyzes coupling paths between optimizations via literature review: visual token compression alters downstream feature distributions and MoE routing decisions; routing behavior affects expert utilization and quantization sensitivity; quantized router logits change expert assignment; KV-cache policies determine retained multimodal evidence; hardware constraints convert computational savings into memory/communication bottlenecks.
summary_en.experiments: This is a survey work with no original experiments, providing only qualitative synthesis of optimization interaction effects from existing research.

recommendation.zh: 多模态边缘推理优化的耦合效应综述，无原创实验结论，做多模态部署时可参考其交互项清单，无需通读。
recommendation.en: A survey on coupling effects across multimodal edge inference optimizations with no original results; refer to its interaction checklist for deployment, no full read needed.

paper.title: Total Variation Distance Estimation in Autoregressive Models
paper.abstract: Modern LLM deployments use a number of implementation choices and inference optimizations (e.g., batching, custom kernels, and quantization) on top of fixed weights, so two engines serving "the same model" can produce meaningfully different distributions. We study the problem of estimating the total variation (TV) distance between two length-$n$ autoregressive distributions to additive error $\varepsilon$, under three access models. (1) Under sample access, we use $\widetilde{O}(n^2 K/\varepsilo

summary.core_problem: 同一组LLM权重经过不同推理栈部署（量化、自定义算子、批处理策略、有损推测解码，甚至实现bug）时，输出分布会产生可观测差异。全变差（TV）距离取值有界、对支撑集变化鲁棒，适合这类部署一致性校验场景，但TV不像KL散度存在逐token链式分解，无法通过简单的逐位置logit对比直接估计序列级差异。论文核心研究在不同程度的API访问权限下，如何用尽可能少的查询次数，将两个长度为n的自回归序列分布之间的TV距离估计到指定加性误差ε。
summary.importance: 现有工作评估部署前后的分布变化普遍使用KL散度，但KL在两个分布支撑集不完全重合时无界，对top-k截断、敏感词过滤这类服务端常规操作过度敏感，结果难以解释。论文提出的估计器大幅降低了TV距离的查询成本，为模型服务商做推理栈回归测试、用户验证第三方模型服务与官方版本的一致性提供了可落地的度量工具，也为训练过程数值漂移检测、推理优化的误差边界评估提供了正式分析框架。
summary.technical_approach: 围绕三种常见的LLM API访问模式，分别推导TV距离估计器及对应样本复杂度界：1）纯采样访问（传入前缀仅返回next-token采样结果）：此前Meel等人2025年的估计器需要O(n³m/ε⁵)次查询（m为全词表大小），新方法将复杂度降至O(n²K/ε²·log²(1/ε))，K为任意前缀下next-token分布的最大有效支撑大小。改进核心是放弃了此前方法对全词表加均匀平滑的处理思路，直接利用LLM next-token分布的强稀疏性，对应的问题下界为Ω(nK/(ε²logK))，说明上界已接近紧。2）全logit访问（传入前缀可拿到完整next-token概率分布）：无需序列级采样，可直接逐位置计算分布差异，得到更低的查询复杂度。3）带噪分布访问（返回的logit存在测量噪声）：给出噪声鲁棒的估计误差界。论文同时明确对比了TV与KL作为部署差异度量的实际优缺。
summary.experiments: 以理论结果为主，配套的实证测量验证了实际场景下的支撑大小特征：Qwen模型全词表m=151643，在常用采样参数k=20时，next-token的实际有效支撑K不到2k（即40），对应m/K比值超过3000，说明这种感知支撑稀疏性的估计器相比此前依赖全词表大小的方法，真实场景下的查询量优势达到三个数量级。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言部分对TV与KL作为LLM部署差异度量的优劣对比，以及三种访问模式下的样本复杂度结论；形式化证明部分可跳过，除非专门研究LLM分布测试方向。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Identical LLM weights can produce measurable output distribution shifts when deployed across different inference stacks, due to choices in quantization, custom kernels, batching, lossy speculative decoding, or even implementation bugs. Total variation (TV) distance is a bounded, support-robust metric well suited for deployment consistency checks, but unlike KL divergence it lacks a per-token chain rule decomposition, so sequence-level TV cannot be directly estimated from simple per-step logit comparisons. This work studies how to estimate TV between two length-n autoregressive sequence distributions to additive error ε with minimal query count, under realistic API access constraints.
summary_en.importance: KL divergence is the de facto metric for measuring distributional changes in LLM serving today, but KL is unbounded when distribution supports do not perfectly overlap, making it oversensitive to common serving operations like top-k truncation or content filtering and producing hard-to-interpret results. The proposed estimators drastically reduce the query cost of TV estimation, giving model providers a practical tool for inference stack regression testing, giving end users a way to verify third-party serving endpoints match reference model behavior, and providing a formal framework to reason about numerical drift during training and error bounds for inference optimizations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper derives TV estimators and tight sample complexity bounds across three tiers of LLM API access: (1) Sample-only access, where an oracle returns next-token samples for a given prefix: the estimator improves on the prior O(n³m/ε⁵) query bound from Meel et al. (2025) to Õ(n²K/ε²), where K is the maximum effective support size of any next-token distribution. The improvement comes from discarding the prior method's full-vocabulary uniform smoothing step, and instead leveraging the strong sparsity of real LLM next-token distributions. A matching lower bound of Ω(nK/(ε² log K)) shows the upper bound is near tight. (2) Full logit access, where the oracle returns the complete next-token distribution for a prefix: the estimator achieves much lower query complexity by computing per-position distribution differences directly without sequence-level sampling. (3) Noisy distribution access, where returned logits have measurement error: noise-robust estimation bounds are provided. The work also formalizes the practical tradeoffs between TV and KL as metrics for LLM deployment comparison.
summary_en.experiments: Results are primarily theoretical, with supporting empirical measurements of real LLM next-token support characteristics: for Qwen models with a full vocabulary size of 151,643, under the common sampling setting k=20, the actual effective next-token support K is less than 2k (40), giving an m/K ratio of over 3000. This quantifies the three-orders-of-magnitude query savings the support-aware estimator delivers in practice, compared to prior methods that scale with full vocabulary size.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for core arguments and complexity results. Focus on the introduction's comparison of TV vs KL for LLM deployment measurement, and the sample complexity bounds across the three access models. Skip formal proof sections unless working specifically on distribution testing for LLMs. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 理论味重但问题提得准：给‘量化/kernel/batching 改坏输出分布多少’一个可证估计框架，做 serving/量化的人读 §2–§3 的三种 access model 与上界即可。
recommendation.en: Theory-heavy but the problem is well-posed: it gives a provable framework for how much quantization/kernels/batching shift output distributions; serving/quantization folks should read §2–§3 on the three access models.

paper.title: Contraction-Gauge Preconditioning for Quantized Matrix Multiplication
paper.abstract: We study low-precision computation of C=AB with both factors quantized. We derive an exact finite-dimensional identity for the expected squared product error under independent, zero-mean entrywise errors with known variance fields; it holds exactly for non-overloading subtractive dither and for independent stochastic rounding, and we empirically assess deterministic round-to-nearest (RTN). Using the product-preserving equivalence AB=(AT)(T^{-1}B), we formulate contraction-gauge preconditioning:

summary.core_problem: 解决双因子低精度量化矩阵乘法C=AB的乘积误差过大问题，降低量化带来的精度损失。
summary.importance: 提出收缩规范预处理方法，通过凸优化得到最优因子变换，为量化矩阵乘的误差控制提供了新的数值范式。
summary.technical_approach: 利用矩阵乘积的规范变换等价性AB=(AT)(T^{-1}B)，将量化前的因子表示选择转化为正对角规范族下的凸优化问题：共享变换通过几何规划求全局最优，块级变换通过线性规划判断恒等变换是否最优。
summary.experiments: 理论上严格证明所提误差界对非溢出减性抖动、独立随机舍入严格成立，对确定性最近邻舍入（RTN）开展了实证评估，未在大模型或深度学习任务上进行端到端验证。

summary_en.core_problem: Reduce product error in low-precision quantized matrix multiplication C=AB where both factors are quantized, to mitigate accuracy loss from quantization.
summary_en.importance: Proposes contraction-gauge preconditioning, which obtains optimal factor transforms via convex optimization, providing a new numerical paradigm for error control in quantized matmul.
summary_en.technical_approach: Leverages the product-preserving equivalence AB=(AT)(T^{-1}B) to formulate pre-quantization factor selection as convex optimization over positive diagonal gauges: shared transforms are solved globally via geometric programming, block-specific transforms use linear programming to check identity fold optimality.
summary_en.experiments: The derived error identity holds exactly for non-overloading subtractive dither and independent stochastic rounding; deterministic round-to-nearest is assessed empirically, with no end-to-end validation on large models or deep learning tasks.

recommendation.zh: 通用量化矩阵乘的数值优化工作，无大模型验证，作为低精度计算文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: General numerical work on quantized matmul without LLM validation; keep as reference for low-precision computing only.

paper.title: Quantizing Recursive Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Recursive reasoning models solve hard puzzles by applying compact, weight-tied blocks over many refinement steps. Because these blocks are reused many times, quantizing them creates a unique dynamical problem: the quantization error is incurred at every step. While 8-bit quantization (integer or float) preserves accuracy, moving to a per-tensor 4-bit format causes a systematic bias to accumulate. The ensuing drift catastrophically degrades exact-solution accuracy on Sudoku from 84.1% to 0.0% (on

summary.core_problem: 递归推理模型（在多个细化步骤中重复使用相同的权重块）在量化到 4-bit 时，由于量化误差在每一步累积，会导致严重的性能崩溃（如数独准确率从 84.1% 降至 0.0%）。
summary.importance: 揭示了递归模型量化崩溃的根本原因在于激活缩放的粒度（activation-scaling granularity），而非位宽或数值格式，并提出了有效的解决方案。
summary.technical_approach: 发现 per-tensor 的 4-bit 量化会导致系统性偏差累积。提出使用 per-block 缩放（具体应用了 MXInt4 格式，即分块整数激活格式）来完全恢复性能，保持了整数元素和 2 的幂次方的块缩放。
summary.experiments: 在数独任务上，per-tensor 4-bit 量化导致准确率从 84.1% 暴跌至 0.0%，而使用 MXInt4（per-block scaling）后性能恢复，与分块浮点格式具有竞争力。
summary.authors_note: ETH Zurich 团队，Luca Benini 是低功耗和高效计算领域的知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: Recursive reasoning models (which reuse weight-tied blocks over many refinement steps) suffer catastrophic performance collapse when quantized to 4-bit due to the accumulation of quantization error at every step.
summary_en.importance: Reveals that the root cause of quantization collapse in recursive models is activation-scaling granularity, not bit-width or number format, and proposes an effective solution.
summary_en.technical_approach: Identified that per-tensor 4-bit quantization causes systematic bias accumulation. Proposed using per-block scaling (specifically applying the MXInt4 format, a blockwise integer activation format) to fully restore performance, maintaining integer elements and power-of-two block scales.
summary_en.experiments: On the Sudoku task, per-tensor 4-bit quantization dropped accuracy from 84.1% to 0.0%, while using MXInt4 (per-block scaling) restored performance, making it competitive with blockwise float formats.
summary_en.authors_note: ETH Zurich team; Luca Benini is a renowned scholar in low-power and efficient computing.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 weight-tied 递归模型在低比特量化时的误差累积机制，对研究具有 recurrent 结构的 LLM（如 Universal Transformer 变体）的量化有启发。
recommendation.en: Reveals the error accumulation mechanism in low-bit quantization of weight-tied recursive models, offering insights for quantizing LLMs with recurrent structures.

paper.title: Regularize or Localize: When Training-Time KV-Cache Geometry Pays Under Quantization
paper.abstract: We study whether \sigreg -- LeJEPA's anti-collapse objective -- can reshape representations during standard autoregressive language-model pretraining, and when the resulting geometry helps \kv-cache quantization. We train 110M-parameter models on 10B FineWeb tokens and report three findings. \textbf{(1)} At $λ{=}0.01$, \sigreg reduces hidden-state pairwise-cosine anisotropy by $38\%$ across three paired seeds. Perplexity increases by less than $0.35\%$ in every pair, with no consistent zero-shot

summary.core_problem: 研究训练时改变表示几何，是否能改善 LLM 的 KV-cache 量化质量。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练动态与推理效率之间的实证连接。它不是单纯做量化算法，而是问预训练或 continued training 中的正则项能否提前塑造 KV 分布，从而降低后续低比特缓存量化损失。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 LeJEPA 中用于防止表示坍缩的 SigReg 引入自回归 LM 训练，分别作用于 hidden states 以及 K/V cache。核心比较是：只正则隐藏状态、直接正则 K/V、冻结 trunk 后 retrofit、以及无 KV 项的匹配 continued training。度量重点是 pairwise-cosine anisotropy 和未变换、对称、group-free KV 量化下的性能变化。
summary.experiments: 作者训练 110M 参数模型，使用 10B FineWeb tokens。λ=0.01 时，hidden-state SigReg 在三组成对 seed 上将隐藏状态各向异性降低 38%，困惑度增加均小于 0.35%，zero-shot 没有一致退化；但该变化不传导到 KV cache。直接对 K/V 做 continued training 正则后，四个 checkpoint 的平均 cache 各向异性下降 94%，且在未变换对称 group-free 量化下，只有直接 KV 正则带来有效收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether shaping representation geometry during training can improve KV-cache quantization in autoregressive language models.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an empirical bridge between training-time representation geometry and inference-time memory efficiency. Rather than proposing another post-hoc quantizer, it tests whether continued training can make the KV cache easier to quantize.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors adapt SigReg, the anti-collapse objective from LeJEPA, to autoregressive LM training. They apply it either to hidden states or directly to K and V tensors, and compare against matched continued training, frozen-trunk retrofits, and unregularized baselines. The key measurements are pairwise-cosine anisotropy and performance under untransformed symmetric group-free KV quantization.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments train 110M-parameter models on 10B FineWeb tokens. With λ=0.01, hidden-state SigReg reduces hidden-state anisotropy by 38% across three paired seeds, with less than 0.35% perplexity increase and no consistent zero-shot degradation. However, this does not transfer to KV-cache geometry. Direct K/V regularization during continued training reduces mean cache anisotropy by 94% across four checkpoints and is the only tested training condition that improves the target quantization setup.

recommendation.zh: 少数把预训练表示几何和 KV 量化直接连起来的干净小实验；重点看 KV 正则消融和量化表。
recommendation.en: A clean small-scale link between training-time geometry and KV quantization; read the KV-regularization ablations and quantization tables.

paper.title: MXSens: Sensitivity-Aware Mixed-Precision Quantization for Efficient LLM Inference
paper.abstract: 4-bit quantization enables efficient LLM inference, but suffers from significant accuracy degradation due to outliers. Prior work addresses this problem via data rotation or mixed-precision integer quantization, but often relies on software-managed scaling and frequent dequantization, incurring substantial overhead. Microscaling formats, such as MXINT, eliminate these inefficiencies by encoding scales in hardware, yet remain incompatible with rotation-based methods. Our analysis reveals that out

summary.core_problem: 4-bit LLM 量化中离群值导致精度下降，而现有 MXINT 硬件微缩放格式与旋转类方法不兼容，混合精度又常引入软件缩放/反量化开销。
summary.importance: 给出一种无需训练、面向 MXINT 硬件格式的敏感度感知混合位宽量化方案，对部署侧有实际价值。
summary.technical_approach: 分析离群值严重程度跨层/跨列分布不均，提出 MXSens：按列与按层的量化敏感度，在 MXINT 块结构内为不同列分配 4/6/8 位尾数，无需训练、无需旋转。
summary.experiments: 在多类 LLM 上超过现有量化方法（摘要截断，具体模型与幅度未给出）；training-free。
summary.authors_note: 作者含 Babak Falsafi、Martin Jaggi、Amir Yazdanbakhsh 等，来自 EPFL/CMU/Google DeepMind 相关背景（按作者所属机构常见归属，未在摘要中明确列出）。

summary_en.core_problem: 4-bit LLM quantization suffers from outliers; rotation-based methods are incompatible with hardware microscaling (MXINT) formats, while mixed-precision approaches incur software scaling/dequant overhead.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a training-free, sensitivity-guided mixed mantissa-bitwidth quantization tailored to MXINT's block structure, with practical deployment value.
summary_en.technical_approach: Observes that outlier severity and quantization sensitivity are uneven across layers and columns; MXSens assigns 4/6/8-bit mantissas per column/layer based on sensitivity, naturally fitting MXINT blocks without rotation or retraining.
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms prior quantization methods across a range of LLMs (abstract truncated; training-free).
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Babak Falsafi, Martin Jaggi, and Amir Yazdanbakhsh.

recommendation.zh: 纯推理量化工作，对预训练无直接 insight；若做 MX 硬件部署可看 §3 的敏感度分布分析，否则跳过。
recommendation.en: Inference-only quantization; no direct pretraining insight. Read §3 sensitivity analysis only if you deploy on MX hardware.

paper.title: QUADS: Stabilizing NVFP4 Reinforcement Learning for MoE via QUantization-error Alignment across Dual Sides
paper.abstract: Rollout generation is a major bottleneck in Reinforcement Learning (RL) for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Large Language Models, motivating low-precision rollout acceleration such as FP8. As an emerging low-precision format, NVFP4 combines fine-grained scaling for accuracy preservation with native W4A4 FP4 GEMMs for higher throughput than FP8. However, we find that directly applying NVFP4 to MoE RL rollout is impractical. NVFP4 rollout with BF16 training collapses after roughly 150 steps, accompanied

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很具体的工程—算法接口问题：在 MoE 大模型的 RL 训练里，rollout 端如果用 Blackwell 上原生 W4A4 的 NVFP4 来提速，会因为 rollout 与 trainer 的 log-probability 偏差迅速放大而训练崩溃。作者要找出的不是“低精度会不会掉点”这种泛泛结论，而是：崩溃主要来自权重量化还是激活量化；如果主要来自激活误差，那么在 rollout 和 trainer 分离的 RL 管线里，怎样做误差对齐，才能既保住 W4A4 吞吐，又不破坏 GRPO 的策略梯度稳定性。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 pretrain↔posttrain 接口、训练稳定性和低精度系统设计很有参考价值。原因有两点。第一，RL 训练越来越像一个分布式异构系统问题，rollout 精度不只是 serving 细节，而是直接进入 importance ratio 和 policy update 的训练信号。第二，这篇工作把“低精度不稳定”拆成了可操作的误差来源分析，指出在 NVFP4 这种极低比特格式下，激活误差比权重误差更致命，而两者不能用同一种对齐策略处理。这个结论对未来更激进的低精度 pretrain / mid-train 也有启发：如果训练和推理路径不一致，先分清哪些张量可同步、哪些张量是在线重算的，往往比统一做 fake quant 更关键。贡献量级属于强工程方法论文，尤其适合关注 RL 系统、MoE 和 Blackwell 低精度栈的人。
summary.technical_approach: 作者的方法叫 QUADS，核心是 dual-side quantization-error alignment，也就是 trainer 侧和 rollout 侧分别处理不同来源的误差，而不是试图用一个统一的量化方案覆盖全部路径。诊断部分先做了关键 ablation：把 rollout 中的权重和激活分开量化，比较 W4A16 与 W16A4。结果显示 W16A4 的失败模式几乎贴近完整 W4A4，而 W4A16 明显更稳定，说明 activation quantization 才是主导项，且权重误差与激活误差近似可加。基于这个发现，QUADS 分两部分。其一是 trainer-side asymmetric QAT：在训练端只对权重做 NVFP4 fake quantization / dequantization，对激活保持 BF16。这样做的原因很直接：权重在 rollout engine 与 trainer 之间是同步参数，可以共享匹配的 QDQ 路径；而激活是每次 rollout 在线重算的，若在 trainer 端也强行做对称 W4A4 fake quant，反而会把本来无法严格对齐的激活误差注入学习过程。其二是 rollout-side residual activation compensation：既然激活误差是主因，就在真正的 W4A4 rollout 里对高残差通道做 second-pass quantization，用额外一轮更精细的补偿减少 activation quantization 带来的 log-prob 偏差。作者强调这部分通过 fused kernels 实现，目的是保住大部分原生 W4A4 Tensor Core 吞吐优势，而不是退回高精度 GEMM。与已有方法相比，QeRL 之类只做 weight-only NVFP4，激活仍用 BF16，本质上没有进入真正的 W4A4 regime；FP8/INT8 RL 系统则处在更宽松的数值网格上，训练—推理不匹配更容易靠 clipping 或 TIS 控住。QUADS 的区别在于它正面处理 full-parameter MoE GRPO 下的原生 FP4 activation mismatch。
summary.experiments: 实验结论很清楚。首先，naive NVFP4 W4A4 rollout + BF16 training 会在大约 150 个 RL step 后崩溃，表现为 reward 和 held-out score 同时下降，且 rollout–trainer 的 per-token log-probability gap 单调增大，importance ratio 被推离 trust region。其次，分离量化的 ablation 证明了误差来源：W16A4 基本复现 W4A4 的不稳定，而 W4A16 更接近稳定训练，支持“激活误差主导”的判断。最终结果上，QUADS 在 full-parameter MoE GRPO 中把平均 pass@1 做到 72.86%，几乎追平 BF16 baseline 的 73.15%，远高于 naive NVFP4 的 51.37%。同时，rollout throughput 比 FP8 还高 16%。摘要里提到评测覆盖四个 held-out benchmarks，但给出的全文片段没有展开具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、专家数、训练 token 数和 group size G 等更细节数字；这些应在实验节和附录里核对。就目前可见信息，最重要的不是绝对分数，而是三组对比关系：BF16≈QUADS >> naive NVFP4，以及 QUADS 在稳定性恢复后仍保留对 FP8 的吞吐优势。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议很明确。先看 Introduction 里对 RL pipeline 的问题定义，确认作者讨论的是 decoupled rollout/trainer 架构下的数值偏差，而不是普通量化推理。然后直接看 Section 3.1 的 ablation，这是全文最关键的一页：如果不先接受“activation error 是主因”，后面的 asymmetric QAT 和 residual compensation 就会显得像两块经验 patch。接着看 trainer-side QAT 和 rollout-side compensation 的实现细节，重点关注为什么一边只量化权重、另一边专门补偿激活，以及 fused kernel 是否真的保住吞吐。最后看主结果表，核对三件事：训练是否稳定到全程、log-prob gap 是否被压回可控范围、吞吐提升是否在端到端而不只是 kernel 级。预计阅读时间 20-30 分钟。若要深挖，建议追问两个问题：一是这种方法对 dense model 是否同样成立，还是 MoE 的路由稀疏性放大了激活误差；二是 residual activation compensation 的额外开销在更长 CoT rollout 下是否仍然划算。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific systems-and-optimization problem in RL for MoE LLMs: native NVFP4 W4A4 rollout on Blackwell is attractive for throughput, but when rollout is run in FP4 while training remains in BF16, the rollout–trainer log-probability mismatch quickly destabilizes GRPO and causes collapse. The key question is not simply whether low precision hurts, but which source of error matters most—weights or activations—and how to align quantization error across the decoupled rollout and trainer paths without giving up the throughput advantage of true W4A4 execution.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is highly relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface, training stability, and low-precision system design. Two points matter. First, in modern RL pipelines, rollout precision is part of the training signal because token log-probabilities feed directly into importance ratios and policy updates; it is not just a serving detail. Second, the paper turns “low precision instability” into a structured error-analysis problem and shows that under NVFP4, activation quantization is much more damaging than weight quantization, and the two should not be handled with the same alignment strategy. That lesson generalizes: whenever training and inference paths diverge, it is often more important to distinguish synchronized tensors from online-recomputed tensors than to apply a uniform fake-quant recipe everywhere. The contribution is best seen as a strong engineering method paper for RL systems, MoE training, and Blackwell-era low-precision deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, QUADS, stands for quantization-error alignment across dual sides. The central idea is to treat trainer-side and rollout-side errors differently instead of forcing a single quantization scheme over both. The diagnostic step is crucial: the authors separately quantize weights and activations during rollout and compare W4A16 against W16A4. W16A4 closely reproduces the failure mode of full W4A4, while W4A16 is much more stable, showing that activation quantization dominates the instability and that weight and activation errors are roughly additive. Based on this, QUADS has two components. First, trainer-side asymmetric QAT: weights are fake-quantized to NVFP4, but activations remain in BF16. The rationale is that weights are synchronized across rollout and trainer engines, so their quantization–dequantization path can be aligned; activations are recomputed online during rollout and cannot be faithfully matched by symmetric W4A4 fake quantization on the learner side. Second, rollout-side residual activation compensation: since activation error is the main problem, the rollout engine performs a second-pass quantization on high-residual channels to reduce activation-induced log-prob bias while preserving native W4A4 GEMMs. The implementation uses fused kernels so that most of the throughput benefit of FP4 Tensor Cores is retained. This differs from prior work in an important way. Weight-only NVFP4 methods such as QeRL never enter the true W4A4 regime because activations stay in BF16, and FP8/INT8 RL systems operate on a much denser numerical grid where mismatch can often be controlled by clipping or truncated importance sampling. QUADS is designed specifically for full-parameter MoE GRPO with native FP4 activation quantization.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical story is straightforward. Naive NVFP4 rollout with W4A4 inference and BF16 training collapses after roughly 150 RL steps: reward and held-out performance drop, while the per-token rollout–trainer log-probability gap grows monotonically and pushes importance ratios outside the trust region. The weight-vs-activation ablation then identifies the source: W16A4 largely matches the instability of full W4A4, whereas W4A16 remains much closer to stable behavior, supporting the claim that activation error is the dominant driver. In the final results, QUADS reaches 72.86% average pass@1 across four held-out benchmarks, essentially matching the BF16 baseline at 73.15% and far outperforming naive NVFP4 at 51.37%. At the same time, it improves rollout throughput by 16% over FP8. The provided text does not expose finer details such as model size, expert count, benchmark names, total RL steps, or exact GRPO group settings, so those should be checked in the experimental section and appendix. The main takeaway is the relation among the three systems: BF16 ≈ QUADS >> naive NVFP4, with QUADS still preserving a throughput edge over FP8.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction to anchor the problem correctly: this is about numerical mismatch in a decoupled rollout/trainer RL pipeline, not generic quantized inference. Then go directly to the ablation in Section 3.1. That is the most important part of the paper. If the activation-dominant failure mode is not established first, the later design choices can look like ad hoc patches. After that, read the trainer-side asymmetric QAT and rollout-side residual compensation sections, focusing on why one side aligns weights while the other explicitly compensates activations, and whether the fused-kernel implementation really preserves throughput. Finally, inspect the main result tables for three things: end-to-end training stability, reduction of the rollout–trainer log-prob gap, and whether the throughput gain survives beyond kernel-level microbenchmarks. A useful skim should take 20–30 minutes. If you want to go deeper, two questions are worth pursuing: whether the same conclusion holds for dense models or is amplified by MoE routing sparsity, and whether the extra cost of residual activation compensation remains favorable for longer chain-of-thought rollouts.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该看的是“激活误差比权重误差更致命”这个结论；若你在做低精度 RL 或 rollout-serving 一体化，先复现 log-prob gap 诊断再谈提速。
recommendation.en: The key takeaway is that activation error, not weight error, dominates FP4 RL collapse; if you run low-precision RL or rollout-serving stacks, reproduce the log-prob-gap diagnostic before chasing throughput.

paper.title: PolyQ: Codesigning End-to-End Quantization Framework for Scalable Edge CPU LLM Inference
paper.abstract: CPUs are the most universal target for on-device LLM inference, but existing low-bit quantization methods offer either coarse operating points or fine-grained mixed precision that is difficult to execute efficiently on CPUs. We present PolyQ, a CPU-oriented compiler/quantization co-design for activation-aware channel-wise bit allocation under a user-specified average-bit budget. PolyQ assigns per-channel bit-widths from $\{2,3,4,8,16\}$, then uses a compile-time model compiler to permute and clu

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM低比特量化方案存在两端脱节：粗粒度整层统一比特的方法无法灵活适配不同内存预算，细粒度逐通道混合精度的方法又难以在CPU上高效执行，缺少能在用户指定的任意平均比特预算下，同时兼顾精度和CPU执行效率的端侧CPU推理量化方案。
summary.importance: 通过量化与编译的共设计，解决了细粒度混合精度量化在CPU上落地的核心系统障碍，将比特预算的控制粒度从整层推进到逐通道，同时把所有布局变换开销移到编译期，消除了运行时额外开销。对端侧CPU部署场景有直接工程价值，但属于推理优化的系统类工作，对预训练研究的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: PolyQ是面向CPU的量化-编译共设计框架，分三步实现：1）逐通道从CPU友好的{2,3,4,8,16}比特集合中分配位宽，以激活感知的通道显著性为权重做水填充，精确匹配用户指定的分数平均比特预算；2）编译期将不规则的逐通道位宽分配通过排列、聚类操作重组为比特同质的块，为每个块生成适配SIMD指令和查找表（LUT）的计算内核；3）跨算子传播兼容的排列规则，让相邻层的布局变换相互抵消，全程不需要运行时数据重排。
summary.experiments: 在3比特平均预算下，模型困惑度比现有方法低2.4%–32.1%；编译期量子匹配后，实际平均比特与目标值的偏差不超过0.045比特；激活重排带来的数据流量比现有布局策略最多降低70.8%；端到端推理延迟与经过优化的LUT后端差距在5.8%以内，每token的额外能耗开销小于2%。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时重点看引言提出的三个核心落地障碍、方法部分的共设计思路，以及实验中的精度-延迟-开销权衡结果，预计阅读时间15分钟。从事端侧CPU部署的工程师可以进一步深入看编译期排列传播和内核生成的实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM low-bit quantization methods face a mismatch between granularity and deployability: coarse per-layer uniform bit-width schemes cannot flexibly adapt to varying memory budgets, while fine-grained per-channel mixed precision schemes cannot execute efficiently on CPUs. No end-to-end quantization solution for edge CPU inference supports arbitrary user-specified average bit budgets while balancing both accuracy and CPU execution efficiency.
summary_en.importance: This work resolves core system barriers to deploying fine-grained mixed-precision quantization on CPUs via quantization-compiler co-design, pushing bit budget control granularity from per-layer to per-channel while moving all layout transformation overhead to compile time to eliminate runtime costs. It delivers direct engineering value for edge CPU deployment scenarios, but offers limited direct insight for pretraining research as an inference optimization system work.
summary_en.technical_approach: PolyQ is a CPU-oriented quantization-compiler co-design framework implemented in three stages: 1) Per-channel bit-widths are allocated from a CPU-aligned palette of {2,3,4,8,16} bits, using activation-aware channel saliency weighted waterfilling to precisely match user-specified fractional average bit budgets; 2) At compile time, irregular per-channel bit assignments are permuted and clustered into bit-homogeneous blocks, with compute kernels tailored for SIMD instructions and look-up tables (LUT) generated for each block; 3) Compatible permutations are propagated across operators to cancel out layout transformations between adjacent layers, eliminating the need for runtime data rearrangement entirely.
summary_en.experiments: At a 3-bit average budget, PolyQ reduces perplexity by 2.4–32.1% relative to prior methods. After compile-time quanta matching, actual average bit-width deviates from the target by no more than 0.045 bits. Activation reorder traffic is reduced by up to 70.8% compared to existing layout policies. End-to-end inference latency is within 5.8% of an optimized LUT backend, with less than 2% additional energy overhead per token.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the three core deployment barriers outlined in the introduction, the co-design logic in the method section, and the accuracy-latency-overhead tradeoff results in experiments; expected reading time is 15 minutes. Engineers working on edge CPU deployment can dive deeper into implementation details of compile-time permutation propagation and kernel generation.

recommendation.zh: skim 编译器部分即可；它提醒量化精度分配必须和 kernel 形态一起设计，单看 PPL 会误判。
recommendation.en: Skim the compiler section; it is a good reminder that bit allocation and kernel shape must be designed together.

paper.title: Quantize with Confidence? An Empirical Study of Quantization for Code Generation
paper.abstract: The growing adoption of local inference frameworks such as Ollama has made it increasingly common for developers to run large code models on laptops and other resource-constrained hardware. In these settings, post-training quantization is essential for reducing memory footprint and enabling practical deployment, yet its impact on generated code remains insufficiently understood. We empirically evaluate six state-of-the-art quantization methods (GPTQ, AWQ, QuIP#, AQLM, BitsAndBytes, and GGUF) on

summary.core_problem: 系统评估后训练量化对代码生成模型的功能正确性、代码质量和提示复杂度鲁棒性的影响。
summary.importance: 这是推理部署侧的经验研究，贡献在于把常见量化方法放到代码生成场景中比较，并补充 pass@1 之外的可靠性、安全性、可维护性等维度；对预训练研究的价值主要是提醒评测指标不能只看平均正确率。
summary.technical_approach: 比较 GPTQ、AWQ、QuIP#、AQLM、BitsAndBytes 和 GGUF 六类量化方法，在 Qwen2.5-Coder 与 CodeLlama 两个代码模型族上评估；除功能正确性外，还分析代码维护性、可靠性、安全性、结构复杂度，并用 Shannon entropy 与 token length 描述 prompt complexity。
summary.experiments: 使用 multilingual McEval 和 CoderEval，覆盖 Python 与 Java；核心指标包括 pass@1 以及多类代码质量指标。摘要只说明不同量化方法对正确性和鲁棒性的影响存在显著差异，未给出具体模型规模、bit-width 设置或完整提升/下降幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper empirically studies how post-training quantization affects code-generation models across functional correctness, code quality, and robustness to prompt complexity.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-deployment study. Its useful contribution is comparing common quantization methods on code LMs and moving beyond pass@1 to reliability, security, maintainability, and structural complexity; for pretraining researchers, the signal is mostly about evaluation brittleness under compression.
summary_en.technical_approach: It evaluates GPTQ, AWQ, QuIP#, AQLM, BitsAndBytes, and GGUF on Qwen2.5-Coder and CodeLlama. Besides pass@1, it measures maintainability, reliability, security, and structural complexity, and characterizes prompt complexity using Shannon entropy and token length.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use multilingual McEval and CoderEval for Python and Java. The abstract reports meaningful differences among quantization methods in correctness and robustness, but does not provide model sizes, bit-width details, or exact degradation numbers.

recommendation.zh: 看结论表即可：它不是预训练论文，但能提醒代码模型量化评测别只报 pass@1。
