recommendation.en: Read the result tables only: not a pretraining paper, but a useful warning that code-model quantization should not be judged by pass@1 alone.

paper.title: ExaGEMM: Exploration Framework for CPU-Driven ML Inference via Associative In-Register Computing for Low-Bit GEMM
paper.abstract: Low-bit GEMM is increasingly central to efficient ML inference, yet very-low-bit execution remains a poor fit for conventional CPUs. Practical deployment spans fragmented regimes-from 1/2/4-bit weights to varying activation precision-whose feasibility, reuse opportunity, and support cost differ under fixed SIMD and register-file budgets, making lightweight CPU support selection a first-class design problem. We present ExaGEMM, a workload-aware codesign and exploration framework for CPU-native lo

summary.core_problem: 解决低比特 GEMM 在通用 CPU 上难以高效执行的问题，尤其是 1/2/4-bit 权重与不同激活精度组合下的设计空间选择。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率与硬件协同设计工作。对做 LLM serving、量化部署和低比特内核的人有参考价值，但对预训练方法论本身帮助有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ExaGEMM，一个面向 CPU 原生低比特 GEMM 的探索框架。核心思路是利用现有 SIMD 数据通路完成查表生成与累加，只增加轻量级 in-register select/feed 机制；再用解析模型联合搜索 kernel 参数、寄存器可行性、计算成本、内存流量和 ISA 支持开销，并在仿真前大幅剪枝候选空间。
summary.experiments: 摘要称可在仿真前剪掉 99.2% 候选，并找到不同 workload 下的非支配设计点。没有看到与 LLM 端到端推理吞吐、延迟或主流 serving 系统的直接对接结果，因此更像硬件探索工具而非可立即落地的 LLM 优化方案。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the difficulty of executing very low-bit GEMM efficiently on general-purpose CPUs, especially across mixed regimes of 1/2/4-bit weights and varying activation precision.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency and hardware co-design paper. It is relevant to people working on LLM serving, quantization, and low-bit kernels, but only indirectly useful for pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes ExaGEMM, a framework for exploring CPU-native low-bit GEMM. The key idea is to reuse existing SIMD datapaths for LUT generation and accumulation, adding only a lightweight in-register select/feed mechanism, then jointly search kernel parameters, register feasibility, compute cost, memory traffic, and ISA support overhead using analytical models.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims 99.2% pruning of the candidate space before simulation and identification of Pareto-optimal design points across workloads. It does not show direct end-to-end LLM serving gains in the abstract, so this reads more like a hardware exploration framework than an immediately actionable LLM optimization recipe.

recommendation.zh: 做低比特 CPU 推理的人可以看建模与剪枝框架；如果你关心的是 pretrain，本篇最多读摘要，别指望方法论迁移。
recommendation.en: Useful if you build low-bit CPU inference kernels; for pretraining researchers, the abstract is enough and there is little methodological transfer.

paper.title: Saturation Makes Quantization Error Additive: A Coverage Model with a Certificate
paper.abstract: Mixed-precision quantization must decide which parts of a model to keep at higher precision. A common premise, shared by sensitivity-based methods such as HAWQ and CoopQ, is that the loss from quantizing a set of layers can be reconstructed from per-layer or pairwise sensitivities measured in isolation. We test this premise at the 4-bit weight-and-activation precisions now being deployed, treating the change in loss $f(S)$ from quantizing a layer set $S$ as a set function on the Boolean cube and

summary.core_problem: 混合精度量化中逐层敏感度能否线性叠加来预测多层同时量化的损失变化，这一前提缺乏理论与实证验证。
summary.importance: 原理分析类贡献，从集合函数视角刻画量化误差的组合规律，为逐层敏感度方法提供理论背书与修正模型。
summary.technical_approach: 将量化损失变化视为布尔立方体上的集合函数，通过傅里叶基与 Möbius 变换两种基变换分析方差构成，提出 coverage model f(S)=c(1-∏(1-a_i)) 拟合多层量化损失。
summary.experiments: 在 4-bit 权重量化与激活量化配置下测试，发现 85-93% 的损失方差可由单层效应解释；单调变换后的单层项之和对配置排序的错配对数不超过 2%。
summary.authors_note: Joshua Hill，机构信息未明确给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether per-layer quantization sensitivities can be linearly combined to predict the loss of quantizing multiple layers simultaneously remains unvalidated in mixed-precision quantization.
summary_en.importance: Analytical contribution that characterizes the combinatorial behavior of quantization error as a set function, providing theoretical grounding and a corrected model for layer-wise sensitivity methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Treats loss change under quantization as a set function on the Boolean cube, decomposes its variance via Fourier basis and Möbius transform, and proposes a coverage model f(S)=c(1-∏(1-a_i)) to capture multi-layer quantization loss.
summary_en.experiments: Under 4-bit weight-and-activation quantization, 85-93% of loss variance is explained by per-layer effects alone; a monotone transform of summed per-layer terms misorders at most 2% of configuration pairs.
summary_en.authors_note: Joshua Hill; institutional affiliation not specified.

recommendation.zh: 量化误差近似可加的结论对混合精度策略设计有参考，但实验规模偏小，作为方法背景备查即可。
recommendation.en: The near-additivity of quantization error informs mixed-precision policy design, but experiments are small-scaled; useful as background reference only.

paper.title: Decomposing Runtime, Kernel, and Quantization Speedups via a Matched FP16 Intermediate: A Hardware-Conditioned Case Study on Four NVIDIA RTX A5000 GPUs
paper.abstract: Reported serving speedups from quantized kernels typically bundle the weight format, the kernel, and the inference runtime into one number. We present an attribution study on four NVIDIA RTX A5000 GPUs, 24 GiB each, on a single host with NVLink-bridged pairs. A matched intermediate stack that keeps the faster runtime without the quantized kernel splits the full speedup into a runtime part and a kernel and quantization part. Under matched greedy decoding the full stack reaches $2.58\times$ end to

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM推理加速的性能报告通常混合了权重量化、计算内核、推理运行时多层栈的贡献，无法做精确归因，同时张量并行在单卡可容纳模型场景下的收益、多实例路由与张量并行的适用边界也缺乏定量结论。
summary.importance: 推理运行时优化（如分页注意力、连续批处理）对端到端加速的贡献远大于量化内核本身，提示预训练架构设计需适配高效运行时特性；中小模型单卡可容纳场景下张量并行收益有限，为预训练规模选择与并行策略设计提供参考；量化的核心价值更多在容量扩展而非单步吞吐量提升，可指导预训练后部署适配的权衡。
summary.technical_approach: 引入匹配的vLLM-FP16中间栈——保留vLLM的运行时优化但使用FP16内核而非量化内核，将总加速比精确分解为运行时因子与内核+量化因子两部分，两者乘积等于总加速比。在4张RTX A5000（24GB，NVLink桥接成对）硬件上测试8B/70B Llama模型，对比张量并行与多实例路由的性能，并用profiler定位性能瓶颈。
summary.experiments: 加速比分解：宽batch贪心解码下总端到端加速比为2.58×，运行时贡献约占对数总加速的三分之二，3个GQA模型家族中内核+量化部分的最大 pairwise 差异仅1.5%。张量并行收益：单实例跨4卡分片的吞吐量提升远低于翻倍，约80%的性能差距来自分片协调开销而非互联带宽。路由对比：8B模型长输出场景4路张量并行更优，宽batch场景多实例路由更优；70B模型所有场景下2个配对实例均优于1个分片实例。容量方面：INT4可将最大可持续并发提升约4倍。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3章的实验设计（匹配中间栈的分解逻辑）、第4章的核心结果、第5章的机制解释与局限性；预计阅读时间1-1.5小时。关注推理部署的读者可补充阅读附录的profiler分析。

summary_en.core_problem: Reported LLM inference speedups typically conflate contributions from weight quantization, compute kernels, and inference runtime, preventing precise attribution, and there is a lack of quantitative conclusions on tensor parallelism gains for models that fit on a single GPU and the applicability boundary between multi-instance routing and tensor parallelism.
summary_en.importance: Runtime optimizations (e.g., paged attention, continuous batching) contribute far more to end-to-end inference speedup than quantization kernels, indicating that pre-training architecture design should align with efficient runtime features. Tensor parallelism delivers limited gains for small-to-medium models that fit on single GPUs, providing reference for pre-training scale selection and parallel strategy design. Quantization delivers primarily capacity expansion rather than per-step throughput gain, guiding tradeoffs in post-pretraining deployment adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces a matched vLLM-FP16 intermediate stack that retains vLLM's runtime optimizations but uses FP16 kernels instead of quantized kernels, enabling exact multiplicative decomposition of total speedup into a runtime factor and a kernel+quantization factor, whose product equals the total speedup by construction. Tests 8B and 70B Llama models on 4 NVIDIA RTX A5000 GPUs (24GB each, NVLink-bridged in pairs), compares performance of tensor parallelism and multi-instance routing, and uses profiler traces to locate performance bottlenecks.
summary_en.experiments: Speedup decomposition: total end-to-end speedup of 2.58× at wide batch with greedy decoding, with runtime contributing roughly two thirds of total log speedup; maximum pairwise spread in kernel+quantization gain is just 1.5% across 3 GQA model families. Tensor parallelism gain: sharding a single instance across 4 GPUs delivers throughput improvement well below 2×, with ~80% of the performance gap coming from shard coordination overhead rather than interconnect bandwidth. Routing comparison: for the 8B model, 4-way tensor parallel wins on long-output workloads while multi-instance routing wins on wide-batch workloads; for the 70B model, two paired instances outperform one sharded instance across all workloads. Capacity: INT4 extends maximum sustainable concurrency by ~4×.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 3 for experimental design (decomposition logic via matched intermediate stack), Chapter 4 for core results, and Chapter 5 for mechanistic explanations and limitations. Estimated reading time: 1–1.5 hours. Readers focused on inference deployment can add profiler analysis in the appendix.

recommendation.zh: Nvidia 官方下场教你算账：量化宣称的 2.5 倍加速里，其实 2/3 是换了更快的 runtime 带来的，纯量化 kernel 的收益被高估了，做 Serving 优化的必读。
recommendation.en: Nvidia officially clarifies the math: in a claimed 2.5x quantization speedup, 2/3 actually comes from a faster runtime, suggesting pure quantized kernel gains are often overestimated; a must-read for serving optimization.

paper.title: Reliability Scaling Laws for Quantized Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Quantization is a powerful strategy to build capable and resource-efficient large language models (LLMs) by reducing the bitwidth of the parameters. While quantized LLMs achieve state-of-the-art performance on unperturbed inputs using standard predictive metrics, their performance on perturbed inputs, measured using reliability metrics, remains underexplored, despite its importance for reliable deployment. To address this gap, we first conduct a comprehensive reliability evaluation of quantized

summary.core_problem: 量化 LLM 在标准评测集上表现良好，但在面对包含微小扰动（如拼写错误、语法错误）的输入时，其可靠性（不确定性估计、校准度和鲁棒性）如何变化，以及如何选择最佳量化位宽以平衡效率和可靠性。
summary.importance: 揭示了 LLM 量化中的一个重要盲区：准确率随模型总比特数单调增加，但可靠性却呈现非单调趋势。这为实际部署中选择量化策略提供了新的视角，指出单纯追求高精度或大模型并非总是最佳选择。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了一个包含三个维度的可靠性评估框架：预测不确定性、校准度（不确定性估计的准确性）以及对 15 种保持语义的输入扰动（字符级和词级）的鲁棒性。在 1B 到 70B 参数规模的模型上，系统评估了 6 种主流的量化方法（2、3、4、8 bit）。
summary.experiments: 发现 4-bit 量化在不同任务、模型架构和量化方法中，提供了可靠性与效率的最佳折中。中等规模的 4-bit 模型在可靠性指标上甚至优于更大规模的低比特模型或更小规模的高比特模型。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注图 1 中准确率与可靠性随总比特数变化的趋势对比。泛读即可，了解 4-bit 量化在可靠性上的优势结论。

summary_en.core_problem: While quantized LLMs perform well on standard benchmarks, how does their reliability (uncertainty estimation, calibration, and robustness) change when facing inputs with minor perturbations (e.g., typos, grammatical errors), and how to choose the optimal quantization bit-width to balance efficiency and reliability.
summary_en.importance: Reveals a critical blind spot in LLM quantization: accuracy increases monotonically with the total number of model bits, but reliability exhibits a non-monotonic trend. This provides a new perspective for selecting quantization strategies in practical deployment, indicating that simply pursuing high precision or large models is not always the best choice.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a reliability evaluation framework comprising three dimensions: predictive uncertainty, calibration (accuracy of uncertainty estimates), and robustness to 15 types of semantically-preserving input perturbations (character-level and word-level). Systematically evaluates 6 mainstream quantization methods (2, 3, 4, 8 bits) on models ranging from 1B to 70B parameters.
summary_en.experiments: Finds that 4-bit quantization offers the best trade-off between reliability and efficiency across different tasks, model architectures, and quantization methods. Moderately-sized 4-bit models even outperform larger low-bit models or smaller high-bit models in reliability metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the trend comparison between accuracy and reliability with respect to the total number of bits in Figure 1. Skim to understand the conclusion regarding the advantages of 4-bit quantization in reliability.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reliability-vs-bitwidth/scale 的图；它不改预训练 recipe，但会影响模型发布时的量化验收标准。
recommendation.en: Skim the reliability-versus-bitwidth/scale plots; it will not change pretraining recipes, but it can change release-time quantization acceptance tests.

paper.title: Silent Failures in Quantized LLM Reasoning: A Taxonomy-Based Analysis of Hollow Convergence and Failure Mode Shifts
paper.abstract: We show that post-training quantization can silently alter how large language models reason even when task accuracy is preserved. Using a six-category failure taxonomy validated by two independent human annotators (Cohen's $κ$ = 0.906), we classify 30,000 chain-of-thought outputs from five instruction-tuned LLMs (3B--14B parameters) across three quantization precisions (FP32, FP16, NF4) and four reasoning benchmarks. We find that while accuracy is robust across precisions (maximum 3.1 pp drop),

summary.core_problem: 后训练量化是否只影响精度，而不改变模型的推理过程与失败模式。
summary.importance: 贡献属于机制分析与评测框架：它不发明新量化方法，而是指出“精度几乎不掉”并不等于“推理行为不变”，这对量化模型的可信部署和训练后分析都有直接意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了一个六类推理失败 taxonomy，并由两位人工标注者验证一致性；随后分析 5 个 3B-14B instruction-tuned 模型在 FP32、FP16、NF4 三种精度下、四个推理 benchmark 上的 3 万条 CoT 输出，比较正确率之外的失败类型分布，重点观察 Hollow Convergence、Shortcut Collapse、Confidence Drift 等行为变化。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 5 个模型、3 种精度、4 个 benchmark、30,000 条 CoT。总体准确率在量化后最多下降 3.1 个百分点，但 NF4 下失败模式显著漂移：小模型的 Hollow Convergence 明显下降，而 12B 及以上模型基本不变；GSM8K 几乎不受影响，LogiQA 和 ARC-Challenge 变化最大；LLaMA 3.2-3B 在 NF4 下 Shortcut Collapse 在错误样本中的占比从 44% 升到 78%。
summary.authors_note: University of Maryland, College Park。未见可确认的头部基座团队作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether post-training quantization merely preserves task accuracy or also changes the internal reasoning behavior and failure modes of LLMs.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-and-evaluation contribution rather than a new quantization method. Its value is in showing that near-constant accuracy does not imply stable reasoning behavior, which matters for trustworthy deployment and for interpreting post-training interventions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define a six-category reasoning-failure taxonomy, validate it with two human annotators, and analyze 30,000 chain-of-thought outputs from five 3B-14B instruction-tuned LLMs under FP32, FP16, and NF4 across four reasoning benchmarks. They compare not just accuracy but shifts in failure-type distributions, focusing on Hollow Convergence, Shortcut Collapse, and related categories.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 5 models, 3 precisions, 4 benchmarks, and 30k CoT traces. Accuracy drops by at most 3.1 points after quantization, yet failure modes shift substantially under NF4: Hollow Convergence drops sharply for smaller models but stays stable at 12B+, GSM8K is largely unaffected, while LogiQA and ARC-Challenge show the largest shifts. In LLaMA 3.2-3B, Shortcut Collapse rises from 44% to 78% of wrong-answer failures under NF4.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Maryland, College Park. No clearly identifiable major foundation-model lab authors from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改算法，但它提醒你别再拿 accuracy 当量化安全证书；读 taxonomy 和按模型尺寸分层的结果，足够改掉不少评测习惯。
recommendation.en: No new quantizer here, but it usefully breaks the habit of treating flat accuracy as proof of unchanged reasoning; read the taxonomy and the size-stratified NF4 results.

paper.title: Signed Symmetric Quantization for Few-Bit Integers
paper.abstract: The signed integer alphabet contains one more negative representable value than positive. Yet, by convention, the standard symmetric integer quantizer fixes its scale to be strictly positive, which assigns this extra representable value to the negative tail and can force clipping of positive outliers. In this work, we show that, at few-bit precision, such clipping is a non-trivial source of quantization error. Asymmetric quantization addresses this problem with a zero point, shifting the grid to

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很具体但被长期忽略的量化细节：标准 signed 对称量化使用的整数码本并不真正对称，负侧比正侧多一个可表示值；而业界习惯又把 scale 固定为正数，于是这个“多出来的格点”永远分配给负尾部，导致正向 outlier 更容易被裁剪。高 bit 下这件事常被噪声淹没，但在 2-bit、4-bit 这类 few-bit 场景里，正尾裁剪会成为显著误差来源。论文要解决的问题不是重新发明 asymmetric quantization，而是在不引入 zero-point 运行时开销的前提下，尽量拿回 asymmetric grid 的端点对齐收益。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在部署和低比特训练后压缩接口，而不是预训练算法本身。它的重要性来自两个层面。第一，这是一个很“工程真实”的观察：很多量化论文把 symmetric quantization 当成理所当然的 baseline，但这个 baseline 其实带着一个约定俗成的偏置。把这个偏置修正后，低比特性能能明显改善。第二，它给出了一种很便宜的改法：不改 kernel 路径，不加 zero-point metadata，只允许 scale 取负号。对于 llama.cpp、GGUF 这类强调推理吞吐和内存的系统，这种改法有现实价值。量级上，它不是范式变化，而是一个小改动换来低 bit 明显收益的工作，尤其适合 2-bit/4-bit 权重量化场景。
summary.technical_approach:
核心方法叫 signed symmetric quantization。标准对称量化在 signed q-bit alphabet 上取 z=0，并用正的 absmax scale。作者指出，既然码本本身是 {-2^(q-1), ..., 2^(q-1)-1}，那就天然有一个额外的负值格点；如果允许 scale 带符号，那么翻转 scale 的符号，就等于把这个额外格点从“保护负尾”切换成“保护正尾”。这样做仍然保持 z=0，因此部署路径仍是对称量化，不需要像 asymmetric quantization 那样在 kernel 中处理 offset，也不需要额外存 zero-point。

关键创新不只是“让 scale 可为负”，而是给出一个闭式、data-free、metadata-free 的 sign selection rule。直觉上，规则是让额外的可表示端点去对齐数据中更占主导的 outlier 方向，从而减少最坏情况下的裁剪误差。论文进一步给出理论分析：证明 worst-case ℓ2 误差界，并说明所提 sign rule 在该误差界下具有条件最优性；还证明了“scale 符号翻转”在解析上等价于“同一 signed alphabet 上做一个单位 zero-point shift”。这个等价性很重要，因为它说明该方法拿到的是一种受限的 asymmetric alignment，但运行时仍保留 symmetric deployment profile。

从系统角度看，这个方法之所以成立，是因为很多实际格式本来就把 scale 存成 signed real value；在这种情况下，额外成本几乎为零。作者还在 llama.cpp / GGUF 风格格式上实现了对应的 2-bit、4-bit 方案，用来验证它确实不是纸面技巧。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 Llama3、Qwen3、Qwen3.5 等模型家族，重点看 few-bit 权重量化下的 perplexity、few-shot accuracy recovery，以及实际部署吞吐/内存。最醒目的数字来自 Llama3 8B 的 2-bit 结果：WikiText2 perplexity 从标准正 scale 对称量化的 103.1 降到 17.8，few-shot accuracy recovery 提升 7.9 个百分点。这说明在极低 bit 下，正负尾端点分配并不是边角问题，而会主导误差。

与 asymmetric quantization 的对比也很关键。作者在 AMD EPYC Turin CPU 上测得，4-bit 对称格式相较对应的 asymmetric 格式，内存可少 9%，prefill 吞吐可高到 2.21×，decode 吞吐约 2.03×；在摘要里还给出 2-bit/整体对比的一组数字：signed symmetric 相比 asymmetric 仍保留 1.24× prefill、1.08× decode 和 14% 内存优势。也就是说，这个方法的目标不是在精度上全面超过 asymmetric，而是在保留对称部署优势的同时，尽量逼近 asymmetric 的端点对齐收益。

如果看全文，建议特别关注不同 bit-width 下收益如何变化。论文的主结论很明确：bit 越低，这个修正越重要；bit 较高时，收益会缩小，因为量化误差不再主要由单侧裁剪主导。另一个值得注意的点是，作者不仅给了 perplexity，也给了 few-shot accuracy recovery，这让结果更接近真实 LLM 使用场景，而不只是语言建模指标。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合快速精读。先看 Introduction，作者把问题讲得很清楚：signed alphabet 的不对称性 + 正 scale 约定，如何在低 bit 下变成系统误差。然后直接看 Section 3 的方法定义，理解 signed symmetric quantization 到底改了什么、没改什么。接着看理论部分的两个结论：一个是 worst-case ℓ2 误差界与 sign rule 的关系，另一个是 scale sign flip 与 unit zero-point shift 的等价性。最后看 Table 1 和主结果表，分别对应部署代价与精度收益。

如果你更关心工程实现，优先看 llama.cpp / GGUF 相关格式说明和 Table 1；如果更关心方法是否站得住，优先看 Theorem 4.3、Corollary 4.4、Theorem 4.6。整篇不长，30 分钟左右可以读完主线。值得深挖的点是：这种“利用码本原生不对称性”的思路，是否还能推广到 activation quantization、group-wise mixed precision，或者训练时量化感知设置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a small but consequential flaw in standard signed symmetric quantization. The signed q-bit integer alphabet is not actually symmetric: it contains one more negative representable value than positive. In practice, however, symmetric quantization conventionally forces the scale to be strictly positive, so the extra endpoint is always assigned to the negative tail. At high precision this is often negligible, but at 2-bit and 4-bit it can cause substantial clipping of positive outliers and become a dominant source of error. The paper asks whether one can recover some of the endpoint-alignment benefit of asymmetric quantization without paying the runtime and metadata cost of a zero point.
summary_en.importance: The relevance is mainly on the deployment and compression side rather than pretraining itself, but it is a useful reminder that common quantization baselines can hide arbitrary conventions. Here, a seemingly innocuous sign convention materially hurts low-bit performance. The proposed fix is attractive because it is operationally cheap: no kernel-path change, no zero-point metadata, and no loss of the symmetric inference profile. For systems such as llama.cpp and GGUF-style formats, where memory and throughput matter as much as accuracy, this is a practical contribution. It is not a new quantization paradigm, but it is a high-leverage correction for very low-bit weight quantization.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is called signed symmetric quantization. Standard symmetric quantization uses a signed alphabet with z = 0 and a positive absmax scale. The authors observe that because the alphabet is inherently skewed by one extra negative value, allowing the scale to take either sign effectively lets that extra endpoint protect either the negative tail or the positive tail. Flipping the sign of the scale does not introduce a zero point, so the deployed format remains symmetric and avoids the offset-handling overhead of asymmetric quantization.

The main contribution is not merely allowing negative scales, but providing a closed-form sign selection rule that is data-free in deployment and metadata-free when scales are already stored as signed real values. Intuitively, the rule aligns the extra representable endpoint with the dominant outlier direction, reducing clipping-driven error. The paper also provides theory: a worst-case l2 error bound, conditional bound-optimality of the proposed sign rule, and an analytical equivalence between a scale-sign flip and a unit zero-point shift on the same signed alphabet. That equivalence is important because it clarifies what the method gains: a restricted form of asymmetric alignment while preserving the symmetric deployment path.

From a systems perspective, the proposal is compelling because many real formats already store scales as signed floating-point values. In that setting, the change is nearly free. The authors also implement corresponding 2-bit and 4-bit formats in a llama.cpp/GGUF-style setup to show that the idea survives contact with real inference code.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers model families including Llama3, Qwen3, and Qwen3.5, with metrics spanning WikiText2 perplexity, few-shot accuracy recovery, and actual deployment throughput and memory. The most striking result is on Llama3 8B at 2 bits: WikiText2 perplexity drops from 103.1 under the conventional positive-scale symmetric quantizer to 17.8 with the proposed signed symmetric variant, and few-shot accuracy recovery improves by 7.9 percentage points. That is a large effect for such a small change, and it confirms that endpoint assignment can dominate error in the ultra-low-bit regime.

The comparison to asymmetric quantization is equally important. On an AMD EPYC Turin CPU, the paper reports that a 4-bit symmetric format can use about 9% less memory and achieve around 2.21x higher prefill and 2.03x higher decode throughput than its asymmetric counterpart. The abstract also reports that the proposed signed symmetric method retains a 1.24x prefill advantage, a 1.08x decode advantage, and 14% memory savings over asymmetric quantization while substantially improving over the conventional symmetric baseline. So the goal is not to beat asymmetric quantization on every accuracy metric, but to recover much of its alignment benefit without giving up the symmetric deployment profile.

A useful pattern in the full results is that gains are largest at the lowest bit widths. As precision increases, the benefit shrinks because one-sided clipping is no longer the dominant error source. The inclusion of few-shot accuracy recovery, not just perplexity, also makes the evaluation more relevant to real LLM usage.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a good paper for a fast but careful read. Start with the introduction, which explains the issue clearly: an asymmetric signed alphabet combined with a positive-scale convention creates systematic clipping bias at low bit widths. Then read the method section to see exactly what changes and what stays the same in signed symmetric quantization. After that, inspect the theory: the worst-case l2 error bound, the conditional optimality result for the sign rule, and the theorem showing equivalence to a unit zero-point shift. Finally, look at Table 1 for deployment cost and the main accuracy tables for the practical payoff.

If your focus is systems, prioritize the llama.cpp/GGUF implementation details and the throughput-memory table. If your focus is method validity, prioritize Theorem 4.3, Corollary 4.4, and Theorem 4.6. The main thread can be read in about 30 minutes. A natural follow-up question is whether the same idea can be extended to activation quantization, group-wise mixed precision, or quantization-aware training.

recommendation.zh: few-bit量化的巧妙改进，利用有符号整数的额外bin减少裁剪，做训练后量化的可重点看网格设计部分
recommendation.en: Clever tweak to symmetric quantization leveraging the extra signed integer bin; check the grid design section if working on post-training quantization.

paper.title: The Illusion of Equivalency: Statistical Characterization of Quantization Effects in LLMs
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization is widely used to deploy large language models in resource-constrained settings, yet its evaluation relies almost exclusively on accuracy and perplexity. We show that these metrics fail to capture behavioral changes induced by quantization. We introduce correctness agreement, a decision-level metric that measures overlap in correct predictions between a base model and its quantized variants, independent of absolute accuracy. Across multiple models and quantization sche

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM训练后量化的评估几乎只依赖准确率和困惑度两类指标，但这些指标无法捕捉量化带来的模型行为层面变化——即使量化后模型整体性能看似保持，其在单个样本上的预测决策可能已经发生显著偏离，形成模型功能等价的错觉。
summary.importance: 1）提出决策层面的一致性评估指标，填补了传统量化评估的盲区，说明仅靠整体精度不足以验证压缩后模型的行为保真度；2）从注意力权重分布漂移的角度解释量化影响，为理解低比特量化的失效机制提供了统计层面的分析框架；3）识别出量化的非线性断点，对量化策略选型和模型架构的量化鲁棒性设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 1）将训练后量化建模为作用于模型参数的算子族，系统研究其对注意力投影权重和决策行为的联合影响；2）提出基于统计矩（如峰度）和分布散度的层敏感度分析方法，逐Transformer块量化注意力Q/K/V/O四类投影矩阵在量化前后的结构漂移程度；3）提出正确性一致性（correctness agreement）指标，衡量基础模型与量化变体在正确预测样本集合上的重叠度，独立于绝对准确率，直接反映决策层面的行为一致性；4）在8比特到2比特的宽范围内系统扫描量化配置，覆盖legacy和K-quant两种主流量化方案。
summary.experiments: 1）跨多个模型和量化方案验证，中等程度量化下即使任务级性能看似保持，决策层面的行为分歧已经出现；2）注意力权重的分布漂移随比特数降低呈现非线性演化，存在明确的断点——比特宽度的小幅下降会导致不成比例的结构扭曲，而此时准确率和困惑度可能仍然稳定；3）分离了不同层和架构组件对量化的敏感度差异，识别出LLM中哪些模块对低比特量化更脆弱。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点：第1章引言（问题提出与动机，约10分钟）、第2章方法论（正确性一致性指标定义与层漂移量化方法，约15分钟）、第4章实验（行为分歧与非线性断点的核心发现，约10分钟）；总阅读时间约35-40分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing evaluations of post-training quantization (PTQ) for LLMs rely almost exclusively on accuracy and perplexity, which fail to capture behavioral changes induced by quantization. Models with similar aggregate performance may still diverge substantially on individual example-level predictions, creating an illusion of functional equivalency between base and quantized variants.
summary_en.importance: 1) Introduces a decision-level consistency metric that fills a blind spot in traditional quantization evaluation, showing that overall accuracy alone is insufficient to verify behavioral preservation under model compression. 2) Explains quantization effects from the perspective of attention weight distribution drift, providing a statistical framework for understanding failure modes of low-bit quantization. 3) Identifies non-linear breakpoints in quantization, offering guidance for quantization strategy selection and robust architecture design for quantized deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Models PTQ as a family of operators acting on model parameters, and systematically studies its joint impact on attention projection weights and decision behavior. 2) Proposes a statistical moment- and divergence-based sensitivity analysis that quantifies block-level structural drift of attention Q/K/V/O projection matrices before and after quantization. 3) Introduces correctness agreement, a decision-level metric measuring the overlap of correct prediction sets between a base model and its quantized variants, independent of absolute accuracy, to directly reflect decision-level behavioral alignment. 4) Runs a controlled sweep of quantization configurations from 8-bit to 2-bit, covering both legacy and K-quant schemes.
summary_en.experiments: 1) Across multiple models and quantization schemes, behavioral divergence at the decision level emerges under moderate quantization even when task-level performance appears preserved. 2) Attention weight distribution drift evolves non-linearly with decreasing bit-width, with clear breakpoints where modest bit-width reductions cause disproportionate structural distortion while accuracy and perplexity remain stable. 3) Layer-wise and architecture-dependent sensitivities are isolated, identifying which LLM components are inherently more vulnerable to aggressive low-bit settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on Chapter 1 (problem framing and motivation, ~10 min), Chapter 2 (definition of correctness agreement and layer drift quantification, ~15 min), and Chapter 4 (core findings on behavioral divergence and non-linear breakpoints, ~10 min). Total estimated reading time: 35–40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 别再只盯 accuracy/PPL 做量化回归；把 correctness agreement 加进评测能更早暴露行为漂移，另外 Q/K 更脆弱这个结论值得在自家模型上复核。
recommendation.en: Stop relying on accuracy/PPL for quantization regression: correctness agreement surfaces behavioral drift early, and the “Q/K are more fragile than V/O” claim is worth validating on your own stack.

paper.title: GIFT: Geometry-Informed Low-precision Gradient Communication for LLM Pretraining
paper.abstract: Gradient communication is a primary scaling bottleneck in large language model (LLM) pretraining. Communicating gradients in low-precision formats, such as FP8 and NVFP4, can significantly reduce the communication volume. Existing methods quantize gradients via linear or nonlinear mappings in Euclidean space, often degrading model performance because highly anisotropic gradients incur direction-dependent distortion. We present GIFT, a geometry-informed gradient scaling method that performs low-p

summary.core_problem: 分布式 LLM 预训练中，梯度通信占整体训练时间的比例可达 40%（128 卡 A100 训练 8.3B 模型场景）。使用 FP8 等低精度格式压缩梯度是直接的带宽优化手段，但现有方法在欧氏空间中做线性/非线性量化，会因梯度分布的高度各向异性（不同方向的方差差异大）引入方向相关的失真，导致同步后的更新方向偏离高精度基准，最终损害下游任务性能。同时，多数已有工作同时量化权重、激活、优化器状态，难以单独评估低精度梯度本身的影响，也难以平衡额外计算开销与通信收益。
summary.importance: 这是首个从黎曼几何视角系统诊断低精度梯度量化误差来源的工作，明确指出欧氏空间均匀缩放与各向异性梯度几何之间的不匹配是性能下降的核心原因。方法层面提供了一种不修改优化器、模型结构、训练配方、通信原语和数值格式的纯坐标变换方案，可直接对接 NCCL 2.24 原生 FP8 通信，工程侵入性极低。实践层面给出了“选择性几何变换”的成本-收益折中思路，让 K-FAC 类近似的额外计算开销可被通信收益覆盖，为大规模预训练中 FP8 梯度通信的落地提供了可复现的路径。
summary.technical_approach: 核心思路是在量化前将梯度变换到近似各向同性的坐标系，使 FP8 均匀缩放对不同维度引入的误差量级相当。具体实现分三步：1）误差诊断：通过 Fisher 信息矩阵白化将梯度映射到黎曼流形，验证该空间下梯度分布接近各向同性，量化误差显著低于欧氏空间；2）几何近似：采用 K-FAC 对 Fisher 矩阵做 Kronecker 分解近似，仅用于构造临时通信坐标系，不替换优化器的更新规则（仍使用 Muon 优化器的原生更新）；3）选择性应用：先逐层评估量化敏感度，仅对量化误差敏感的层执行 K-FAC 变换与逆变换，其余层沿用标准逐层欧氏缩放，控制额外计算量。整个流程只改变梯度通信时的坐标表示，不影响优化器状态存储和模型权重精度。
summary.experiments: 基于 Megatron-LM 实现，在 OpenWebText 数据集上预训练 Llama-300M 和 Llama-600M，优化器采用 Muon。误差分析显示，与欧氏逐层缩放的 FP8 基线相比，GIFT 将 FP8 梯度与 FP32 梯度的平均误差降低最多 67.4%。通信体积方面，相对 FP32 梯度减少 75%（对应 FP8 的理论压缩比）。端到端训练速度上，64 张 GH200 超芯片场景下，整体预训练时间较 FP32 减少 7.6%；同规模下直接使用欧氏 FP8 可减少 10.79% 的时间，GIFT 以约 3 个百分点的原始加速比为代价，换来了更好的下游任务性能保留。下游评估中，相同优化器和通信路径下，GIFT 预训练的模型在多数任务上的表现优于欧氏 FP8 基线，更接近 BF16/FP32 基准。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 II 节的误差诊断部分，尤其是梯度各向异性与欧氏量化误差的对应关系推导，以及 Fisher 白化后分布变化的可视化；其次关注选择性 K-FAC 变换的敏感度评估标准和层选择策略，这是控制计算开销的关键；实验部分重点对比 GIFT、欧氏 FP8、FP32 三者的梯度误差-训练时间-下游性能三维权衡，注意区分“通信体积减少”和“端到端加速比”的差异。值得深挖的点包括：该几何变换思路是否可扩展到 NVFP4 等更低精度格式、是否可与 ZeRO 等分片数据并行策略结合、量化敏感度评估是否可在训练前离线完成以进一步降低开销。

summary_en.core_problem: In distributed LLM pretraining, gradient communication can account for up to 40% of total training time (as observed in a 128-A100 setup for an 8.3B GPT-style model). Compressing gradients into low-precision formats such as FP8 directly cuts bandwidth usage, but existing methods perform linear or nonlinear quantization in Euclidean space. Because gradient distributions are highly anisotropic—variances differ drastically across directions—uniform scaling introduces direction-dependent distortion that drifts the synchronized update away from the high-precision reference, degrading downstream performance. Most prior works simultaneously quantize weights, activations, and optimizer states, making it hard to isolate the impact of low-precision gradients alone, or to balance extra compute overhead against communication savings.
summary_en.importance: This work provides the first systematic diagnosis of low-precision gradient quantization error from a Riemannian geometry perspective, identifying the mismatch between anisotropic local gradient geometry and axis-aligned Euclidean scaling as the root cause of performance degradation. The proposed solution is a pure coordinate transformation that leaves the optimizer, model architecture, training recipe, communication collectives, and numerical format untouched, enabling direct integration with NCCL 2.24 native FP8 communication with minimal engineering overhead. The selective geometry-transform strategy further makes K-FAC-style approximation practical, such that the extra compute cost is offset by communication gains. It offers a reproducible path for deploying FP8 gradient communication in large-scale pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core idea is to transform gradients into a near-isotropic coordinate system before quantization, so that uniform FP8 scaling introduces comparable error magnitudes across dimensions. The implementation has three parts: 1) Error diagnosis: Fisher information matrix whitening maps gradients onto a Riemannian manifold where the gradient distribution becomes approximately isotropic, with substantially lower quantization error than in Euclidean space. 2) Geometry approximation: K-FAC is used for Kronecker-factored approximation of the Fisher matrix, but only to construct temporary communication coordinates; the optimizer (Muon) update rule remains unchanged. 3) Selective application: Per-layer quantization sensitivity is first evaluated. K-FAC forward and inverse transforms are applied only to quantization-sensitive layers; all other layers use standard layer-wise Euclidean scaling to keep extra compute bounded. The entire pipeline only alters the coordinate representation during gradient communication and does not affect optimizer state storage or model weight precision.
summary_en.experiments: Implemented in Megatron-LM. Llama-300M and Llama-600M models are pretrained on OpenWebText with the Muon optimizer. Error analysis shows GIFT reduces the average difference between FP8 and FP32 gradients by up to 67.4% compared with a Euclidean layer-wise scaling FP8 baseline. Gradient payload size is reduced by 75% relative to FP32, matching the theoretical FP8 compression ratio. End-to-end, on 64 GH200 superchips, GIFT cuts overall pretraining time by 7.6% over FP32; direct Euclidean FP8 achieves a 10.79% reduction at the same scale, meaning GIFT trades roughly 3 percentage points of raw speedup for better downstream preservation. Under identical optimizer and communication paths, models pretrained with GIFT outperform the Euclidean FP8 baseline on most downstream tasks and stay closer to the BF16/FP32 reference.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus first on Section II's error diagnosis, especially the derivation linking gradient anisotropy to Euclidean quantization error and the visualizations of distribution change after Fisher whitening. Next, study the quantization-sensitivity metric and layer-selection policy for selective K-FAC application—this is the key mechanism that controls compute overhead. In experiments, examine the three-way tradeoff among gradient error, training wall time, and downstream performance across GIFT, Euclidean FP8, and FP32; pay attention to the distinction between communication-volume reduction and end-to-end speedup. Worth investigating further are: whether the geometry-transform framework extends to lower-precision formats like NVFP4, whether it composes with sharded data parallelism such as ZeRO, and whether quantization-sensitivity evaluation can be done offline before training to further reduce runtime overhead.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看方法和实验规模；若大模型结果扎实，GIFT 是低精度梯度通信里少见的低侵入改动。
recommendation.en: Read the method and scale details first; if the large-model results hold, GIFT is a rare low-intrusion fix for low-precision gradient communication.

paper.title: Quantize the Target, Quantize the Drafter: Efficient Inference with Qwen3.5-4B
paper.abstract: This report describes our approach to the Efficient Qwen Competition, where the goal is to enable low-latency serving of Qwen3.5-4B on a resource-constrained NVIDIA A10G GPU. Our system combines a quantized target model with speculative decoding. To recover accuracy, we apply quantization-aware distillation to the target model while retaining the original quantization grid. To speed up decoding, a block-diffusion drafter specialized for the quantized target model is trained using a two-stage pro

summary.core_problem: 在资源受限的单卡 NVIDIA A10G（24GB VRAM）上部署 Qwen3.5-4B 时，需要同时满足低延迟推理与严格的质量阈值约束；现有单独使用量化或推测解码的方案，难以在目标模型精度、草稿模型接受率、端到端延迟三者之间取得平衡，尤其是量化后的目标模型分布偏移会破坏草稿模型的对齐。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于：后训练量化与蒸馏、推测解码草稿模型的训练、目标-草稿的分布对齐是一个联合优化问题，不能割裂处理；两阶段草稿训练（先对齐高精度目标、再适配低精度目标）的思路可迁移到其他“目标模型发生分布偏移后需要重训辅助模块”的场景，例如持续预训练后重训推测解码草稿、重训检索增强的适配器等。
summary.technical_approach: 整体方案由量化目标模型与适配的推测解码系统两部分组成。目标模型侧：从现成的 AWQ INT4 PTQ 检查点出发，使用原始 BF16 模型作为教师，执行固定量化网格的量化感知蒸馏（QAD），通过前向 KL 做逐 token 蒸馏，权重更新后重新舍入回原 AWQ 尺度的 INT4 网格，最终以 W4A16 格式部署。推测解码侧：训练基于 DFlash 的块扩散草稿模型，利用目标模型多层隐藏状态作为条件，单次前向预测多个未来 token；采用两阶段训练，第一阶段用 BF16 目标模型及其生成的数据训练草稿，第二阶段用 QAD 后的量化目标模型及其生成的数据微调，解决量化导致的分布偏移。进一步对草稿模型做 GPTQ INT4 量化，并引入滑动窗口注意力（SWA）降低长上下文下的注意力开销，同时提升草稿接受长度。
summary.experiments: 该方案在 Efficient Qwen 竞赛中排名第 3（共 40+ 队伍）。端到端平均加速比达 6.978×：短输入（64/128 token）从 2582ms 降至 232ms，中等输入（2048/256）从 5441ms 降至 782ms，长输入（8192/256）从 6576ms 降至 2313ms。质量指标均满足阈值：MMLU-Pro 0.659（阈值 ≥0.621）、IFEval 0.845（阈值 ≥0.814）、GPQA-Diamond 0.667（阈值 ≥0.630）。组件消融显示：INT4 QAD 目标模型单独贡献 2.16× 加速；加入两阶段训练的 BF16 草稿后提升至 3.32×；草稿 INT4 量化后提升至 3.55×；草稿加入 SWA 后提升至 3.57×，其中 SWA 对长输入场景的增益最明显（从 2.49× 提升至 2.81×）。训练数据来自 Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v2 中随机抽取的 22 万样本，经目标模型再生后打包为 16384 长度序列。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点放在方法部分的两阶段草稿训练设计、QAD 的固定量化网格实现细节，以及表 2 的组件消融，理解每个模块对加速比和质量的边际贡献。图 2 的工作流示意图可快速建立整体认知。竞赛设置与主结果表 1 浏览即可，无需深入。预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Deploying Qwen3.5-4B on a resource-constrained single NVIDIA A10G GPU (24 GB VRAM) requires simultaneously meeting strict low-latency targets and quality thresholds. Standalone quantization or speculative decoding fails to balance target-model accuracy, draft-token acceptance rate, and end-to-end latency — in particular, distribution shift introduced by target-model quantization breaks alignment with a separately trained drafter.
summary_en.importance: The key takeaway for pretraining research is that post-training quantization/distillation, speculative-decoding drafter training, and target-drafter distribution alignment must be treated as a joint optimization problem rather than isolated steps. The two-stage drafter training recipe — first aligning to a high-precision target, then adapting to a low-precision shifted target — generalizes to other settings where auxiliary modules must be retrained after target-model distribution shifts, such as drafter refresh after continual pretraining or adapter adaptation for retrieval-augmented systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system combines a quantized target model with an adapted speculative decoding pipeline. On the target side, an existing AWQ INT4 post-training quantization checkpoint is used as initialization; quantization-aware distillation (QAD) is applied with the original BF16 model as teacher, minimizing per-token forward KL divergence while keeping the AWQ per-group quantization scales frozen. Updated BF16 weights are rounded back to the original INT4 grid at packing time, and the final model is served in W4A16 format. On the speculative decoding side, a lightweight DFlash-style block-diffusion drafter is trained on top of the frozen target, using multi-layer hidden states from the target as conditioning to predict multiple future tokens in one forward pass. A two-stage pipeline is used: Stage 1 trains the drafter from scratch against the BF16 target and its regenerated data; Stage 2 fine-tunes the drafter against the QAD quantized target and its regenerated data to absorb quantization-induced distribution shift. The drafter is further compressed with GPTQ INT4 post-training quantization and equipped with sliding-window attention to reduce long-context compute and improve acceptance length.
summary_en.experiments: The submission ranked 3rd out of 40+ teams in the Efficient Qwen Competition. End-to-end average speedup reaches 6.978× over the unoptimized baseline: short inputs (64/128 tokens) drop from 2582ms to 232ms, medium inputs (2048/256) from 5441ms to 782ms, and long inputs (8192/256) from 6576ms to 2313ms. All quality thresholds are satisfied: MMLU-Pro 0.659 (threshold ≥0.621), IFEval 0.845 (threshold ≥0.814), GPQA-Diamond 0.667 (threshold ≥0.630). Component ablation shows the INT4 QAD target alone delivers 2.16× speedup; adding the two-stage BF16 drafter raises it to 3.32×; INT4 quantization of the drafter brings it to 3.55×; sliding-window attention on the drafter reaches 3.57×, with the largest gains on long-context inputs (from 2.49× to 2.81×). Training data is regenerated by the target model from 220K randomly sampled examples from Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v2, packed into 16,384-token sequences.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim pass, focus on the two-stage drafter training design, the fixed-grid QAD implementation details, and the component ablation table to understand the marginal contribution of each module to speedup and quality. The workflow diagram gives a quick overview of the full pipeline. The competition setup and main results table can be browsed lightly. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是会改写你对预训练的 prior，但把“量化 target + 量化 drafter + 两阶段适配”串成可落地 recipe，做 serving 的人该看实验分解。
recommendation.en: It will not change your pretraining priors, but the recipe of quantizing both target and drafter with two-stage adaptation is practical; read the ablations, not the hype.

paper.title: Variable Bit-width Quantization: Learning Per-Group Precision for "Bigger-but-Smaller" Language Models
paper.abstract: Low-bit quantization shrinks language models but treats precision as a single global hyper-parameter: every weight uses the same bit-width. We introduce Variable Bit-width Quantization (VBQ), a training-time method in which each contiguous group of 64 weights learns its own resolution from {1,2,4,8} bits via a Gumbel-Softmax relaxation, trained jointly by an alternating optimization that gives the precision logits a clean, task-aligned signal. VBQ discovers a consistent, strongly heterogeneous a

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是：低比特量化通常把整个模型或整层绑定到统一 bit-width，但真实模型里不同权重组对精度的敏感性差异很大，固定分配会浪费预算，也限制了“更大参数量但更小存储”的设计空间。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发不在于单个量化技巧，而在于它把 bit allocation 变成可学习对象，而不是部署阶段的手工格式选择。更重要的是，作者给出一个很强的经验结论：如果模型从训练开始就原生适应异构低比特表示，那么平均约 1.8 bit 的权重预算也能支撑比均匀 4-bit 更好的质量/容量折中。这对低成本预训练、量化感知训练、以及“参数量扩张换精度缩减”的 scaling 设计都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 VBQ。它把每 64 个连续权重作为一个 group，为每组学习一个离散 bit-width，候选集合是 {1,2,4,8}。bit 选择通过 Gumbel-Softmax 松弛成可微形式，与模型权重联合训练。难点在于，如果直接端到端优化，任务损失经量化器传回的梯度会远大于 bit-budget 正则，precision logits 基本不会动，最后 bit 分配停在初始化附近。

作者用了两个关键设计。第一是 gradient isolation：在计算 bit-selection 路径时，对重构权重做 detach，阻断交叉熵损失直接更新 precision logits，只让 logits 主要接收与 bit 选择相关的干净信号。第二是 alternating optimization：交替进行权重更新步和精度分配更新步，类似把“学表示”和“学资源分配”拆开。实验显示这样 precision logits 才会真正收敛到离散决策，而不是停留在软分布。

另一个重要发现是，训练出来的分配模式很快稳定，约在训练前 20% 就基本锁定。于是作者进一步把搜索结果蒸馏成固定 recipe：例如大部分 block 用统一 2-bit，首个 FFN block 保留 4-bit，LM head 按词频分层分配更高精度。也就是说，Gumbel 学习主要用于发现结构，最终部署不一定需要保留复杂的自适应机制。
summary.experiments:
核心结果有三类。第一，学到的 bit 分配高度异构，而且异构性发生在层内、甚至同类投影内部，而不只是“某些层高精度、某些层低精度”。整体上 69% 的 group 收敛到 1-bit，平均 bit-width 约 1.78。LM head 平均约 1.09 bit，但高频词相关部分会保留更高精度。

第二，作者强调 bigger-but-smaller。一个 131M 的 VBQ 模型，平均 1.82 bit、总大小 29MB，能在 perplexity 上超过 55M 的 FP16 模型，而后者大小是 109MB。更大的例子里，1.46B 参数模型用同样 recipe，在 FineWeb-Edu 上可以匹配 593M FP16 control，同时参数量约 2.5× 更大，但总存储预算约 3.7 bit/weight 级别。这里传达的信息是：在固定内存预算下，扩大参数量并原生训练到低比特，可能比训练一个更小的高精度模型更划算。

第三，recipe transfer 是成立的。自适应搜索得到的分配在早期就稳定，冻结成固定量化方案后，效果接近在线学习版。这说明论文的主要贡献不只是一个训练时技巧，也包括发现了可复用的精度分配规律。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和方法部分前半，抓住两个问题：为什么统一 bit-width 不够；为什么 precision logits 会被主任务梯度淹没。然后看训练算法图或伪代码，理解 gradient isolation 和 alternating optimization 如何配合。实验部分优先看三张结果：bit 分配直方图/分层统计、bigger-but-smaller 主表、以及 recipe freeze/transfer 结果。若只想判断是否值得跟进，20 到 30 分钟足够；若关心低比特预训练，可再细看不同模块的敏感性分析，尤其是 LM head、首层 FFN、attention output projection 的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a limitation of standard low-bit quantization: bit-width is usually fixed globally or by coarse heuristics, even though different weight groups have very different sensitivity to precision. That wastes memory budget and limits the design space for models that are larger in parameter count but smaller in storage.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model research is not a single quantization trick, but the shift from hand-designed precision formats to learned bit allocation. More interestingly, the paper argues that if a model is trained natively under heterogeneous low-bit constraints, an average budget around 1.8 bits per weight can support a better quality-size tradeoff than uniform low-bit compression applied after the fact. That has implications for quantization-aware pretraining, memory-constrained scaling, and recipes that trade precision for parameter count.
summary_en.technical_approach:
VBQ assigns each contiguous group of 64 weights a learnable bit-width chosen from {1, 2, 4, 8}. The choice is relaxed with Gumbel-Softmax so it can be optimized jointly with the network. The core optimization problem is that task gradients flowing through the quantizer dominate the bit-budget signal by orders of magnitude, causing the precision logits to stay near initialization.

The paper addresses this with two mechanisms. First, gradient isolation: reconstructed weights are detached along the bit-selection path, preventing the main cross-entropy loss from directly overwhelming the precision logits. Second, alternating optimization: weight updates and precision updates are interleaved, so representation learning and precision allocation are optimized on cleaner timescales. Together, these changes let the bit-selection variables actually commit to discrete allocations.

A notable empirical finding is that the learned allocation stabilizes early, around the first 20% of training. The authors then distill the learned pattern into a fixed recipe, such as mostly 2-bit blocks, a higher-precision first feed-forward block, and a frequency-tiered LM head. This means the adaptive search is useful not only as a deployment method, but also as a way to discover reusable quantization structure.
summary_en.experiments:
There are three main empirical takeaways. First, the learned precision allocation is strongly heterogeneous, and the heterogeneity appears within projection types, not just across layers. About 69% of groups collapse to 1 bit, with an average precision of roughly 1.78 bits. The LM head averages around 1.09 bits, while a minority of more sensitive groups retain 4- or 8-bit precision.

Second, the paper makes a bigger-but-smaller argument. A 131M model at 1.82 bits on average, occupying 29MB, outperforms a 55M FP16 model that occupies 109MB. At a larger scale, a 1.46B model using the same recipe matches a 593M FP16 control on FineWeb-Edu while using a storage budget in the roughly 3.7 bits-per-weight regime. The practical message is that, under a fixed memory budget, training a larger model natively at low precision can be better than training a smaller high-precision model.

Third, recipe transfer works. Since the learned bit assignments stabilize early, freezing them into a fixed quantization recipe reproduces most of the adaptive method’s gains. That suggests the paper contributes both an optimization method and a structural observation about where precision matters in decoder-only LMs.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick pass, read the introduction and the first half of the method section. Focus on two questions: why uniform bit-width is too restrictive, and why precision logits fail under naive end-to-end optimization. Then inspect the training algorithm or pseudocode to understand how gradient isolation and alternating optimization interact.

In the experiments, prioritize the allocation histograms or per-module precision statistics, the main bigger-but-smaller comparison table, and the recipe-freezing results. Those are enough to judge whether the method is only a search procedure or whether it reveals a reusable low-bit training recipe. A 20 to 30 minute read is enough for triage. If low-bit pretraining is your main interest, spend extra time on the sensitivity analysis for the LM head, the first FFN block, and attention output projections.

recommendation.zh: 位宽分配的稳定规律有参考价值，只看§4的权重分组位宽分布统计即可，方法本身对超大模型的可扩展性待验证
recommendation.en: Stable bit-width allocation patterns are informative; only read §4 per-group precision statistics, method scalability to very large models remains unproven

paper.title: Lynx: Progressive Speculative Quantization for accelerating KV Transfer in Long-Context Inference
paper.abstract: Long-context inference is increasingly common in large language model (LLM) serving, driven by retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems. In disaggregated inference, these workloads require transferring large Key-Value (KV) caches across the network, where decoding cannot begin until the transfer completes. Recent KV quantization techniques reduce data volume and alleviate this bottleneck, but existing schemes fail to achieve both low network-exposed latency and high inference accuracy.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文、分离式推理里的一个具体瓶颈：Prefill 端生成的 KV cache 需要跨网络传给 Decode 端，而 Decode 往往必须等整份 KV 到齐后才能开始。上下文一长，KV 体积线性增长，网络传输就会直接暴露在首 token 延迟里。已有 KV 量化方法虽然能缩小传输量，但通常在两点之间做艰难取舍：要么压得狠、延迟低，但注意力误差变大，生成质量掉得明显；要么保守量化，精度较稳，但 TTFT 改善有限。Lynx 试图打破的不是单纯“如何把 KV 压得更小”，而是“KV 是否必须作为一个不可分割的整体被完整接收后才能使用”这个系统假设。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是预训练方法论文，但对大模型系统设计有直接启发，尤其是长上下文 serving、PD-disaggregation、远程 KV 检索这类越来越常见的部署形态。它的重要性在于把 KV 量化从“静态压缩问题”改成了“分层信息传输 + 可验证近似推理”的联合问题：先传最关键的高位信息，让模型尽早开始 decode，再在后台补齐低位残差，并用 speculative verification 保证最终采样分布与全精度一致。这种思路对后续很多系统问题都有参考价值，比如分阶段状态传输、分辨率渐进式上下文恢复、以及把近似计算包进可校验框架里。对做训练的人，启发主要在于：模型内部状态并不是所有 bit 同等重要，系统层可以利用这种不均匀性，而不必把张量视作刚性对象。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三部分组成。第一部分是 Hierarchical Split-Stream Quantization。作者把 KV 不是压成单一路径的低比特表示，而是显式拆成 Anchor 和 Residual 两条流。Anchor 保留高价值、粗粒度的信息，用来尽快恢复一个可用但不完全精确的 KV；Residual 再补充细节，逐步逼近原始状态。这里的关键不是简单高低位切分，而是结合非线性对数量化和 outlier-aware chunking，尽量在固定 bit budget 下保住 attention 输出分布。对数量化适合处理 KV 中动态范围不均的问题；outlier-aware chunking 则避免少数极端值把整块量化尺度拉坏。

第二部分是 Split-Stream Pipelining Architecture。系统层面，Lynx 让网络优先发送 Anchor 流，Decode 端在只拿到部分 KV 状态时就启动计算，而 Residual 在后台继续传输和反序列化。这里需要自定义的序列化/反序列化协议和 non-blocking runtime，避免传统“收齐—解压—装载—再算”的串行路径。论文强调的不只是网络传输时间，还包括 deserialize 和把 KV 装入 paged device memory 的开销，因此它把通信和运行时一起做了设计。

第三部分是 Speculative Decoding Verification。因为基于 Anchor 的早期 decode 仍然是近似的，作者借用 speculative decoding 的验证机制：先用部分信息生成候选 token，再用完整或更精确状态验证。如果候选通过验证，最终输出分布与未量化全精度模型一致；如果不通过，则回退。这个设计很关键，因为它把“快但近似”的系统优化包进了一个有形式保证的采样框架里，避免只追求平均精度而牺牲分布一致性。

和已有 KV quantization 方法相比，Lynx 的区别主要有三点。第一，已有方法多把 KV 当成一次性压缩、一次性恢复的对象，Lynx 则把它视作可渐进恢复的状态。第二，已有方法通常只优化压缩率和重建误差，Lynx 直接优化网络暴露延迟。第三，已有方法的精度退化往往是不可逆的，而 Lynx 通过 verification 把最终生成质量拉回到与全精度一致的目标上。
summary.experiments:
论文给出的代表性结果是：在长上下文、带宽受限的分离式推理场景下，Lynx 达到接近 INT4 级别的 KV 传输延迟，同时保持接近 INT8 或 BF16 的推理精度。相对 INT8 baseline，TTFT 最多降低 30.5%，Time-to-32nd-Token 最多降低 10.7%；相对 CacheGen，推理准确率最多高 5.1%。这些收益在更长上下文和更低带宽下更明显，这和方法设计是对齐的，因为此时网络传输更容易成为主瓶颈。

文中还给了一个很直观的规模例子：Qwen3-235B-A22B 在 128k context 下，单请求可产生约 23.5 GB 的 BF16 KV 数据；在 100Gbps 网络上，仅传输就大约需要 2 秒。这说明问题不是边角优化，而是会直接决定分离式推理是否成立。Figure 2 的时间分解也说明，除了纯网络时间，deserialize 和 KV 装载本身也是不可忽略的延迟来源，因此只做压缩算法而不改 runtime，收益会被吃掉。

从实验解读上，最值得注意的不是单个 benchmark 分数，而是三类对比：一是与 INT8/BF16 的精度-延迟折中，说明 Anchor/Residual 设计确实把“快”和“准”拆开了；二是与 CacheGen 这类已有 KV 压缩方法的对比，说明渐进式传输比单次压缩更适合 PD-disaggregation；三是不同上下文长度、不同带宽下的趋势，验证了它不是只在某个甜点配置上有效。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：先看引言和 Figure 2，抓住问题定义——瓶颈不是算力，而是 KV 传输暴露在 decode 启动路径上。然后看方法部分里关于 Anchor/Residual 的定义、量化方式和 pipeline 设计，理解作者为什么不把 KV 当成一个整体。再看 speculative verification 的描述，确认它如何保证最终分布不偏。最后看实验里不同带宽、不同上下文长度的曲线和与 CacheGen、INT8 baseline 的对比。

如果时间有限，优先看三处：1）KV 体积和传输时间的量级估算；2）Split-Stream Quantization 的实现细节，尤其是对数量化和 outlier 处理；3）验证协议如何把近似 decode 变成可接受的系统优化。预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主要贡献；若要复现或迁移到自家 serving 栈，需要细读 runtime、SerDes 和验证流程。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete bottleneck in long-context disaggregated inference: KV caches produced by the prefill worker must be transferred over the network to the decode worker, and decoding typically cannot start until the full KV state arrives. Since KV size grows linearly with context length, network transfer becomes directly exposed in TTFT. Existing KV quantization methods reduce payload size, but they usually trade latency against generation quality: aggressive compression lowers transfer time but hurts attention fidelity, while conservative quantization preserves accuracy but leaves much of the latency untouched. Lynx questions a deeper systems assumption: the KV cache does not have to be treated as an indivisible object that must be fully received before it becomes usable.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model systems, especially for long-context serving, prefill-decode disaggregation, and remote KV retrieval. Its main contribution is to reframe KV quantization from a static compression problem into a joint problem of hierarchical information transfer and verifiable approximate decoding. The system sends the most important bits first, starts decoding early from a coarse KV state, and fills in the residual information in the background, while speculative verification preserves equivalence to full-precision sampling. That design pattern is useful beyond this specific setting: staged state transfer, progressive context reconstruction, and wrapping approximate computation inside a correctness-preserving verification loop are all broadly applicable ideas. For researchers closer to training, the useful takeaway is that internal model states are not uniformly important at the bit level, and systems can exploit that non-uniformity instead of treating tensors as rigid blobs.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components. First, Hierarchical Split-Stream Quantization. Instead of producing a single low-bit representation of the KV cache, Lynx explicitly decomposes KV into two streams: Anchors and Residuals. Anchors carry the coarse but high-value information needed to reconstruct a usable KV state quickly; Residuals refine that state toward the original representation. This is not just a naive MSB/LSB split. The paper combines non-linear logarithmic quantization with outlier-aware chunking to minimize reconstruction error under a constrained bit budget while preserving the downstream attention-output distribution. Logarithmic quantization helps with the uneven dynamic range of KV values, and outlier-aware chunking prevents a few extreme values from corrupting the scale of an entire chunk.

Second, Split-Stream Pipelining Architecture. At the systems level, Lynx prioritizes Anchor transmission so the decode worker can begin computation from a partial KV state, while Residuals continue to transfer and deserialize in the background. This requires a custom serialization/deserialization protocol and a non-blocking serving runtime, because the conventional path of receive-then-decompress-then-load-then-compute would erase much of the benefit. The paper explicitly accounts not only for network time but also for deserialization overhead and loading serialized KV into paged device memory.

Third, Speculative Decoding Verification. Since early decoding from Anchors is approximate, Lynx uses a verification protocol inspired by speculative decoding: candidate tokens are generated from the partial state and then checked against a more accurate or complete state. If accepted, the resulting token distribution matches that of the unquantized full-precision model; otherwise the system falls back. This is the key mechanism that turns a fast-but-approximate systems trick into one with formal distributional guarantees.

Relative to prior KV quantization work, Lynx differs in three ways. It treats KV as progressively recoverable state rather than a one-shot compressed object. It optimizes network-exposed latency rather than only compression ratio or reconstruction error. And instead of accepting irreversible quality loss, it uses verification to recover equivalence to the full-precision model at the sampling level.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline result is that under long-context, bandwidth-constrained disaggregated inference, Lynx achieves roughly INT4-level KV transfer latency while maintaining inference accuracy close to INT8 or BF16. Compared with an INT8 baseline, it reduces TTFT by up to 30.5% and Time-to-32nd-Token by up to 10.7%. Compared with CacheGen, it improves inference accuracy by up to 5.1%. The gains become larger at longer context lengths and lower available bandwidth, which is exactly where KV transfer dominates the critical path.

The paper also gives a useful scale example: for Qwen3-235B-A22B at 128K context, a single request can produce about 23.5 GB of BF16 KV data. On a 100 Gbps interconnect, transfer alone takes roughly 2 seconds. That makes the problem operationally significant rather than marginal. Figure 2 is also important because it shows that deserialization and loading serialized KV into paged device memory are non-trivial contributors to latency, so compression alone is not enough without runtime co-design.

The most informative experimental comparisons are not just the final benchmark numbers, but three trends: the latency-accuracy tradeoff against INT8/BF16 baselines, showing that Anchor/Residual separation decouples early usability from final fidelity; the comparison against prior KV compression methods such as CacheGen, showing that progressive transfer is better aligned with PD-disaggregation; and the scaling behavior across context lengths and bandwidth regimes, showing that the method is not confined to a narrow sweet spot.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction and Figure 2 to understand the problem framing: the bottleneck is not compute, but KV transfer sitting directly on the decode start path. Then read the method sections defining Anchors and Residuals, the quantization design, and the split-stream pipeline. After that, inspect the speculative verification section carefully, because that is where the paper justifies distributional equivalence rather than just approximate quality preservation. Finally, look at the experiments across bandwidths and context lengths, especially the comparisons with CacheGen and the INT8 baseline.

If time is limited, focus on three parts: (1) the order-of-magnitude estimates for KV size and transfer time, (2) the implementation details of split-stream quantization, especially logarithmic quantization and outlier handling, and (3) the verification protocol that makes approximate early decoding acceptable. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. A deeper read is only needed if you want to reproduce the runtime, integrate it into a serving stack, or reason about the exact correctness guarantees.

recommendation.zh: 渐进式 KV 传输的思路对长上下文 serving 系统设计有启发，重点看 §3 的比特位重要性分析和系统架构部分。
recommendation.en: The progressive KV transfer idea is insightful for long-context serving design; focus on §3 for bit-level importance analysis and system architecture.

paper.title: OrbitQuant: Data-Agnostic Quantization for Image and Video Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) achieve state-of-the-art image and video generation, but their multi-step sampling and growing parameter count make inference expensive. Post-training quantization (PTQ) is the natural remedy, yet DiT activations shift across timesteps, prompts, and guidance branches, forcing prior methods to re-fit calibration data for every new checkpoint or modality. We present OrbitQuant, a data-agnostic weight-activation quantizer that bypasses range estimation by quantizing in

summary.core_problem: OrbitQuant 解决的是 DiT 推理中的低比特权重-激活量化问题，重点是不依赖校准数据。DiT 的激活分布会随 denoising timestep、prompt、classifier-free guidance 分支变化，传统 PTQ 依赖一次校准捕获激活范围的假设在这里不稳。论文的目标是在图像和视频扩散 Transformer 上，用统一的量化规则覆盖不同时间步、提示词和层输入，而不是为每个 checkpoint、分辨率或模态重新收集校准集。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值主要在推理效率和量化方法，对 LLM 预训练本身是间接启发。关键点不是又做一个 DiT PTQ recipe，而是把激活量化从“估计动态 range”改成“构造固定边缘分布后的码本量化”。这种分布归一化思路对 LLM/VLM/DiT 这类分布漂移明显的模型有参考意义，尤其适合思考校准数据不可靠、部署场景变化快时的量化策略。它也提醒一点：DiT 推理与 LLM decoding 的瓶颈不同，DiT 单 batch 下仍偏 compute-bound，因此 weight-only quantization 很难带来实测速度收益，必须同时量化 activation 才能减少计算。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 normalized rotation + Lloyd–Max codebook。对输入激活向量先保留 L2 norm，再归一化到单位球面，然后施加随机正交旋转。理论上，Haar 随机旋转后的每个坐标服从只由维度决定的固定边缘分布；当维度大于约 64 时，可近似为 N(0, 1/d)。这样量化不再依赖当前 prompt 或 timestep 的激活范围，而是提前为每个输入维度和 bit-width 计算一个 MSE 最优的 Lloyd–Max 标量码本。论文将这一思想工程化为 RPBH rotation，即 randomized permuted block-Hadamard rotation。Hadamard 结构降低旋转开销，随机 permutation 用来避免低比特下坐标分布过差。权重量化也放到同一个旋转基中处理：旋转可以离线折叠进 weight rows，使得权重和激活在共享基下量化，线性层内部旋转相互抵消，推理时只需要保留必要的前向旋转与查表反量化。相较 SmoothQuant 这类把 activation outlier 平滑到权重里的方法，OrbitQuant 不试图拟合每层的激活尺度；相较常规 DiT PTQ，它避免为不同时间步和分支单独校准。
summary.experiments: 论文在图像和视频 DiT 上评估，指标包括 GenEval 和 VBench。摘要与引言给出的结论是：在无校准数据条件下，OrbitQuant 的 PTQ 质量优于已有校准式或范围估计式方法；在 W2A4 设置下，已有 PTQ baseline 会退化到接近噪声，而 OrbitQuant 仍能生成可用图像。给出的全文片段没有包含完整实验表，因此无法确认具体分数、模型规模、采样步数、速度收益和各消融的数值。可以确定的消融方向包括：Haar/近似旋转与 RPBH 的替代关系、随机 permutation 对低 bit activation 的影响、weight-only 与 weight-activation 联合量化的差异、不同 bit-width 下的质量退化曲线。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25 分钟。先看 Introduction，重点理解为什么 DiT 的量化难点不同于 LLM：激活随 timestep、prompt 和 CFG branch 漂移，且推理更偏 compute-bound。然后看 Preliminaries 中 TurboQuant 的固定边缘分布推导，尤其是归一化后随机旋转使坐标分布只依赖维度这一点。方法部分应重点看 RPBH rotation 如何替代 Haar rotation、权重旋转如何离线折叠、码本如何按维度和 bit-width 共享。实验部分建议直接看 W2A4、W4A4 等低比特结果，以及有无 calibration 的对照。若关注 LLM/VLM serving，可深挖它对校准数据依赖的处理方式，而不是只看 DiT 生成质量。

summary_en.core_problem: OrbitQuant addresses low-bit weight-activation post-training quantization for diffusion transformers without calibration data. The central issue is that DiT activations drift across denoising timesteps, prompts, and classifier-free guidance branches. A single calibration pass, which is often acceptable for LLM PTQ, does not provide stable activation ranges for this setting.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is inference efficiency rather than pretraining. The useful idea is to replace range estimation with a distributional quantization view: transform normalized activations into a basis where each coordinate follows a known marginal distribution, then use a fixed Lloyd–Max codebook. This is a useful design pattern for models with strong activation drift, including multimodal transformers and diffusion backbones. The paper also makes a practical point: DiT inference is more compute-bound than LLM decoding, so weight-only quantization is unlikely to give meaningful speedups; activation quantization is needed to reduce arithmetic cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method normalizes each activation vector by its L2 norm, applies a randomized orthogonal rotation, and quantizes the rotated coordinates with an offline Lloyd–Max scalar codebook. Under a Haar-random rotation, each coordinate of a normalized vector has a fixed dimension-dependent marginal, well approximated by N(0, 1/d) for moderate dimensions. OrbitQuant implements this idea with a randomized permuted block-Hadamard rotation, which is cheaper than a dense random orthogonal matrix and empirically keeps low-bit coordinates well behaved. The same rotated basis is used for weights: rotations can be folded into weight rows offline, so weights and activations are quantized in a shared basis and the linear-layer computation remains consistent. Unlike SmoothQuant-style methods, it does not rely on calibrated activation scales; unlike many DiT PTQ methods, it does not refit ranges for each timestep, prompt, checkpoint, or modality.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates image and video DiTs using GenEval and VBench. The provided text reports that OrbitQuant works without calibration data and remains usable at W2A4, while prior PTQ baselines collapse to noisy generations in that regime. The supplied full-content excerpt does not include the detailed result tables, so exact model sizes, metric values, latency gains, and ablation numbers cannot be verified here. The key experimental checks to look for are low-bit W2A4 and W4A4 quality, calibration-free versus calibration-based comparisons, the effect of the random permutation in RPBH, and weight-only versus weight-activation quantization.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take about 25 minutes. Start with the introduction to understand why DiT PTQ is different from LLM PTQ: drifting activations and compute-bound inference. Then read the preliminaries on TurboQuant, especially the fixed marginal distribution after normalizing and rotating a vector. In the method section, focus on RPBH rotation, offline folding of rotations into weights, and the construction of dimension-specific Lloyd–Max codebooks. In the experiments, prioritize the lowest-bit settings and calibration-free comparisons. For LLM or VLM serving researchers, the most transferable part is the calibration-free distributional quantization design.

recommendation.zh: 将 Hadamard 旋转量化（类似 QuIP）成功应用到 DiT 上，解决了 DiT 激活值动态变化带来的校准难题，做 DiT 推理优化的值得看其旋转矩阵的设计。
recommendation.en: Successfully applies Hadamard rotation quantization (similar to QuIP) to DiTs, solving the calibration challenge caused by dynamic activation shifts; worth reading for DiT inference optimization.

paper.title: Beyond Activation Alignment:The Alignment-Diversity Tradeoff in Task-Aware LLM Quantization
paper.abstract: Mixed-precision quantization (MPQ) has become a key technique for deploying large language models under stringent memory and compute constraints. We first identify a phenomenon that we term the Perplexity Illusion: layers ranked as important by perplexity-based sensitivity show little rank correlation with those that are most influential for complex reasoning performance, with Kendall $τ\approx 0$ in our analysis. We further reveal an Alignment-Diversity Tradeoff: using only target-task calibrat

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM后训练混合精度量化流程默认采用两个未在现代LLM上验证的假设：一是困惑度（PPL）可以作为所有下游能力层敏感度的可靠代理，二是仅用通用域或仅用目标任务域校准数据就足以完成准确的敏感度度量。两个假设在面向推理任务的部署场景下均不成立，且朴素的任务对齐校准反而会降低量化后性能。
summary.importance: 两个核心观察修正了任务感知量化中常见的流程设计偏差：一是基于PPL的层敏感度排序和推理能力的敏感度排序几乎不相关，说明PPL作为能力代理指标在层粒度上存在系统性偏差；二是纯任务校准数据虽然激活对齐度高，但会导致表征坍缩，混合通用域数据才能稳定敏感度估计。这两点既指导实际量化部署——平均3.5bit精度即可达到传统4bit均匀量化性能，压缩率提升12.5%，也为理解LLM内部分层功能提供了量化证据：输入/输出层主要支撑流畅token预测，中间层承载多步组合推理，对模型结构设计、剪枝策略、预训练评估指标选择都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 通过逐层量化扰动实验验证了两个核心现象：1）困惑度错觉（Perplexity Illusion）：PPL测量得到的敏感层集中在输入嵌入层和输出投影层，而数学、科学推理任务对应的敏感层位于网络中间块，二者排序的Kendall τ≈0，统计上无相关性；2）对齐-多样性权衡（Alignment-Diversity Tradeoff）：仅用目标任务数据做校准时，校准用的Hessian矩阵估计方差大，容易引发表征坍缩；混入一定比例通用域数据可以正则化敏感度估计，保护模型的泛化流形，但混合比例随模型和任务变化，不存在固定通用的最优值。在此基础上提出TASA双层混合精度框架：数据层面用免训练的梯度迹对齐搜索，确定通用域和任务域校准数据的最优混合比，仅需|A|+1次前向传播，额外成本极低；网络层面提出多目标聚合（MOA）指标，融合PPL和推理任务的敏感度信号，将层间比特分配建模为背包结构的整数线性规划问题，用动态规划求精确解，层内再通过二阶显著性做分组粒度的精度调整。
summary.experiments: 在LLaMA-3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B两个模型上测试，覆盖推理、常识、语言建模共8个基准。LLaMA-3-8B上，平均3.5bit精度的TASA模型对齐多个4bit均匀量化基线的总性能，比特消耗减少12.5%，保留FP16模型总精度的97.2%；Qwen2.5-7B上，3.75bit的TASA模型保留FP16性能的99.1%。数学推理任务上提升明显，GSM8K上比均匀3bit基线高20个点以上。消融实验验证了单独使用PPL指标、或单独使用任务校准数据都会带来明显性能下降，最优混合比不存在通用固定值。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第3节两个现象的实证证据，尤其是不同能力对应的层敏感度分布对比，以及校准数据混合的消融结果，这两部分对理解模型内部能力分布最有价值。TASA的框架设计可以快速浏览，不需要深究比特分配的动态规划求解细节。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Post-training mixed-precision quantization (MPQ) pipelines for LLMs operate on two unvalidated assumptions for modern models deployed on reasoning tasks: that perplexity (PPL) is a reliable proxy for per-layer sensitivity across all downstream capabilities, and that calibration data drawn solely from either the general domain or the target task domain is sufficient for accurate sensitivity estimation. Both assumptions fail in practice, and naive task-aligned calibration often reduces post-quantization performance.
summary_en.importance: Two core observations correct common biases in task-aware quantization design. First, PPL-based layer sensitivity rankings have near-zero correlation with sensitivity for complex reasoning, showing that PPL is a systematically biased proxy for capability at layer granularity. Second, pure task-specific calibration causes representation collapse despite better activation alignment, while mixing in general-domain data stabilizes sensitivity estimates. Beyond practical deployment gains — 3.5-bit average precision matching standard 4-bit quantization with 12.5% lower bit cost — these results provide quantitative evidence for LLM functional specialization: input/output layers primarily support fluent token prediction, while middle layers carry multi-step compositional reasoning. This is relevant to model architecture design, pruning strategies, and pre-training evaluation metric selection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Systematic layer-wise quantization perturbation experiments first validate two core phenomena: (1) The Perplexity Illusion: PPL-sensitive layers concentrate at input embeddings and output projections, while reasoning-critical layers lie in the middle network blocks, with a Kendall τ ≈ 0 rank correlation between the two orderings. (2) The Alignment-Diversity Tradeoff: exclusive task-domain calibration produces high-variance Hessian estimates and representation collapse, while mixing in general-domain data regularizes sensitivity estimation to protect the generalization manifold, though the optimal mixing ratio varies across models and tasks with no universal heuristic. The proposed TASA framework operates on two levels: at the data level, a training-free gradient trace alignment search finds the optimal general/task calibration data ratio in |A|+1 forward passes with negligible overhead. At the network level, a Multi-Objective Aggregation metric fuses PPL and reasoning sensitivity signals; inter-layer bit allocation is formulated as a knapsack integer linear program solved exactly via dynamic programming, with intra-layer bit refinement via second-order saliency-based group assignment.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations are run on LLaMA-3-8B and Qwen2.5-7B across 8 benchmarks spanning reasoning, commonsense, and language modeling. On LLaMA-3-8B, 3.5-bit average precision matches multiple 4-bit uniform quantization baselines with 12.5% fewer bits, retaining 97.2% of FP16 aggregate accuracy. On Qwen2.5-7B, 3.75-bit TASA retains 99.1% of FP16 performance. Gains are particularly large on mathematical reasoning, with over 20 points improvement over uniform 3-bit baselines on GSM8K. Ablations confirm that using PPL alone or pure task calibration both cause significant performance drops, with no fixed universally optimal mixing ratio.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for empirical evidence of the two core phenomena, especially the layer sensitivity distribution across capabilities and calibration data mixing ablations — these are the most transferable insights for understanding LLM internal organization. Skim the TASA framework design; the dynamic programming solver details for bit allocation are not necessary unless implementing MPQ systems. Expected reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Perplexity Illusion的发现很有启发性——量化时只看perplexity会误导，对做训练后量化的研究员有直接参考，重点看§3的现象分析。
recommendation.en: The Perplexity Illusion finding is insightful—relying solely on perplexity for quantization can be misleading; directly useful for researchers working on post-training quantization; focus on §3 phenomenon analysis.

paper.title: GSRQ: Gain-Shape Residual Quantization for Sub-1-bit KV Cache
paper.abstract: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) with extended context windows is increasingly constrained by the linear growth of Key-Value (KV) cache memory. Vector Quantization (VQ), particularly Residual Quantization (RQ), is a promising approach for pushing KV cache storage toward the sub-1-bit regime by progressively encoding residuals with small codebooks. However, most VQ methods still rely on standard $\ell_2$ $K$-means as the core codebook-learning primitive. We identify a subtle high-di

summary.core_problem: 解决残差量化用于KV缓存压缩时，标准ℓ2 K-means在高维下存在质心收缩、削弱角度对齐、方向保真差的问题，目标是实现亚1位KV缓存。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出改进的K-means变体用于残差量化，提升高维向量量化的方向保真度，为亚1位KV缓存提供新的量化方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Gain-Shape K-means（GSKM）作为标准K-means的直接替代，将质心更新分解为增益（幅度）和形状（方向）两部分，缓解质心收缩问题；在此基础上构建Gain-Shape残差量化（GSRQ），用于KV缓存的亚1位压缩。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整给出实验细节，提到在部分场景下ℓ2失真与标准方法相当甚至更优，方向保真度提升；具体模型参数量、基线、下游任务效果未在摘要中体现。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses centroid shrinkage and poor directional fidelity of standard ℓ2 K-means in high-dimensional residual quantization for KV cache compression, targeting sub-1-bit KV cache storage.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing an improved K-means variant for residual quantization that enhances directional fidelity of high-dimensional vector quantization, enabling a new sub-1-bit KV cache quantization scheme.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Gain-Shape K-means (GSKM) as a drop-in replacement for standard K-means, decomposing centroid updates into gain (magnitude) and shape (direction) components to mitigate centroid shrinkage; builds Gain-Shape Residual Quantization (GSRQ) on top for sub-1-bit KV cache compression.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not provide full experimental details; notes ℓ2 distortion matches or improves on standard methods in some regimes, with better directional fidelity. Model size, baselines, and downstream performance are not specified.

recommendation.zh: 亚1位KV量化的增量改进，gain-shape分解思路可作为量化感知预训练的参考，看摘要和方法核心部分即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement for sub-1-bit KV quantization; the gain-shape decomposition idea is a minor reference for quantization-aware pretraining, read abstract and core method section only.

paper.title: RaBitQCache: Rotated Binary Quantization for KVCache in Long Context LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Long-context Large Language Model inference is severely bottlenecked by the massive Key-Value (KV) cache, yet existing sparse attention methods often suffer from static fixed-budget (Top-k) retrieval or rely on proxy scores that are computationally expensive and biased. To address these limitations, we propose RaBitQCache, a novel sparse attention framework that utilizes randomized rotated binary quantization and high-throughput binary-INT4 arithmetic to efficiently estimate attention weights. O

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文推理里的 KV cache 访问瓶颈。问题不只是显存大，而是每一步解码都要在巨大的历史 KV 上做选择和读取。已有 sparse attention / KV offloading 方法通常依赖固定预算的 Top-k 检索，或者依赖近似但偏差较大的 proxy score 来估计注意力重要性。前者不够自适应，后者既不够准，也缺少误差保证，因此很难安全地做 Top-p 这类按真实注意力质量自适应分配预算的检索。作者要解决的核心问题是：能否构造一个足够便宜、足够准、还有理论误差界的注意力代理分数，用它在不访问完整 KV cache 的前提下做动态稀疏检索。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于 efficient inference，而不是预训练本身，但对大模型系统研究有现实价值。它的重要性主要在两个层面。第一，方法上它把 KV 选择问题明确地写成高维向量相似度估计问题，并借助 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 视角构造了带理论界的 proxy score，这比很多经验型 sparse attention 方法更扎实。第二，系统上它不是只给一个近似公式，而是把二值化、INT4 查询、异步流水和 lazy update 一起做成了可运行方案。对基座研究员来说，直接启发不在建模，而在于：长上下文能力的上限越来越受 memory movement 和 retrieval policy 约束，未来训练和推理可能需要更统一地考虑“哪些历史 token 值得被精确保留”。
summary.technical_approach:
方法名是 RaBitQCache，核心思想是把 Key 的高维浮点向量映射成随机旋转后的二值码，再用一个极轻量的二值-低比特算术近似 query-key 内积，从而估计注意力权重。具体分成几个层次。

第一层是表示压缩。在 prefill 阶段，作者对 Key 向量做随机旋转，然后映射到单位超立方体顶点，也就是得到 binary code。随机旋转的作用是让原始空间中的几何关系在低成本表示里尽量保真，避免直接按坐标符号切分带来的偏置。这个设计明显受 JL lemma 和相关近似近邻检索方法启发。

第二层是 proxy score 构造。在 decoding 阶段，不再直接用全精度 query 与所有 key 做内积，而是把 Query 做 INT4 量化，再与二值化 Key 进行高吞吐计算，得到一个对真实 attention score 的无偏估计。论文强调两点：一，这个估计器是 unbiased；二，它有严格的误差界。前者意味着估计值不会系统性高估或低估某类 token，后者意味着不仅能做相对排序，还能对分数大小本身有一定可信度，这正是支持 Top-p 检索的关键。

第三层是检索策略。不同于固定 Top-k，RaBitQCache 用估计到的注意力质量做 adaptive Top-p retrieval。因为不同层、不同头、不同任务的注意力稀疏度差异很大，固定 k 往往要么取多了浪费算力，要么取少了伤精度。Top-p 更接近“保留足够多的重要质量”，理论上更适合异质的注意力分布，但前提就是 proxy score 必须能近似真实权重幅值，而不只是给个粗排序。

第四层是系统实现。作者实现了硬件感知的 kernel 和调度，包括异步流水线以及 lazy updates，用来隐藏二值检索和数据搬运的额外开销。这个部分很关键，因为很多 sparse/offloading 方法算法上省 FLOPs，系统上却被 gather/scatter 和 CPU-GPU 传输拖垮。RaBitQCache 试图把“近似检索”真正做成吞吐友好的路径。

和 Quest、DS 这类方法相比，区别主要在三点：检索粒度更细，不是整页粗选；proxy score 更接近真实内积，不是部分维度或启发式统计；支持自适应 Top-p，而不是被迫固定预算。
summary.experiments:
从引言和方法描述看，作者做的是长上下文推理加速实验，并声称显著优于现有 sparse attention / KV offloading 方法。虽然给出的片段没有完整主表数字，但正文明确强调了几个结果方向。第一，在不访问完整 KV cache 的前提下，RaBitQCache 能在保持模型性能基本稳定的同时提升长上下文推理效率。第二，相比现有方法，它的优势来自更准确的 token 重要性估计，因此在相同预算下精度损失更小，或者在相近精度下可进一步减少检索 token 数。第三，系统优化后，额外的代理分数计算和调度开销被较好掩蔽，否则算法收益很难兑现成端到端 latency 改善。

如果通读全文，建议重点抓几类实验。其一，proxy score 与真实 attention score 的相关性或误差分析，这是方法成立的根。其二，Top-k 与 Top-p 的对比，尤其是在不同层、不同头、不同任务上的预算自适应效果。其三，和 Quest、DS、静态位置选择等基线的端到端 latency、吞吐、显存/带宽占用比较。其四，消融随机旋转、二值码长度、INT4 量化精度、lazy update 和异步流水各自贡献。真正有说服力的结果通常不是单一 speedup，而是 accuracy-latency 曲线整体外移。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议 25 到 35 分钟。先看引言里对现有动态 KV 检索两类缺陷的归纳：proxy 不准，以及没有误差界。这两点决定了作者为什么坚持做带理论保证的估计器。然后直接看方法部分中 proxy score 的定义与定理，确认无偏性和误差界到底针对的是 query-key 内积、attention logits，还是归一化后的权重。接着看系统实现图，判断异步流水和 lazy update 是否只是工程补丁，还是和算法设计强耦合。最后看主实验和消融，重点关注 accuracy-latency tradeoff，而不是只看单点加速比。

如果只想快速判断价值，优先读三处：理论部分的主命题、Top-p 检索实验、端到端系统性能表。若要深挖，可以继续追两个问题：一，随机旋转和二值化在不同层的分布漂移下是否稳定；二，这种 proxy 是否能迁移到训练时的 memory compression 或检索增强注意力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the main bottleneck in long-context decoding: not just the size of the KV cache, but the cost of repeatedly selecting and reading from a very large history. Existing sparse-attention and KV-offloading methods usually rely on either fixed-budget Top-k retrieval or cheap but biased proxy scores for token importance. Fixed Top-k is not adaptive enough, while weak proxies are often inaccurate and lack error guarantees, which makes adaptive Top-p retrieval hard to trust. The core question here is whether one can build a proxy score that is cheap, accurate, and theoretically controlled, so that dynamic sparse retrieval can be done without touching the full KV cache.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model systems work. Its main value is twofold. First, it formulates KV selection as a high-dimensional similarity estimation problem and brings in a Johnson-Lindenstrauss-style perspective to construct a proxy with explicit guarantees. That is methodologically stronger than many heuristic sparse-attention designs. Second, it does not stop at the estimator: it also builds a hardware-aware implementation around binary keys, INT4 queries, asynchronous pipelining, and lazy updates.
