A key observation is zero-ratio collapse: when group scales are learned parameters, optimization can increase the scale, widen the zero region, push more weights to zero, and reduce capacity in a positive feedback loop. Recomputing absmean scales at every forward pass provides a stabilizing feedback and keeps sparsity around 26%.
summary_en.experiments: The main run trains for 50k steps on C4 with sequence length 1024, totaling about 102M tokens, on a single H100 for roughly 4 hours. The compressed model reduces storage from 2687 MB to 744 MB, a 3.61x reduction. It reaches 48.1% average zero-shot accuracy over seven tasks, close to Bi-Mamba's 48.4%; the 0.3 percentage-point difference is within the reported approximate ±0.9pp confidence interval. On C4, perplexity increases by 4.20 relative to the FP16 model, about a 24% gap. The WikiText-2 gap is larger and attributed partly to domain mismatch. Naive ternary PTQ gives perplexity around 13 million, effectively unusable, which supports the need for QAT. Multi-seed runs show low variance: about 0.01 standard deviation in C4 perplexity and ±0.13pp in the seven-task average. Extending training to 307M tokens keeps improving C4 perplexity without a visible plateau. The log-token trend suggests further gains, but the extrapolation is based on only four points. Group-size ablations show only about 0.06 PPL range, indicating that the ternary constraint, not scale granularity, is the main bottleneck.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim should cover the Method section, the zero-ratio collapse analysis, and the main comparison tables. The most important implementation details are which Mamba modules are quantized, why SSM dynamics stay FP16, and why non-learned absmean scales are used. The experimental section is worth reading for the PTQ failure case, the QAT cost accounting, and the scaling curve up to 307M tokens. Plan for 25–35 minutes. Readers aiming to reproduce or extend the result should inspect the optimizer schedule, distillation loss, group-size sweep, and layer-selective ablations.

recommendation.zh: QAT-from-pretrained比从头训便宜1000x的结论有实际工程价值，zero-ratio collapse和SSM不适合后处理校正这两点值得注意。只看§3和§4.2
recommendation.en: 1000x token reduction via QAT-from-pretrained is practically useful; zero-ratio collapse and SSM incompatibility with post-hoc correction are notable. Read §3 and §4.2 only

paper.title: Gefen: Optimized Stochastic Optimizer
paper.abstract: AdamW is a default optimizer for modern deep learning, but its first and second moment states add roughly two parameter-sized buffers to training memory. We propose Gefen, a memory-efficient optimizer that automatically shares second-moment estimates across parameter blocks and quantizes the first moment using a learned codebook, thereby reducing AdamW's memory footprint by ~8x while maintaining the same performance, corresponding to a reduction of 6.5 GiB per billion parameters. The method is m

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很实际、也很卡大模型训练上限的问题：AdamW 的优化器状态太占显存。标准 AdamW 需要为每个参数额外维护一阶矩 m 和二阶矩 v，两者合起来大约是 2× 参数量级的额外内存。在百亿到千亿参数训练里，这部分开销会直接挤压 batch size、序列长度、激活重计算策略和并行切分空间。已有路线主要有两类：一类是像 Adam-mini 那样按人工规则共享二阶矩，另一类是对优化器状态做量化。但前者依赖架构先验和张量命名，泛化性差；后者通常用手工 codebook 或 block-wise 量化，存在额外超参和失真控制问题。Gefen 要解决的是：在不依赖人工分组规则的前提下，自动找到适合共享二阶矩的参数块，并进一步压缩一阶矩状态，把 AdamW 的状态内存显著降下来，同时尽量保持 AdamW 级别的收敛和最终质量。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义很直接，而且量级不小。它不是单纯做一个“更省内存的工程技巧”，而是在优化器设计里把三件事连起来了：二阶结构的理论解释、自动分组算法、以及可精确求解的一阶矩量化。结果是把 AdamW 的优化器状态内存压到约 1/8，对应每 1B 参数节省约 6.5 GiB。这种量级的节省，在大模型预训练里通常可以换成更大的全局 batch、更长上下文、更少的并行碎片，或者在同样硬件上训练更大的模型。更重要的是，它给“为什么可以共享二阶矩”补上了比经验规则更扎实的解释：高 Hessian 耦合的参数，其平方梯度比值会被约束到更接近 1，因此共享 v 不是纯经验近似，而是有局部曲率上的依据。对做训练 recipe、优化器状态压缩、甚至 ZeRO/分布式内存预算的人，这篇都值得认真看。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两部分。第一部分是二阶矩共享。作者先从一个两层 MLP 的理论分析出发，研究混合 Hessian 项较大时，不同参数的平方梯度何时会接近。结论是：在可行的 Hessian 范围内，混合 Hessian 的绝对值越大，两个参数平方梯度之比允许的区间越收缩到 1 附近。这给出了一个很清楚的设计信号：如果一组参数在 Hessian 上强耦合，那么它们共享 Adam 的二阶矩估计，失真会比较小。问题在于大模型里不能显式算 Hessian，所以 Gefen 不直接估 Hessian，而是用首步梯度 g0 的平方结构做代理。具体做法是：对每个参数张量先展平，对长度 n 的张量枚举其所有 proper divisors p，把 g0^2 reshape 成若干个连续 block，每个 block 大小为 p，然后计算块内异质性指标 E(p)。E(p) 小，说明这个分块下块内平方梯度更相似，适合共享一个二阶矩标量；p 大则共享更激进、更省内存。算法在“更大块、更低异质性”之间做权衡，自动选出分块周期。这里一个有意思的点是，E(p) 不一定随 p 单调变差；某些更大的 divisor 反而更贴合真实结构，比如 attention head 或卷积通道带来的块结构，所以自动搜索比手工按名字切块更稳。

第二部分是一阶矩压缩。Gefen 不是简单做低比特均匀量化，而是复用前面得到的 block partition，对一阶矩 m 做基于可学习 codebook 的量化，并且量化分配通过动态规划精确求解。作者强调两点：一是 codebook 是学习得到的，不是手工固定；二是复用同一套 block 划分，因此不会再引入一个独立的 block-size 超参。整体上，Gefen 可以理解为：v 用共享标量做结构化压缩，m 用 codebook 做离散压缩，两者都围绕同一个自动发现的参数块结构展开。这样设计比单独压 v 或单独量化 m 更完整，也比 Adam-mini 这类依赖架构规则的方法更通用。
summary.experiments:
从文中给出的主结果看，Gefen 的核心结论有三层。第一层是内存：相对 AdamW，优化器状态内存约缩小 8×，作者给出的换算是每 1B 参数节省约 6.5 GiB。这是最硬的结果。第二层是性能保持：在 LLM 和非 LLM 网络上，Gefen 都能维持与 AdamW 可比的训练质量，部分设置下还有小幅收益。引言里明确说它在多种模型和数据集上取得了最低的内存占用，同时质量和吞吐与对比方法相当或更好。第三层是自动分组的有效性：论文不仅给了两层 MLP 的理论，还在附录展示了真实网络张量——包括 attention tensor 和卷积层——中，按自动发现的块结构切分后，平方梯度在块内更一致，这支持了“用首步梯度结构近似 Hessian 耦合”的经验合理性。

和基线的比较重点应当包括 AdamW、Adam-mini，以及量化优化器一类方法。Adam-mini 的问题是需要用户提供架构信息，例如 attention heads 数量，还依赖 tensor name；Gefen 则完全自动。量化优化器的常见问题是手工 codebook 和额外 block-size 超参；Gefen 用 learned codebook 和动态规划避免了这点。文中还强调吞吐没有因为自动分组而明显受损，因为分组只在第一步基于 g0 推断一次，而不是训练中持续重估。精读时建议重点核对实验表里不同模型规模、不同任务上的最终 loss / accuracy / perplexity 差异，以及消融里“只共享 v”“只量化 m”“自动分组 vs 手工分组”的对比，这些最能看出方法是否只是内存换质量，还是确实找到了较优折中。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“理论—算法—实验”三段读。

先看理论分析部分，重点抓住那个核心命题：混合 Hessian 大，平方梯度比值会被压向 1。这里不用过度纠缠证明细节，但要看清假设条件、适用对象，以及作者为什么说这个现象不仅出现在两层 MLP，也能在真实网络张量里观察到。这个部分决定了方法不是拍脑袋做 block sharing。

再看算法部分。需要重点理解三个点：第一，为什么只用第一步梯度 g0 就足够推断共享结构；第二，E(p) 这个异质性指标如何定义、如何在内存和失真之间选 p；第三，一阶矩量化为什么要和同一套 block partition 绑定，以及动态规划在这里精确优化的是什么。如果你关心工程落地，这一节最值得细抠。

实验部分建议优先看主表、内存统计表、吞吐对比和消融。主问题不是“有没有赢一点点指标”，而是“在 8× 状态压缩下，质量掉了多少、吞吐变了多少、适用范围有多广”。如果这些表里 Gefen 在 LLM 预训练设置下和 AdamW 基本打平，而明显优于 Adam-mini 或通用量化优化器，那它的实用价值就成立了。附录里 attention / conv 张量的平方梯度可视化也值得看，这些图能帮助判断自动分组到底是在捕捉真实结构，还是只是偶然拟合首步噪声。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete bottleneck in large-scale training: AdamW’s optimizer states are expensive. Standard AdamW stores both first and second moments, so optimizer memory is roughly 2× parameter memory on top of the weights themselves. At LLM scale, this directly constrains batch size, context length, activation checkpointing choices, and parallelization strategy. Existing memory-saving alternatives are unsatisfactory in different ways. Manual sharing schemes such as Adam-mini rely on architecture-specific heuristics and tensor-name conventions. Quantized optimizers reduce memory, but often depend on hand-crafted codebooks and introduce extra tuning knobs such as quantization block size. Gefen aims to remove these weaknesses at once: automatically discover which parameters can share second-moment statistics, compress first moments as well, and preserve AdamW-like optimization behavior without requiring model-specific rules.
summary_en.importance: This matters for pretraining in a very practical sense. The contribution is not just a lighter optimizer implementation; it connects theory, algorithm design, and systems impact. The reported reduction is about 8× in optimizer-state memory, or roughly 6.5 GiB saved per 1B parameters. At current model scales, that is large enough to change feasible training regimes: larger global batch, longer sequences, fewer memory-driven compromises, or simply larger models on the same hardware budget. The more interesting part is conceptual. The paper gives a principled reason for sharing second moments: if two parameters have strong mixed-Hessian coupling, their squared gradients are constrained to be similar, so sharing v is not merely a heuristic. For researchers working on optimizer design, memory-efficient pretraining, or distributed training budgets, this is a useful piece of work because it turns an empirical trick into a more grounded design pattern.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Gefen has two main components.

The first is shared second-moment estimation. The paper starts from a theoretical analysis on a two-layer MLP and studies when two parameters with a large mixed Hessian entry should also have similar squared-gradient magnitudes. The key result is that, under feasible Hessian bounds, increasing the magnitude of the mixed Hessian contracts the admissible ratio of squared gradients toward 1. This gives a clean design principle: parameters that are strongly coupled in curvature are natural candidates for sharing Adam’s second-moment estimate. Since explicit Hessian computation is intractable in large models, Gefen uses the structure of the first-step squared gradients as a proxy. For each parameter tensor, it flattens the tensor, enumerates proper divisors p of the tensor length n, reshapes g0^2 into consecutive blocks of size p, and computes an intra-block heterogeneity score E(p). Small E(p) means the squared gradients within each block are similar, so replacing element-wise v with one shared scalar per block should incur limited distortion. Larger p gives more aggressive sharing and lower memory, so the method selects p by balancing compression against heterogeneity. An important empirical observation is that E(p) is not necessarily monotonic in p; some larger divisors align better with real structural patterns such as attention heads or channel groups. That is why automatic search can outperform hand-written grouping rules.

The second component is first-moment compression. Instead of using a generic low-bit quantizer, Gefen reuses the same block partition and quantizes the first moment m with a learned codebook. The assignment is solved exactly with dynamic programming. Two design choices matter here. First, the codebook is learned rather than manually specified. Second, reusing the same partition avoids introducing another independent block-size hyperparameter. In effect, Gefen is a joint optimizer-state compression scheme: structured sharing for v and codebook-based quantization for m, both built around an automatically inferred block structure.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical claims are threefold. First, memory: Gefen reduces optimizer-state memory by about 8× relative to AdamW, corresponding to roughly 6.5 GiB saved per 1B parameters. That is the headline systems result. Second, quality retention: across both LLM and non-LLM models, the method maintains performance comparable to AdamW, with some settings showing slight gains. The introduction explicitly states that Gefen achieves the lowest memory footprint among compared methods while keeping quality and throughput comparable or better. Third, the automatic grouping mechanism appears to capture real structure rather than arbitrary compression. Beyond the toy theory, the appendix shows similar behavior in real tensors, including attention and convolutional layers, where the discovered partitions produce more homogeneous squared gradients within blocks.

The most relevant baselines are AdamW, Adam-mini, and quantized optimizer variants. Adam-mini reduces memory through manually specified sharing patterns, but requires architecture information such as the number of attention heads and depends on tensor naming. Gefen removes that dependency. Quantized optimizers often rely on hand-crafted codebooks and an extra block-size hyperparameter; Gefen replaces those with a learned codebook and exact dynamic programming. Another practical point is overhead: the grouping pattern is inferred once from the first-step gradient rather than recomputed throughout training, so the method avoids a large recurring cost. When reading the experimental section, the most informative comparisons are final loss or perplexity gaps versus AdamW, throughput changes, and ablations for shared-v only, quantized-m only, and automatic versus manual grouping.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in three passes: theory, algorithm, then experiments.

Start with the theoretical section and focus on the central statement: large mixed-Hessian entries force the ratio of squared gradients toward 1. You do not need every proof detail on the first pass, but it is worth understanding the assumptions, the scope of the result, and why the authors argue that the same phenomenon appears beyond the toy MLP setting. This is the part that justifies block-wise sharing as more than an engineering shortcut.

Then move to the algorithm section. Three details deserve careful attention: why the first-step gradient g0 is sufficient to infer a useful sharing structure; how the heterogeneity metric E(p) is defined and used to trade off distortion against memory; and why first-moment quantization is tied to the same partition, with dynamic programming used for exact assignment. If you care about implementation and recipe design, this is the section to study closely.

For experiments, prioritize the main result tables, memory accounting, throughput comparisons, and ablations. The key question is not whether Gefen wins by a tiny metric margin, but whether it preserves AdamW-level optimization under an 8× state reduction, and whether it does so broadly across model families. The appendix visualizations of squared-gradient structure in attention and convolution tensors are also useful; they help assess whether the automatic partitioning is discovering meaningful structure or merely fitting first-step noise.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看大模型 loss 曲线和 spike 统计；8x optimizer-state 压缩若稳定，训练配额会被重新分配。
recommendation.en: Check the large-model loss curves and spike statistics immediately; stable 8x optimizer-state compression would change training-memory allocation.

paper.title: Multi-Bitwidth Quantization for LLMs Using Additive Codebooks
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across heterogeneous hardware with varying resource constraints, the ability to adaptively manage the trade-off between performance and efficiency without retraining is critical. We propose Drop-by-Drop, a novel multi-bitwidth post-training quantization framework that enables inference-time precision control over LLM weights from a single trained model. Our method is theoretically grounded in information theory and successive refinement.

summary.core_problem: 一次量化训练后如何在不同硬件上运行时任意切换 bitwidth，而无需重新训练或维护多份权重。
summary.importance: 提出多比特位 PTQ 框架，用 additive codebook + Matryoshka 式监督让单个权重表示支持渐进式增加 bit 的连续精度谱，属于部署侧实用方法。
summary.technical_approach: Drop-by-Drop 基于 successive refinement/高斯加权 MSE 视角构造 additive codebook，量化时加 Matryoshka 风格损失，前 k 个 codebook 子集即对应低比特近似、逐本增加就提升精度，从而一次 PTQ 覆盖多档 bitwidth。
summary.experiments: 论文在多个 LLM 上做 PTQ，报告从单模型动态抽出不同 bitwidth 的权重在 perplexity/任务指标上的退化曲线；摘要未给具体模型规模和数字，但定位是 post-training quantization 而非训练侧改动。
summary.authors_note: University of Toronto 团队，作者含 Ashish Khisti，信息论方向研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: How to support runtime-adaptive multi-bitwidth LLM inference from a single post-training quantized model without retraining separate copies per precision.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a PTQ framework producing one model whose additive codebooks can be partially evaluated to give multiple bitwidths, useful for heterogeneous deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Drop-by-Drop grounds quantization in successive refinement and Gaussian weighted MSE, uses additive codebooks with Matryoshka-style supervision so the first k codebooks give a k-bit-approximate reconstruction and additional codebooks monotonically improve fidelity.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LLMs across bitwidths extracted from one quantized model, reporting perplexity/task degradation vs bit-budget; precise models and numbers are not in the abstract but scope is PTQ/serving.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Toronto work; includes Ashish Khisti from information theory.

recommendation.zh: 部署向工作，思路是把 Matryoshka 思想搬到 additive codebook PTQ；做 serving 的看，pretrain 视角只当文献留底。
recommendation.en: Serving-oriented PTQ combining Matryoshka ideas with additive codebooks; relevant if you run inference stacks, marginal for pretraining research.

paper.title: Otters++: A Time-to-first-spike Based Energy Efficient Optical Spiking Transformer
paper.abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) are promising for energy-efficient inference, and time-to-first-spike (TTFS) coding is especially attractive because each neuron fires at most once. In practice, however, this benefit is often reduced by the cost of computing a temporal decay term and multiplying it by the synaptic weight. We address this issue by turning a physical hardware "bug," the natural signal decay in optoelectronic devices, into the main computation of TTFS, named Otters++. Specifically, w

summary.core_problem: TTFS 脉冲神经网络理论上节能，但实际部署中时间衰减项和权重乘法的数字计算开销会抵消部分收益。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向 Transformer 的光电 SNN 硬件计算路径和训练方法。它属于推理能效与硬件加速方向，对 LLM serving 有远期参考，但离主流 GPU/TPU 预训练与推理栈较远。
summary.technical_approach: Otters++ 利用定制 In2O3 光电突触的自然信号衰减直接实现 TTFS 时间项，避免显式数字衰减计算。为扩展到 Transformer，作者建立 Otters++ 与量化神经网络的逐层函数等价，并采用混合训练：前向使用设备忠实的 SNN 计算，反向通过等价 QNN 路径使用 straight-through 梯度。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调能效目标、硬件测量衰减曲线、Transformer 扩展和混合训练方法，但未给出具体模型规模、任务、baseline、能耗数字或精度损失。

summary_en.core_problem: TTFS spiking neural networks promise energy-efficient inference, but the digital cost of computing temporal decay terms and multiplying them by synaptic weights can erode the expected benefit.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an optoelectronic SNN computation path and training method for Transformer models. It is relevant to inference efficiency and hardware acceleration, but remains far from the mainstream GPU/TPU LLM training and serving stack.
summary_en.technical_approach: Otters++ uses the natural signal decay of a custom In2O3 optoelectronic synapse to realize the TTFS temporal term directly, removing explicit digital decay computation. To scale to Transformers, it establishes a layer-wise functional equivalence between Otters++ and a quantized neural network, then trains with device-faithful SNN computation in the forward pass and straight-through gradients through the equivalent QNN path in the backward pass.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes measured device decay, Transformer scaling, and hybrid training, but does not specify model sizes, tasks, baselines, energy numbers, or accuracy trade-offs.

recommendation.zh: 硬件想法有意思，但离 LLM 推理主线较远；只看等价 QNN 训练技巧，别把能效结论外推到数据中心。
recommendation.en: The hardware idea is neat but far from mainstream LLM inference; skim the QNN-equivalence training trick and avoid extrapolating the energy claims to datacenters.

paper.title: TWLA: Achieving Ternary Weights and Low-Bit Activations for LLMs via Post-Training Quantization
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit exceptional general language processing capabilities, but their memory and compute costs hinder deployment. Ternarization has emerged as a promising compression technique, offering significant reductions in model size and inference complexity. However, existing methods struggle with heavy-tailed activation distributions and therefore keep activations in high precision, fundamentally limiting end-to-end inference acceleration. To overcome this limitation, we p

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM三值化方法因重尾激活分布无法同时低比特量化激活，限制端到端推理加速。
summary.importance: 提出首个实现1.58位权重和4位激活的训练后量化框架，属于高效推理领域的方法贡献。
summary.technical_approach: TWLA包含三部分：(1) E2M-ATQ两阶段优化（欧几里得初始化到流形重定位）最小化权重三值化的层输出误差；(2) KOTMS使用Kronecker结构正交旋转处理激活分布。
summary.experiments: 在多个LLM模型上进行PTQ实验，与现有量化方法对比精度。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM ternarization methods cannot simultaneously quantize activations to low bits due to heavy-tailed activation distributions, limiting end-to-end inference acceleration.
summary_en.importance: First PTQ framework achieving 1.58-bit weights and 4-bit activations with maintained accuracy, a methodological contribution in efficient inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: TWLA comprises (1) E2M-ATQ: two-stage optimization from Euclidean initialization to manifold relocation minimizing layer-output error under weight ternarization; (2) KOTMS: Kronecker-structured orthogonal rotation for activation shaping.
summary_en.experiments: PTQ experiments on multiple LLM models, accuracy compared against existing quantization methods.

recommendation.zh: 推理量化的增量工作，声称1.58bit权重+4bit激活精度保持不错，但PTQ方法对预训练研究无直接启示，快速浏览方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental inference quantization work claiming 1.58-bit weights + 4-bit activations with decent accuracy preservation. PTQ methods have no direct implication for pretraining; skim the method section only if interested.

paper.title: ReSET: Accurate Latency-Critical NVFP4 Reasoning via Step-Aware Temperature Scaling
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) improve complex problem-solving by generating long intermediate reasoning traces, but this substantially increases inference costs. NVFP4 inference offers a promising approach to reduce both computational and memory costs through hardware-supported low-precision execution. However, directly applying NVFP4 to LRMs introduces two practical limitations: reasoning accuracy degrades under quantization, and existing NVFP4 kernels do not fully realize latency benefits in s

summary.core_problem: NVFP4低精度推理在大推理模型(LRM)上导致推理精度下降，且现有NVFP4内核在小批量自回归解码中未充分发挥延迟优势
summary.importance: 方法创新——首次针对推理模型量化后不同步骤的token不确定性差异提出自适应温度缩放策略
summary.technical_approach: ReSET方法：在线估计每个推理步骤的token级熵不确定性，对低熵符号token降低采样温度以抑制错误采样，对高不确定性步骤调整温度分布；分析了NVFP4量化对token不确定性的具体影响
summary.experiments: 摘要被截断，已知发现：NVFP4量化在低熵符号token上增加错误采样，在高不确定性推理步骤中导致token分布过度集中

summary_en.core_problem: NVFP4 low-precision inference degrades reasoning accuracy on large reasoning models, and existing NVFP4 kernels underdeliver latency benefits in small-batch autoregressive decoding
summary_en.importance: Method innovation—first to propose adaptive temperature scaling based on per-step token uncertainty in quantized reasoning models
summary_en.technical_approach: ReSET: online estimates token-level entropy uncertainty at each reasoning step, lowers temperature for low-entropy symbolic tokens to suppress incorrect sampling, adjusts temperature distribution for high-uncertainty steps; includes analysis of NVFP4 quantization's specific impact on token uncertainty
summary_en.experiments: Abstract truncated; finding: NVFP4 quantization increases incorrect sampling at low-entropy symbolic tokens and causes over-concentration in high-uncertainty reasoning steps

recommendation.zh: token级量化误差分析有一定启发性，但温度缩放属于推理侧补丁，对预训练无直接借鉴，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: Token-level quantization error analysis has some relevance, but temperature scaling is an inference-side patch; no direct pretraining takeaways, read abstract only

paper.title: TileFuse: A Fused Mixed-Precision Kernel Library for Efficient Quantized LLM Inference on AMD NPUs
paper.abstract: With the growing demand for on-device LLM inference, edge SoCs increasingly integrate NPUs to improve performance and energy efficiency under tight power and thermal budgets. However, practical LLM deployment on current client NPUs remains difficult: widely used quantization formats such as AWQ do not map cleanly onto many existing NPU software stacks, which are often proprietary and expose limited low-level control. In this work, we present \textit{TileFuse}, a close-to-metal mixed-precision ke

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很具体但长期被忽视的问题：边缘端 NPU 明明有不错的能效，却很难直接运行社区常用的量化 LLM，尤其是 AWQ 这类已经广泛分发的 W4A16 / W8A16 权重。问题不在于单纯算力不够，而在于现有 NPU 软件栈封闭、低层可编程性不足，以及量化格式、数据布局、DMA 流水和 tile 级执行方式之间不匹配。结果就是，用户往往得为了硬件去改模型或改量化方案，而不是把现成量化模型直接部署上去。TileFuse 试图把这个链条打通：让 AMD XDNA2 NPU 直接吃下 AWQ 风格权重，并把它真正接进端到端 LLM 推理流程。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是训练方法论文，而是推理系统与量化落地论文。但它有两点现实意义。第一，它说明“社区主流量化格式能否被硬件原生支持”会反过来影响模型分发、量化标准和后续训练生态，这对 pretrain/posttrain 接口是有启发的。第二，它展示了低比特权重在 NPU 上落地时，真正的瓶颈常常不是 MAC 数，而是权重解包、去量化、片上存储布局和 DMA 调度；这对以后设计更硬件友好的量化格式、token-wise/group-wise scaling 方案有直接参考价值。贡献量级更接近工程系统层面的扎实推进，而不是范式改变。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是做一套面向 XDNA2 AIE tile 的 fused mixed-precision kernel library，并围绕它重做权重布局和数据流。关键点有三层。

第一层是 kernel fusion。作者不是先把 INT4/INT8 权重展开成 BF16 再做 GEMM/GEMV，而是让压缩权重一路保持低比特格式，直到进入 compute core 后再在同一 kernel 流里完成 unpack、dequantize 和矩阵计算。这样做的原因很直接：如果先物化成高精度权重，带宽和片上存储都会被吃掉，低比特量化的收益会被前处理成本抵消。TileFuse 直接支持 AWQ 风格 W4A16 和 W8A16，对 transformer 线性层做 fused execution。

第二层是 interleaved pre-tiling 与 layout co-design。XDNA2 的 DMA streaming 和 tile 级数据搬运有严格约束，直接按常规矩阵布局喂数据会让流水断掉，尤其在 FFN 的大 shape 上更明显。作者因此在离线阶段对权重做预切块和交错布局，让运行时 DMA 能连续供数，同时让 dequant 后的数据更贴合 AIE 的向量化执行方式。这里的重点不是单纯“换个 layout”，而是把量化分组、tile 尺寸、片上 buffer 和 GEMM/GEMV 访存模式一起设计。

第三层是 end-to-end runtime integration。论文不只停在 microkernel，而是把这些 kernel 接进完整 LLM runtime，覆盖 prefill 和 decode 场景，并处理 practical LLM shapes。前文专门批评已有工作只能跑受限 GEMM 维度，不能覆盖 Gemma-2B 一类模型常见 FFN 形状；TileFuse 的一个卖点就是把 kernel 设计到能覆盖这些真实模型尺寸，而不是只在漂亮的 benchmark shape 上报吞吐。

和已有方法相比，区别主要有两点。相对 Qualcomm 上的 ScalingLLM，它不要求改用 NPU 定制量化方案，而是尽量保留社区现成 AWQ 格式。相对此前基于 IRON 的 BFP16 GEMM 工作，它追求的是可用于准确端到端 LLM 推理的 mixed-precision low-bit 路线，而不是只展示某类 GEMM 的高 TOP/s。
summary.experiments:
实验结论很清楚：融合低比特 kernel 后，收益主要来自避免高精度权重物化和减少数据搬运。论文给出的核心数字是，和 full-precision baselines 相比，kernel 级性能最高可提升 121.6%（GEMM）和 281%（GEMV）。在端到端 LLM 推理上，prefilling latency 最多降低 2.0×，能耗降低超过 64.6%。

从摘要和正文可见，作者重点评测的是 transformer 线性层，因为这是 LLM 推理主耗时路径。实验还强调 practical shapes，而不是只测规则小矩阵，这一点很重要。论文的价值不在于某个单点峰值，而在于：在真实量化格式、真实模型 shape、真实 runtime 集成下，NPU 终于能把低比特 LLM 推理跑成一个可部署系统。

消融层面，最值得注意的应当是三类对比：是否 fuse unpack/dequantize；是否采用预切块交错布局；以及 GEMM 与 GEMV 在 prefill/decode 两阶段的不同收益。通常 decode 更容易被小 batch、低算强度和访存开销主导，因此 GEMV 281% 的提升说明前处理与数据流优化在 token-by-token 场景里尤其关键。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先抓系统瓶颈，再看 kernel 细节。优先看 Introduction 里对现有 NPU 部署困境的界定，明确作者到底解决了什么。然后看方法部分里 fused kernel、weight layout、DMA/dataflow 设计这三块，尤其关注为什么 AWQ 直接映射到 XDNA2 会卡在数据搬运而不是算子表达。实验部分建议重点看 kernel-level benchmark 和 end-to-end prefill/decode latency、energy 对比，确认收益来自哪里。预计 25 到 35 分钟能读完主线；如果你关心边缘部署或硬件友好量化，可以再细看 kernel pipeline 图和不同矩阵 shape 的覆盖范围。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a practical deployment gap: client NPUs are attractive for on-device LLM inference, but they still cannot run widely used quantized models in a native way, especially AWQ-style W4A16/W8A16 checkpoints. The bottleneck is not just raw compute. It is the mismatch between community quantization formats and NPU software stacks, plus the lack of low-level control over data movement, unpacking, and execution. As a result, users often have to reshape the model around the accelerator instead of running off-the-shelf quantized weights. TileFuse aims to close that gap on AMD XDNA2 by making AWQ-like weights a first-class execution format inside the NPU runtime.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it matters for foundation-model infrastructure. It shows that hardware support for community-standard quantization formats can shape the broader model ecosystem, including what formats become practical to distribute and optimize for. It also makes a useful point for researchers working on quantization-aware training or post-training quantization: on NPUs, the real bottleneck is often not the arithmetic itself, but weight unpacking, dequantization, on-chip layout, and DMA scheduling. The contribution is best read as a strong systems result with implications for hardware-friendly quantization design, rather than a change in modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core idea is a close-to-metal mixed-precision kernel library for AMD XDNA2 AIE tiles, coupled with weight-layout and runtime co-design.

First, TileFuse uses fused kernels for quantized linear layers. Instead of materializing low-bit weights into BF16 before matrix multiplication, it keeps weights compressed as INT4 or INT8 until they reach the compute core. Unpacking, dequantization, and GEMM/GEMV execution happen within one kernel flow. This matters because separate weight expansion would erase much of the memory and bandwidth benefit of low-bit quantization.

Second, the paper introduces interleaved pre-tiling and layout co-design. XDNA2 imposes practical constraints on DMA streaming and tile-local buffering, so a conventional matrix layout leads to poor pipeline utilization, especially for large FFN shapes. The authors therefore pre-tile and interleave weights offline so that runtime DMA can stream data continuously and the dequantized fragments align with the vectorized execution pattern of the AIE tiles. The key point is that quantization grouping, tile geometry, memory layout, and execution order are designed together.

Third, the work is integrated into an end-to-end LLM runtime rather than stopping at microkernels. The paper explicitly positions itself against prior results that report strong GEMM throughput on restricted dimensions but do not cover practical transformer shapes or sufficient numerical fidelity for full LLM inference. TileFuse is designed to support real transformer linear layers in both prefill and decode settings.

Relative to prior work, the distinction is clear. Unlike hardware-tailored quantization schemes such as ScalingLLM on Qualcomm, TileFuse tries to preserve standard AWQ-style formats. Unlike earlier BFP16 GEMM work on Ryzen NPUs, it targets deployable low-bit inference with adequate end-to-end accuracy, not just high isolated TOP/s.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is that fusion removes a large amount of overhead from weight handling. Compared with full-precision baselines, the paper reports up to 121.6% kernel-level improvement for GEMM and 281% for GEMV. In end-to-end LLM inference, it achieves up to 2.0x lower prefilling latency and more than 64.6% lower energy.

The evaluation focuses on transformer linear layers, which dominate LLM inference cost, and emphasizes practical model shapes rather than only idealized benchmark matrices. That is an important part of the contribution: the system is meant to run real quantized LLMs, not just produce good microbenchmark numbers.

The most informative ablations are likely the comparisons with and without fused unpack/dequantize, with and without the interleaved pre-tiling layout, and the different behavior of GEMM versus GEMV across prefill and decode. The especially large GEMV gain suggests that token-by-token decode is highly sensitive to dataflow and preprocessing overhead, which is exactly where this design helps most.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the introduction and the motivation around NPU fragmentation and why standard AWQ deployment is still difficult. Then read the method sections on fused kernels, weight layout, and DMA/dataflow design. The main question to keep in mind is why direct AWQ support is hard on XDNA2 unless execution and layout are co-designed. In the experiments, focus on kernel-level benchmarks and end-to-end prefill/decode latency and energy numbers. A 25-35 minute skim should be enough to capture the main ideas. If you care about edge inference or hardware-aware quantization, spend extra time on the kernel pipeline diagrams and the coverage of practical transformer shapes.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但很适合做小模型/端侧路线的人看：重点看它如何避免为硬件专有量化格式改模型，这个接口问题常被训练侧低估。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but useful if you care about small models or edge deployment: the key is how it avoids reshaping models around hardware-specific quantization formats, an interface issue training teams often underestimate.

paper.title: SPEAR: A System for Post-Quantization Error-Adaptive Recovery Enabling Efficient Low-Bit LLM Serving
paper.abstract: Efficient large language model (LLM) serving is increasingly constrained by deployment cost. Quantization is a key technique for reducing serving cost, yet even state-of-the-art 4-bit quantizers exhibit a noticeable quality gap from FP16, particularly for smaller models where low-bit serving is most beneficial. We identify a fundamental cause of this gap: quantization error is highly input-dependent and varies substantially across tokens, while existing post-quantization compensation methods are

summary.core_problem: 现有4-bit LLM量化的精度补偿方案采用静态策略，对所有token、所有网络层施加统一的修正量。实际量化误差具有强输入依赖性，不同token的误差幅度可达数倍差异，导致简单token补偿过剩、困难token补偿不足；而直接引入动态补偿会打破现有推理服务栈的执行假设，带来不可接受的延迟开销。
summary.importance: 明确了量化误差的输入依赖分布特性，给出了精度-延迟折中良好的系统级低比特服务方案，对生产环境低比特LLM部署有实用价值，对预训练方法直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是输入自适应的后量化补偿机制。首先设计轻量级误差补偿器，通过轻量门控模块按当前输入动态决定补偿强度，优先将修正容量分配给误差大的困难token；再通过CKA引导的熵感知诊断方法，仅在对误差最敏感的网络层插入补偿器，最小化参数量和计算开销。系统层面配套三类协同优化：一是分阶段kernel融合调度，decode阶段（内存 bound）将补偿逻辑与低比特计算核深度融合，prefill阶段（计算 bound）采用CUDA Graph执行路径降低开销；二是基于NVLink P2P双写的核内设计，消除张量并行场景下补偿分支带来的跨卡同步开销；三是感知补偿开销的分块调度，基于预校准的kernel延迟查找表，在连续batching场景下根据SLO约束动态调整分块大小。
summary.experiments: 在Llama系列模型上，SPEAR可补回56%-75%的W4量化与FP16推理之间的困惑度差距，例如Llama-3.2-1B困惑度从20.46降至12.40，Llama-2-7B从6.56降至5.92，效果覆盖RTN、GPTQ、AWQ、OmniQuant四类主流量化算法；额外内存开销不到1%，仅为已有静态补偿方法的31%-66%。单卡场景decode延迟比原生W4 MARLIN高25%以内，多卡场景延迟与原生W4 MARLIN相当；连续batching下可满足16ms/22ms的SLO要求，平均首Token延迟比满足相同SLO的静态分块prefill基线最高快2.7倍。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注引言部分对量化误差输入依赖特性的观测、自适应补偿的设计动机、系统层面三类优化对应的问题场景，实验部分浏览精度-延迟折中曲线即可，无需深究底层CUDA kernel实现细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing post-quantization error compensation methods for 4-bit LLM serving apply static, uniform correction across all tokens and layers. In practice, quantization error is strongly input-dependent, varying several-fold across tokens, leading to over-compensation for easy tokens and under-correction for hard tokens. Naive implementation of dynamic compensation breaks core assumptions of existing serving stacks, introducing prohibitive latency overhead.
summary_en.importance: This work characterizes the input-dependent distribution of quantization error, and delivers a system-co-designed low-bit serving solution with strong accuracy-latency tradeoff. It has clear practical value for production LLM deployment, with limited direct implication for pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core design is input-adaptive post-quantization compensation. Lightweight Error Compensators (ECs) use a small gating module to adjust correction strength per input token, allocating most correction capacity to high-error hard tokens. A CKA-guided entropy-aware diagnostic method selects only the most error-sensitive layers to place ECs, minimizing parameter and compute overhead. Three system-level co-optimizations address deployment gaps: first, phase-aware kernel fusion that fuses ECs into low-bit decode kernels (optimized for memory-bound decode phase) and uses CUDA Graph execution for the compute-heavy prefill phase; second, an NVLink P2P dual-write design within kernels to eliminate cross-GPU synchronization overhead introduced by the EC branch in tensor-parallel settings; third, EC-aware chunk scheduling that uses pre-calibrated kernel latency lookup tables to dynamically adjust chunk sizes and meet service level objectives under continuous batching.
summary_en.experiments: Across Llama model variants, SPEAR closes 56-75% of the perplexity gap between W4 quantization and FP16 inference, e.g. reducing Llama-3.2-1B perplexity from 20.46 to 12.40, and Llama-2-7B perplexity from 6.56 to 5.92. Gains are consistent across RTN, GPTQ, AWQ, and OmniQuant quantizers. The method adds less than 1% extra model memory footprint, using only 31-66% of the memory required by prior static compensation methods. On a single GPU, decode latency stays within 25% of plain W4 MARLIN; on multi-GPU setups, latency is comparable to plain W4 MARLIN. Under continuous batching, SPEAR meets both 16ms and 22ms SLO targets, and reduces mean time to first token by up to 2.7x relative to SLO-compliant static chunked prefill baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the observation of input-dependent quantization error in the introduction, the core design motivation for adaptive compensation, and the problem framing for each of the three system optimizations. Browse the accuracy-latency tradeoff curves in experiments; low-level CUDA kernel implementation details can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看误差诊断和 per-token gate 设计；结论若无延迟细表支撑，不能当 serving recipe。
recommendation.en: Read the error diagnostic and per-token gating design; without detailed latency tables, do not treat it as a serving recipe.

paper.title: Alignment Collapse Under KV Cache Quantization: Diagnosis and Mitigation
paper.abstract: Key-value (KV) cache quantization is widely used to reduce Large Language Model (LLM) inference memory, yet existing evaluations solely focus on measuring perplexity and accuracy without assessing the safety impact. In this study, we explore alignment preservation under KV cache quantization. Across eleven instruction-tuned models (3.8B-72B) and five benchmarks (1,894 prompts), we find that low-bit quantization can silently destroy safety alignment: Mistral-7B loses 15.2% of its refusals at only

summary.core_problem: KV cache 量化可以降低长上下文推理显存，但低比特量化可能在困惑度和任务准确率几乎不变时破坏拒答行为；这篇工作系统诊断这种 alignment collapse 的出现条件和缓解方式。
summary.importance: 对基座和后训练研究的启发在于：对齐能力不是只由权重决定，服务侧的 activation 表示和压缩策略也会改变模型行为。常规 PPL 监控无法覆盖安全拒答子空间，低比特 KV cache 可能把后训练得到的拒答方向扰乱掉。对长上下文 serving、量化评测、post-train 到部署的接口都有直接影响。它也提醒预训练研究者，在设计长上下文架构、activation 分布和 outlier 通道时，需要考虑后续量化是否会集中伤害少数行为控制方向。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把问题定位为几何脆弱性。拒答相关特征集中在低维 activation 子空间，而 KV cache 量化噪声并不是均匀地伤害所有语义特征。当安全关键通道与 activation outlier 通道的重合关系不同，per-channel 量化、layer protection 或提高 bit-width 的效果也不同。作者提出 Per-Channel Reduction, PCR，用约 20 个 calibration prompts 测量模型在关键通道上的量化敏感性，并据此把模型归入不同失败模式。缓解方案是训练-free 的：根据 PCR 结果选择保留部分层为 FP16、改用更细粒度量化，或提高基础 bit-width。方法强调诊断先于修复，而不是给所有模型套同一个量化配置。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 11 个 instruction-tuned 模型，规模从 3.8B 到 72B；5 个安全 benchmark，共 1,894 个 prompts。结果显示不存在通用安全 bit-width：collapse onset 从 6-bit 到 2-bit 跨越四个 bit。例子包括 Qwen-2.5-7B 在 6-bit 已出现崩塌，而 Gemma-2-9B 到 3-bit 仍保持安全；Mistral-7B 在 PPL 仅变为 1.03× 时，拒答率下降 15.2%。作者进一步报告安全特征子空间比整体表示空间对量化噪声脆弱 10^2–10^3 倍。PCR 用 20 个 calibration prompts、约 35 GPU-min 诊断模型，并在九个主要模型和一个 held-out 模型上给出正确缓解选择；该诊断在 KIVI、不同 system prompt 和不同 layer-selection heuristic 下仍能工作。缓解方案最高可恢复 97% 的丢失对齐，典型显存额外开销为 0–7%。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看现象部分：不同模型的 bit-width collapse 曲线，以及 PPL 与 refusal rate 脱钩的图。然后看几何分析：安全子空间、outlier channel overlap、per-channel 量化为何对不同模型效果不同。最后看 PCR 诊断和 mitigation 表格，确认它如何从 20 个 prompts 推出具体策略。对做 serving 或量化的人，缓解 protocol 值得细看；对做预训练的人，最有用的是 activation outlier 与行为方向重合这一点。

summary_en.core_problem: KV-cache quantization saves inference memory, but low-bit cache compression can destroy refusal behavior while leaving perplexity and task accuracy nearly unchanged. The paper diagnoses when this happens and how to mitigate it without retraining.
summary_en.importance: The main lesson is that alignment is not only a property of model weights. It also depends on activation geometry and on the compression scheme used at serving time. Standard PPL-based validation can miss a large change in refusal behavior because the safety signal lives in a small subspace. This matters for long-context serving, quantization evaluation, and the handoff from post-training to deployment. It also gives pretraining researchers a concrete reason to care about activation outliers and whether behavior-controlling directions are concentrated in fragile channels.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper frames the failure as a geometric interaction between quantization noise and safety-critical activation directions. Refusal features occupy a low-dimensional subspace, and this subspace can be much more sensitive to cache quantization than the full representation. Whether per-channel quantization helps depends on the overlap between safety-critical channels and activation outlier channels. The proposed diagnostic, Per-Channel Reduction (PCR), uses about 20 calibration prompts to classify a model into a failure mode and select a mitigation. The mitigation is training-free: protect selected layers in FP16, use finer-grained quantization, or increase the base bit-width depending on the PCR diagnosis. The key design choice is model-specific diagnosis rather than a universal low-bit recipe.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates 11 instruction-tuned models from 3.8B to 72B on five safety benchmarks with 1,894 prompts. Collapse thresholds vary widely, from 6-bit to 2-bit. For example, Qwen-2.5-7B collapses around 6-bit, while Gemma-2-9B remains safe through 3-bit. Mistral-7B loses 15.2% of its refusals while perplexity increases only to 1.03×, showing why PPL monitoring is insufficient. The safety subspace is reported to be 10^2–10^3 times more vulnerable to quantization noise than the full representation space. PCR, computed from 20 calibration prompts in about 35 GPU-minutes, selects the right mitigation on nine primary models and one held-out model, and remains predictive across KIVI, system prompts, and layer-selection heuristics. The mitigation recovers up to 97% of lost alignment with typical memory overhead between 0% and 7%.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the collapse curves that compare bit-width, refusal rate, and perplexity; they are the clearest evidence that standard metrics miss the failure. Then read the geometry section on safety subspaces and outlier-channel overlap. Finish with the PCR diagnostic and mitigation tables to see how the calibration signal maps to an action. For inference and quantization work, the protocol details are the most actionable. For pretraining work, the useful part is the link between activation outliers and behavior-critical directions.

recommendation.zh: 一个被忽视的真实问题：量化的安全退化不体现在 perplexity 上。几何机制解释（低维安全子空间）很有说服力，做量化/部署的人应看 §4 的 PCR 诊断。
recommendation.en: A real and understudied failure mode: quantization degrades safety without showing up in perplexity. The geometric explanation (low-dimensional safety subspace) is convincing; read §4 for the PCR diagnostic if you do quantization or deployment.

paper.title: Optimal Post-Training Quantization Scales and Where to Find Them
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses large language models by mapping weights to low-bit representations. The scaling factor that defines the quantization grid is typically chosen using simple, data-free heuristics. In this work, we present PiSO (Piecewise Scale Optimization), an algorithm that leverages calibration data to compute the optimal channel-wise weight scales exactly and efficiently under round-to-nearest quantization. PiSO partitions the scale search space into finitely many i

summary.core_problem: 后训练量化（PTQ）中缩放因子通常采用简单无数据启发式（如 absmax）选择，忽略了输入激活如何在层输出处放大概率化误差；现有数据感知方法有限，且最优通道级缩放因子能否在 round-to-nearest 量化下被精确高效计算是一个未解决问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在于量化校准数据效率的改进——PiSO 减少了精确定量所需的校准数据量，这对于模型压缩与部署环节和预训练的接口有参考价值；此外，scale 优化与误差校正算法的联合优化思路可迁移至其他模型压缩场景。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PiSO（Piecewise Scale Optimization）算法，核心洞察是量化函数 q(w;s) 关于 s 是分段常数的，因此可将实轴（s 的搜索空间）划分为有限多个区间，每个区间内误差函数有闭式最优解。通过高效增量更新遍历这些区间，可在多项式时间内得到每个通道的全局最优 scale。通过两种互补近似扩展到分组量化（其中一种可捕捉跨组交互），并提出三种策略与 GPTQ 等贪婪误差校正方法交错优化 scale 和权重网格分配。
summary.experiments: 在 Llama 和 Qwen 模型上进行了多模型尺寸和目标位宽的综合实验。结果显示 PiSO 无论单独使用还是与 GPTQ、Qronos 结合，都在困惑度和下游零样本精度上取得持续改进；目标位宽越窄（量化越困难），改进幅度越大。PiSO 同时减少了 RTN 和与 GPTQ 结合场景下所需的校准数据量。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看方法章节中 PiSO 算法的三个关键观察（通道可分性、固定网格分配的闭式最优、分段常数洞察），与 GPTQ 的结合策略，以及实验章节中的低位宽消融结果。预计阅读时间：25-35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Scaling factors in post-training quantization (PTQ) are typically chosen using simple data-free heuristics (e.g., absmax) that ignore how input activations amplify quantization errors at layer output. Existing data-aware methods are limited, and whether optimal channel-wise scales can be computed exactly and efficiently under round-to-nearest quantization remained an open question.
summary_en.importance: The primary relevance to pretraining research is improved calibration data efficiency for quantization — PiSO reduces the amount of calibration data needed for accurate quantization, which has implications for the model compression/deployment interface with pretraining. The joint optimization of scale and error correction also provides a transferable idea to other model compression scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes PiSO (Piecewise Scale Optimization), whose key insight is that the quantization function q(w;s) is piecewise constant in s, allowing the real line (search space for s) to be partitioned into finitely many intervals where the error admits a closed-form minimizer. Sweeping these intervals with efficient incremental updates yields the globally optimal scale per channel in polynomial time. Extends to group-wise quantization via two complementary approximations (one capturing cross-group interactions), and proposes three interleaving strategies to integrate with greedy error correction methods like GPTQ.
summary_en.experiments: Comprehensive experiments on Llama and Qwen models across multiple model sizes and target weight bit-widths. PiSO yields consistent improvements in perplexity and downstream zero-shot accuracy, both standalone and when combined with GPTQ and Qronos. Benefits increase as target bit-width narrows and quantization becomes more challenging. PiSO also reduces calibration data requirements under both RTN and GPTQ-integrated settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Methods section for PiSO's three key observations (channel separability, closed-form optimum for fixed grid assignment, piecewise constant insight), GPTQ integration strategies, and the low-bitwidth ablation results in experiments. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: PiSO对PTQ量化给出了一个干净的闭形式解，比传统启发式有理论优势，做低bit推理的人应看§3的分区分析
recommendation.en: PiSO provides a clean closed-form solution for PTQ scale optimization with theoretical advantages over heuristics; §3 interval analysis is worth reading for low-bit inference practitioners

paper.title: Quality Is Not a Safety Proxy Under Quantization
paper.abstract: Quantized checkpoints are often screened first with quality metrics and only later, if at all, with direct safety tests. This paper audits that shortcut on a matched 51-row matrix spanning 6 models, 4 families, a 7-level GGUF ladder, and AWQ/GPTQ INT4 checkpoints. In this matrix the shortcut fails: all 36 quality-safety pairings split direction across models, and 9 hidden-danger rows plus 1 near-hidden-danger row show quality stable or improved while refusal falls by 12-68 percentage points. Sev

summary.core_problem: 检验一个常见但危险的流程假设：量化模型只要质量指标稳定，安全行为也应大体稳定。
summary.importance: 这是量化安全审计，不是单纯推理加速论文。它指出质量指标和安全指标在量化后可能解耦，对开源量化 checkpoint 的发布、筛选和 serving 风险控制有直接意义。
summary.technical_approach: 构造 51 行匹配矩阵，覆盖 6 个模型、4 个模型族、7 档 GGUF 量化以及 AWQ/GPTQ INT4 checkpoint；逐项比较质量与拒答安全行为，并用熵、拒答方向、校准 probe、与安全相关神经元的量化误差做机制跟踪。
summary.experiments: 所有 36 个质量-安全配对都在不同模型上出现方向分裂；发现 9 个 hidden-danger 行和 1 个 near-hidden-danger 行，即质量稳定或提升但拒答率下降 12-68 个百分点。11 个 AWQ/GPTQ 行中有 7 个属于 hidden-danger。机制 probe 没能可靠区分危险量化；安全相关神经元整体吸收 1.39 倍量化误差，p < 5e-7，但该效应并非特定危险 regime 独有。Claude Sonnet 4 还对预定义分层集合中的 11,470 个样本做了重标注。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests a common but unsafe assumption: if a quantized checkpoint preserves quality metrics, its safety behavior should also remain stable.
summary_en.importance: This is a quantization safety audit rather than a pure inference-acceleration paper. It shows that quality and safety can decouple after quantization, which matters for releasing, screening, and serving open quantized checkpoints.
summary_en.technical_approach: It builds a matched 51-row matrix spanning 6 models, 4 families, a 7-level GGUF ladder, and AWQ/GPTQ INT4 checkpoints. It compares quality and refusal behavior, then runs mechanistic probes based on entropy, refusal directions, calibration, and quantization error on safety-associated neurons.
summary_en.experiments: All 36 quality-safety pairings split direction across models. The audit finds 9 hidden-danger rows and 1 near-hidden-danger row where quality is stable or improved while refusal drops by 12–68 percentage points. Seven of the 11 AWQ/GPTQ rows are hidden-danger. Mechanistic probes do not reliably separate dangerous quantized checkpoints; safety-associated neurons absorb 1.39× more quantization error overall with p < 5e-7, but this effect is not regime-specific. Claude Sonnet 4 relabels 11,470 items in a predefined stratified set.

recommendation.zh: 只看矩阵设计和 hidden-danger 行；它会改变“先看 perplexity 再看安全”的量化发布流程。
recommendation.en: Read the matrix design and hidden-danger rows; this should change the habit of screening quantized releases by quality before safety.

paper.title: Density Field State Space Models: 1-Bit Distillation, Efficient Inference, and Knowledge Organization in Mamba-2
paper.abstract: We present Density Field State Space Models (DF-SSM), a framework for compressing SSMs to a 1-bit scaffold with int8 low-rank correction. Applied to Mamba-2 1.3B, we achieve a 278 MB model (9.7x smaller than the 2.7 GB FP16 teacher) that runs at 21.4x faster inference on GPU (batch=1, relative to the mamba-ssm reference implementation) while maintaining downstream task performance within 2-4 percentage points of BitMamba-2, a 1.58-bit model trained from scratch on 150B tokens. The distillation i

summary.core_problem: 尝试把 Mamba-2 这类 SSM 模型压缩到极低比特并保持可用性能，同时给出配套高效推理实现。
summary.importance: 这是一篇效率导向的压缩/部署工作，亮点在于 1-bit scaffold + int8 低秩修正和较小蒸馏成本；但作者为独立研究者，结论更适合作为工程线索而非立即采信的范式结果。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DF-SSM，将预训练 SSM 蒸馏为 1-bit 主干并配合 int8 低秩校正；推理侧结合 cuBLAS INT8 tensor cores、自定义 CUDA kernel 以及 AVX-512 CPU 后端。作者还分析压缩后模型内部出现的三阶段处理模式。
summary.experiments: 在 Mamba-2 1.3B 上，模型从 2.7GB FP16 压到 278MB，声称 GPU batch=1 推理相对参考实现快 21.4 倍；蒸馏仅用 32M tokens、单张 A100 训练 6 小时。性能上与从头训练的 1.58-bit BitMamba-2 相差 2-4 个百分点。需要注意比较基线是 reference implementation，系统优化成分较大。
summary.authors_note: 作者为独立研究者。论文同时覆盖压缩、系统实现和少量机制分析，但缺少大机构常见的大规模复现实证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to compress Mamba-2 style SSMs to extremely low bitwidth while preserving usable performance, and to pair that with an efficient inference stack.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficiency-oriented compression/deployment paper. The interesting part is the 1-bit scaffold plus int8 low-rank correction with relatively cheap distillation, but given the independent-researcher setting, the claims are better treated as engineering signals than as settled results.
summary_en.technical_approach: DF-SSM distills a pretrained SSM into a 1-bit scaffold with int8 low-rank correction. On the systems side, it combines cuBLAS INT8 tensor cores, custom CUDA kernels, and an AVX-512 CPU backend. The paper also reports a three-phase internal processing pattern in the compressed model.
summary_en.experiments: On Mamba-2 1.3B, the model is reduced from 2.7GB FP16 to 278MB, with a claimed 21.4x GPU batch-1 speedup over the reference implementation. Distillation uses only 32M tokens and 6 hours on one A100. Performance is reported within 2-4 points of BitMamba-2, a 1.58-bit model trained from scratch. The baseline being a reference implementation means the systems component likely contributes heavily.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is an independent researcher. The paper spans compression, systems implementation, and some internal analysis, but lacks the large-scale validation typically seen in major lab work.

recommendation.zh: 把它当工程线索看，不要当定论：1-bit+低秩修正值得抄到压缩实验里，但 21x 提速多半混了实现红利，先看 baseline 是否公平。
recommendation.en: Treat this as an engineering lead, not a settled result: 1-bit plus low-rank correction is worth trying, but the 21x speedup likely mixes in implementation gains, so check baseline fairness first.

paper.title: STAR-KV: Low-Rank KV Cache Compression via Soft Thresholding for Adaptive Rank Control
paper.abstract: Low-rank projection has emerged as a promising approach for compressing the KV cache by exploiting hidden-dimension redundancy. However, prior methods rely on fixed or heuristic rank selection and struggle to achieve aggressive compression with minimal accuracy degradation. We propose STAR-KV, an adaptive low-rank KV cache compression framework with fine-grained rank control. STAR-KV encompasses 1) a differentiable thresholding mechanism that enables optimal rank selection at both attention-head

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文推理中 KV cache 占用过大，而现有低秩压缩方法 rank 选择僵硬、压缩激进时精度掉得快的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的工程方法创新。它不直接改变预训练范式，但对长上下文 serving、训练后评测和 RL 长 rollout 的系统成本都有现实影响，尤其是把低秩压缩、量化和自适应 rank 控制放到一个统一框架里。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 STAR-KV：用可微 soft-thresholding 在 attention head 和 block 两个粒度上自适应选 rank；对 K/V 采用不同的低秩分解策略，利用两者敏感性差异；再叠加 low-rank-aware mixed-precision quantization，根据统计特性做近无损低比特量化。实现上配了 Triton GPU kernel，说明作者关心的不只是离线压缩率，而是实际吞吐。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的结果是在多个 LLM 和 benchmark 上，单独做 KV 压缩可达 75% 压缩率，结合量化后总体 KV cache reduction 最高到 20x，同时尽量维持精度。具体模型规模、基线和退化幅度摘要未完整给出，但对比对象显然是固定 rank 或启发式 rank 的低秩 KV 方法，以及常规量化方案。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the KV-cache memory bottleneck in long-context inference, where prior low-rank methods rely on fixed or heuristic rank choices and degrade quickly under aggressive compression.
summary_en.importance: This is an engineering contribution in inference efficiency rather than pretraining proper, but it matters for long-context serving, post-training evaluation, and RL rollouts because it combines adaptive low-rank compression and quantization in one deployable stack.
summary_en.technical_approach: STAR-KV introduces differentiable soft-thresholding for adaptive rank selection at both head and block granularity, uses different low-rank factorizations for keys and values based on their sensitivity, and adds low-rank-aware mixed-precision quantization driven by data statistics. The Triton kernel implementation suggests the work is aimed at real throughput, not just offline compression ratios.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, STAR-KV reaches up to 75% KV compression across multiple LLMs and benchmarks, and up to 20x total KV reduction when combined with quantization, while keeping accuracy degradation small. The likely baselines are fixed-rank or heuristic-rank low-rank KV methods plus standard quantization schemes, though the abstract does not expose the full setup.

recommendation.zh: 这是典型值得看实现细节的系统论文，不改 pretrain prior，但若你关心长上下文或 RL rollout 成本，只看自适应 rank 设计和 kernel 结果就够了。
recommendation.en: A solid systems paper to mine for implementation ideas; it does not change pretraining priors, but if long-context serving or RL rollout cost matters, read the adaptive-rank design and kernel results.

paper.title: Building & Benchmarking: LLMs on a 16GB Jetson Orin NX for Hermes Agent
paper.abstract: Introduction Small AI computers are usually sold with large dreams and shitty memory buses. I have a ridiculous server that pulls a few kilowatts, but I wanted a local Hermes Agent box that could sit on a shelf, stay near silent, draw laptop-class power, and still run a serious model with enough context for real agent work: always available and cheap enough that leaving it on does not feel ...

summary.core_problem: 在 16GB Jetson Orin NX 这类边缘设备上，如何把“能跑、够安静、够长上下文”的本地 LLM/Agent 运行起来，并给出可复现的性能与资源占用记录。
summary.importance: 属于工程实践/部署经验分享：对做本地推理、边缘端 agent 盒子的人有参考，但对基座预训练方法论（数据/目标/优化/架构）几乎没有增量。
summary.technical_approach: 以 Hermes Agent 的本地运行需求为目标，围绕 Jetson Orin NX 的显存/带宽/功耗约束做模型选择、量化/推理栈配置、上下文长度与吞吐/延迟的折中，并记录可用配置与踩坑点（更像“bench log”而非新方法）。
summary.experiments: 博客摘要未给出可核验的统一实验表（模型规模、量化位宽、上下文长度、tokens/s、功耗、温度、KV-cache占用等关键指标在此处不可确认）。整体更像单机配置与体验报告，而非严格对照实验。

summary_en.core_problem: How to run a practical local LLM/agent with sufficient context length on a 16GB Jetson Orin NX, with reproducible performance/resource measurements.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an engineering/deployment write-up: useful for edge inference practitioners, but offers little direct insight for foundation-model pretraining (data/objectives/optimization/architecture).
summary_en.technical_approach: Targets a Hermes Agent “always-on” box under memory-bandwidth/power constraints, choosing model/configs and tuning the inference stack (e.g., quantization/runtime settings), then logging throughput/latency/context trade-offs and pitfalls—more a bench log than a new method.
summary_en.experiments: The provided excerpt does not include a clean, verifiable experimental table (model size, quantization, context length, tokens/s, power/thermals, KV-cache footprint, etc.), so evidence strength is limited.

recommendation.zh: 偏部署随笔：对预训练研究几乎无信息增益；除非你要做 Jetson 端本地推理选型，否则不值得读正文。
recommendation.en: Mostly a deployment diary with little pretraining signal; only skim if you’re actually sizing Jetson-class edge inference.

paper.title: ScaleSweep: Accurate NVFP4 Post-Training Quantization of LLMs via Block Scale Initialization
paper.abstract: NVFP4 is a recently introduced hardware-supported FP4 format that improves the fidelity of 4-bit quantization through fine-grained block scales. However, existing NVFP4 scale initialization methods still primarily rely on AbsMax initialization, which leaves a noticeable gap to the optimal solution. To address this, we propose ScaleSweep, a simple and efficient scale optimization method that sweeps over feasible block scale candidates and selects the candidate that minimizes a target objective. W

summary.core_problem: NVFP4是近期提出的硬件支持的FP4格式，现有缩放初始化方法主要依赖AbsMax初始化，与最优解之间存在明显差距。
summary.importance: 提出ScaleSweep——简单高效的NVFP4块尺度优化方法，并提供了理论分析和扫描范围边界，大幅减少扫描空间同时保留最优候选。
summary.technical_approach: ScaleSweep在可行的块尺度候选范围内扫描，选择使目标函数最小的候选；理论推导了MSE和WMSE下所需扫描范围的上下界，从而大幅减少扫描空间而不丢失最优解；相比基线量化算子增加的开销可忽略不计。
summary.experiments: 在Llama和Qwen模型上实验，验证了ScaleSweep在保持最低开销的同时，相比AbsMax初始化在NVFP4量化精度上取得了明显改进。
summary.authors_note: 作者Li Lin和Xiaojun Wan，无法从论文信息确认机构背景。

summary_en.core_problem: NVFP4 is a recently introduced hardware-supported FP4 format for 4-bit quantization; existing scale initialization methods still rely primarily on AbsMax initialization, leaving a noticeable gap to the optimal solution.
summary_en.importance: Presents ScaleSweep, a simple and efficient NVFP4 block scale optimization method with theoretical analysis and sweep range bounds that substantially reduce the search space while preserving optimal candidates with negligible overhead.
summary_en.technical_approach: ScaleSweep sweeps over feasible block scale candidates and selects the one minimizing a target objective; provides theoretical derivation of upper and lower bounds for the required sweep range under MSE and WMSE, drastically reducing search space without losing optimal solutions; overhead is negligible compared with baseline quantization operators.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on Llama and Qwen models validate that ScaleSweep achieves significant improvements in NVFP4 quantization accuracy over AbsMax initialization while maintaining minimal overhead.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are Li Lin and Xiaojun Wan; institutional affiliations not identifiable from paper information.

recommendation.zh: NVFP4量化的实用改进，理论推导有一定参考价值。关注量化的研究员值得看推导部分。
recommendation.en: Practical improvement for NVFP4 quantization with useful theoretical derivations; researchers focused on quantization should check the derivation section.

paper.title: Understanding Quantization-Aware Training: Gradients at Quantized Weights Bias to the Low-Loss Basin
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) converts a trained full-precision model into low-bit weights without task-level retraining, while quantization-aware training (QAT) incorporates quantization into the training loop. Although PTQ is efficient and often accurate at moderate bitwidths, it can fail sharply at aggressive bitwidths; QAT is more expensive but can often recover the lost accuracy. We propose a unified geometric framework that explains both PTQ failure and QAT recovery. We model full-preci

summary.core_problem: 现有理论缺乏对训练后量化（PTQ）在极低比特下失效、量化感知训练（QAT）可恢复精度这一现象的统一解释框架
summary.importance: 原理分析贡献，提出统一的几何框架解释量化相关的精度变化机制，为低比特量化方法设计提供理论指导
summary.technical_approach: 将全精度训练建模为在低损失谷地中沿低损失河道前进：河道附近为近似平坦的低损失盆地，超出盆地则损失急剧上升；PTQ仅做局部量化优化，易落在盆地外的高损失点；QAT的直通估计器梯度会将权重拉向量化网格上的低损失点
summary.experiments: 在多个CV与NLP模型上验证了几何框架的预测，观察到PTQ在量化网格宽度与盆地宽度可比时失效，QAT可稳定将量化权重引导至低损失盆地内，恢复PTQ丢失的精度

summary_en.core_problem: Existing theories lack a unified explanatory framework for why post-training quantization (PTQ) fails at aggressive bitwidths, while quantization-aware training (QAT) can recover accuracy
summary_en.importance: Mechanistic analysis contribution, proposing a unified geometric framework to explain quantization-related accuracy change mechanisms, providing theoretical guidance for low-bit quantization method design
summary_en.technical_approach: Model full-precision training as following a low-loss river inside a wider valley: the neighborhood of the river forms a nearly flat low-loss basin, while leaving the basin incurs a sharp loss increase; PTQ only performs local quantization optimization and easily selects high-loss points outside the basin; QAT's straight-through estimator gradients pull weights towards low-loss points on the quantization grid
summary_en.experiments: Verified the predictions of the geometric framework on multiple CV and NLP models, observing that PTQ fails when the quantization grid width is comparable to the basin width, and QAT can stably guide quantized weights into the low-loss basin to recover accuracy lost by PTQ

recommendation.zh: 量化相关的机制性解释，对设计低比特量化训练方案有直接指导意义，重点看第3章的几何框架建模与第4章的实验验证
recommendation.en: A mechanistic explanation of quantization that provides direct guidance for designing low-bit quantization training schemes, focus on the geometric framework modeling in §3 and experimental verification in §4

paper.title: Value-and-Structure Alignment for Routing-Consistent Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts Models
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale foundation models efficiently by activating only a subset of experts for each token, but their large number of expert parameters still makes quantization essential for practical deployment. Unlike dense models, however, MoE models are sensitive to routing instability: small quantization-induced perturbations can change the top-$k$ expert selection, altering the computation path and degrading model quality. We propose Value-and-Structure Routing Alignment for

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 MoE 模型做后训练量化时，一个 dense 模型里不明显、但在 MoE 里很致命的问题：量化误差会改变 router 的 top-k 专家选择，导致 token 走到不同 expert，计算路径被改写，最终性能下降。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是核心推进，更偏部署侧，但对 MoE 基座研究仍有启发。启发点在于：MoE 的脆弱性不只来自数值重建误差，还来自离散路由边界的扰动。这个观察对训练期的 router 正则、负载均衡、margin 设计、以及后续做低比特 MoE serving 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 VSRAQ，属于可插拔的 MoE 专用 PTQ 校准目标，而不是一套独立量化算法。它在常规 reconstruction loss 之外，加了 router alignment loss，并把对齐拆成两部分。第一部分是 value alignment，去匹配量化前后的 router logits 或相关分数，且对路由敏感区域加权，让靠近决策边界的 token 受到更强约束。第二部分是 structure alignment，不只看数值接近，还显式保持被选中 expert 之间的相对排序，以及第 k 个被选 expert 与附近未选 expert 之间的 margin，避免 rank inversion 和 boundary violation。方法可以接到现有 PTQ 流程上，推理时没有额外开销。和已有 router-aware quantization 相比，它的区别在于不满足于“分数差不多”，而是把 top-k 决策的结构稳定性也纳入目标。
summary.experiments: 从全文描述看，实验重点应是三类指标：量化后语言模型质量下降幅度、expert-selection consistency，以及不同 bit-width/不同基线 PTQ 框架下的稳健性。作者声称在近期 MoE foundation models 上，VSRAQ 能减少量化导致的路由变化，并降低性能退化。阅读时重点看：相对 GPTQ/AWQ 类基线，加入 VSRAQ 后 perplexity 或下游指标改善多少；路由一致率提升多少；value alignment 和 structure alignment 分别拿掉时退化多大。如果这些消融成立，说明“结构对齐”不是装饰项，而是 MoE 量化里真正缺失的目标。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。先看 Introduction，理解作者为什么认为 MoE 量化和 dense 量化不是同一个问题。然后看方法部分里 structure alignment 的定义，尤其是 expert 排序和 top-k 边界 margin 怎么写进 loss。最后看实验表里路由一致率和主任务指标的对应关系。预计 20–30 分钟能抓住主要内容。若只关心研究启发，不必深究量化实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a MoE-specific failure mode in post-training quantization: small quantization errors can perturb router scores enough to change top-k expert selection, so the token is sent through a different computation path and model quality drops.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pre-training paper, but it is still relevant to MoE foundation-model research. The useful takeaway is that MoE sensitivity is not only about numerical reconstruction error. It is also about preserving discrete routing decisions and the margins around those decisions. That insight can inform router regularization, routing-margin design, and low-bit MoE deployment strategy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, VSRAQ, is a plug-in calibration objective for MoE post-training quantization rather than a standalone quantizer. It augments the standard reconstruction loss with a router-alignment term and splits that term into two components. Value alignment matches pre- and post-quantization router logits or routing-relevant scores, with extra emphasis on sensitive regions near routing boundaries. Structure alignment goes beyond score matching and explicitly preserves the relative ordering among selected experts as well as the margin between the k-th selected expert and nearby non-selected experts. The goal is to prevent rank inversions and boundary violations that would alter top-k routing. The method can be integrated into existing PTQ pipelines and adds no inference-time overhead. Relative to prior router-aware quantization work, the main difference is that it treats routing as a structured decision problem, not just a value-matching problem.
summary_en.experiments: The key results to look for are: reduced degradation in language-model quality after quantization, higher expert-selection consistency, and robustness across bit-widths and PTQ backbones. The paper claims improvements on recent MoE foundation models. The most informative numbers are the gains over standard PTQ baselines such as GPTQ/AWQ-style methods, the increase in routing consistency, and the ablations removing value alignment or structure alignment. If the structure term matters materially in those ablations, that supports the paper’s main claim that preserving routing geometry is necessary for MoE quantization.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Read the introduction to understand why MoE quantization is qualitatively different from dense-model quantization. Then read the definition of structure alignment, especially how expert ranking and top-k boundary margins are encoded in the loss. Finally, inspect the tables linking routing consistency to end-task quality. About 20–30 minutes should be enough for the main ideas.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改预训练范式，但把 MoE 量化失效点钉在 routing boundary 上，值得看方法和消融；若你做 MoE，先读路由一致性指标和 top-k 边界那部分。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining, but it pins MoE quantization failure on routing boundaries; worth reading for the objective and ablations. If you work on MoE, start with the routing-consistency metric and top-k boundary analysis.

paper.title: Beyond Output Matching: Preserving Internal Geometry in NVFP4 LLM Distillatio
paper.abstract: Demand for low-precision inference, including NVFP4-based approaches, has grown as large language models are increasingly deployed in latency and cost constrained production environments. Quantization-aware distillation (QAD) helps recover accuracy lost under low bit quantization by training a quantized student to match the output distribution of a frozen higher precision teacher via a KL-divergence loss. In this work, we first provide a representation level diagnosis of QAD: output matching alo

summary.core_problem: 量化感知蒸馏（QAD）仅通过KL散度对齐输出分布，无法保证中间激活层的内部几何结构被保留。论文发现仅用KL的QAD反而会加剧表示漂移——尤其是经过RL后训练的模型——尽管输出分布与老师模型已经对齐。
summary.importance: 对低比特LLM量化蒸馏的研究提供了诊断层面的新视角：输出对齐 ≠ 内部表示保真。这一发现也间接提醒预训练研究者，蒸馏/对齐等后训练过程中，内部表示几何可能被悄悄破坏而指标不反映。
summary.technical_approach: 在标准QAD目标（KL散度对齐输出分布）之外，增加了一层Centered Kernel Alignment（CKA）正则项，对中间激活的几何结构做显式约束。CKA的核心优势是对正交变换和各向同性缩放不变，比逐点MSE更鲁棒于量化带来的尺度偏移和截断。总损失为KL项加层间CKA对齐项。实现采用teacher-top-k变体减少词表级蒸馏的通信开销，k=8192。
summary.experiments: 在Nemotron 3 Nano（混合Mamba-Transformer MoE）和Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507上评测。KL-only QAD会降低各层与BF16老师的CKA相似度，RL后训练模型的漂移最严重。CKA-QAD将内部对齐恢复到接近BF16水平，额外开销仅为step时间的0.5%和峰值VRAM的7.0%（在Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507上）。下游任务上，AIME25从68.5%→72.3%，GPQA-D从59.5%→61.1%，LiveCodeBench-v5从57.9%→59.8%。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Section 3（CKA-QAD目标函数和实现细节）和Section 4中的CKA相似度热力图（展示各层漂移模式）。对于预训练研究者，最有价值的是其诊断部分：如何用CKA系统地揭示输出对齐掩盖内部退化这一现象。预计阅读时间20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息未在提供的文本中明确给出，作者是做NVFP4量化和QAD方向的研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Quantization-Aware Distillation (QAD) using only KL divergence to align output distributions does not guarantee preservation of the internal geometric structure of intermediate activations. The paper finds that KL-only QAD can actually exacerbate representational drift — especially in RL-post-trained models — even when output distributions are well-aligned to the teacher.
summary_en.importance: Provides a diagnostic insight for low-bit LLM quantization distillation: output alignment does not equal internal representation fidelity. This finding also indirectly alerts pretraining researchers that internal geometry may be silently corrupted during distillation/alignment without being reflected in output metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: In addition to the standard QAD objective (KL divergence for output distribution alignment), a layerwise Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) regularization term is added to explicitly constrain the geometry of intermediate activations. CKA is invariant to orthogonal transformations and isotropic scaling, making it more robust than pointwise MSE against quantization-induced scale shifts and clipping. Total loss combines KL term and inter-layer CKA alignment. Implementation uses a teacher-top-k variant with k=8192 to reduce communication cost of vocabulary-level distillation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Nemotron 3 Nano (hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE) and Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507. KL-only QAD reduces CKA similarity to the BF16 teacher across layers, with RL-post-trained models showing the most severe drift. CKA-QAD restores internal alignment to near-BF16 levels with only 0.5% step-time overhead and 7.0% peak VRAM overhead. On downstream tasks: AIME25 68.5%→72.3%, GPQA-D 59.5%→61.1%, LiveCodeBench-v5 57.9%→59.8%.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (CKA-QAD objective and implementation details) and Section 4's CKA similarity heatmaps showing per-layer drift patterns. The most valuable part for pretraining researchers is the diagnostic framing: how CKA systematically reveals that output alignment can mask internal degradation. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution not explicitly stated in the provided text; authors work on NVFP4 quantization and QAD.

recommendation.zh: RL 后训练模型在蒸馏中表征退化更严重——这对 pretrain-post-train 接口有直接启示；重点读 §3 CKA 分析。
recommendation.en: RL-post-trained models suffer more representational degradation during distillation — directly relevant to the pretrain-post-train interface; focus on §3 CKA analysis.

paper.title: LLMCodec: Adapting Video Codecs for Efficient Weight Compression of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: The rapid development of large language models(LLMs) has led to remarkable advances in natural language processing. However, the increasing scale of these models introduces substantial challenges in terms of storage, transmission, and deployment. Though great efforts have been devoted to model compression and quantization, existing methods often rely on fine-tuning or calibration data, which exhibit limited generalization across different tensor types. In this paper, we argue that video codecs o

summary.core_problem: 大模型权重压缩通常依赖量化，但极低比特量化（如 2-bit）会导致严重的精度损失，且现有方法对不同张量类型的泛化能力有限。
summary.importance: 提出了一种将 LLM 权重转换为视频序列并利用成熟视频编解码器进行压缩的新范式，为极低比特模型压缩提供了一种不依赖校准数据或微调的替代方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 LLMCodec 框架。首先，利用可学习的仿射变换（借鉴 FlatQuant）消除权重中的异常值，使权重分布更均匀；然后，将权重进行 INT8 RTN 量化，并重组为 YUV420 格式的视频序列；最后，使用标准视频编解码器进行压缩。推理时，解码并反量化回浮点数。
summary.experiments: 在 LLaMA-3-8B 上，将权重压缩至 2-bit 时，LLMCodec 相比 FlatQuant 将 Wikitext2 的困惑度降低了约 36%（从 41.15 降至 26.53），下游任务平均准确率提升了 21%。在其他 LLM 上也观察到了类似的一致性提升。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Section III 中权重到视频序列的映射方法，以及异常值消除对视频压缩效率的影响。可以快速浏览实验部分，了解其在极低比特下的性能优势。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM weight compression typically relies on quantization, but extreme low-bit quantization (e.g., 2-bit) leads to severe accuracy degradation, and existing methods have limited generalization across different tensor types.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a novel paradigm that converts LLM weights into video sequences and leverages mature video codecs for compression, offering an alternative for extreme low-bit model compression that does not rely on calibration data or fine-tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the LLMCodec framework. First, it utilizes a learnable affine transformation (inspired by FlatQuant) to eliminate outliers in weights, resulting in a more uniform distribution. Then, the weights are quantized to INT8 using RTN and reorganized into YUV420 video sequences. Finally, standard video codecs are applied for compression. During inference, the bitstream is decoded and dequantized back to floating-point values.
summary_en.experiments: On LLaMA-3-8B, when compressing weights to 2-bit, LLMCodec reduces Wikitext2 perplexity by approximately 36% (from 41.15 to 26.53) and improves average downstream accuracy by 21% compared to FlatQuant. Similar consistent improvements are observed across other LLMs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section III for the mapping method from weights to video sequences and the impact of outlier elimination on video compression efficiency. Skim the experiments section to understand its performance advantages under extreme low-bit constraints.

recommendation.zh: 别被“用视频编码压权重”噱头带跑：只要看压缩比-精度曲线和与 GPTQ/AWQ 的公平对照，若真能免校准还稳，值得进部署工具箱。
recommendation.en: Ignore the gimmick—only the rate–accuracy curves and fair baselines vs GPTQ/AWQ matter; if it truly stays stable without calibration, it’s a deployable trick worth keeping.

paper.title: When Good Enough Is Optimal: Multiplication-Only Matrix Inversion Approximation for Quantized Gated DeltaNet
paper.abstract: Matrix inversion in chunk-wise parallel linear attention is a major bottleneck for long-context modeling, particularly on NPUs, where forward-substitution-based methods exhibit limited parallelism and poor hardware utilization. We propose a fast, Matrix Multiplication (MatMul)-based algorithm tailored for strictly lower-triangular matrices arising in chunk-wise linear attention. Motivated by the rapid growth of Neumann-series terms and the diagonal concentration of the inverse matrix, we employ

summary.core_problem: 如何加速长上下文分块线性注意力（chunk-wise linear attention）中，特别是 NPU 上的矩阵求逆瓶颈？
summary.importance: 工程突破。针对线性注意力在长上下文场景下的计算瓶颈，提出了一种纯矩阵乘法（MatMul）的求逆近似算法，显著提升了硬件利用率和并行度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一种基于 MatMul 的算法，专门针对分块线性注意力中产生的严格下三角矩阵。利用截断诺伊曼级数（truncated Neumann expansion）结合结构化掩码和并行残差校正来消除顺序依赖。进一步扩展到低比特 INT 量化，通过缓解重复矩阵幂运算引起的动态范围扩展，并根据块大小自适应调整近似阶数和残差步数。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3.5 系列模型上，实现了高达 5 倍的 kernel 级别加速，并减少了 20% 的计算量。

summary_en.core_problem: How to accelerate the matrix inversion bottleneck in chunk-wise linear attention for long-context modeling, particularly on NPUs?
summary_en.importance: Engineering breakthrough. Proposes a multiplication-only (MatMul) matrix inversion approximation algorithm to address the computational bottleneck of linear attention in long-context scenarios, significantly improving hardware utilization and parallelism.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a MatMul-based algorithm tailored for strictly lower-triangular matrices in chunk-wise linear attention. Employs a truncated Neumann expansion with structural masking and parallel residual correction to eliminate sequential dependencies. Extends the method to low-bit INT quantization by mitigating dynamic range expansion from repeated matrix power operations, and adapts approximation order and residual steps to chunk size.
summary_en.experiments: Demonstrates up to 5x kernel-level speedup and a 20% reduction in computational cost on Qwen3.5-family models.

recommendation.zh: 针对线性注意力长上下文推理的底层算子优化，对预训练研究员来说作为 literature 备查即可，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Low-level operator optimization for linear attention in long-context inference; keep as literature reference, skip the main text.

paper.title: WUSH: Near-Optimal Adaptive Transforms for LLM Quantization
paper.abstract: Quantizing LLM weights and activations is a standard approach for efficient deployment, but a few extreme outliers can stretch the dynamic range and amplify low-bit quantization errors. Prior transform-based mitigations (e.g., Hadamard rotations) are fixed and data-agnostic, and their optimality for quantization has remained unclear. We derive closed-form optimal linear blockwise transforms for joint weight-activation quantization under standard RTN AbsMax-scaled block quantizers, covering both

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 LLM 低比特权重-激活量化中的 outlier 问题：少数极端值拉大量化动态范围，使 4-bit 这类低精度格式的有效分辨率下降。已有 Hadamard rotation 等方法能摊平方差，但通常是固定、数据无关的；论文要回答的是，在标准 blockwise RTN AbsMax quantizer 下，什么样的线性变换才接近最优。
summary.importance: 这是一篇偏 efficient inference 的论文，对预训练方法本身不是直接贡献，但对低精度部署和硬件友好模型设计有参考价值。它把常见的 Hadamard rotation 从经验技巧推进到可分析的 blockwise quantization objective，并说明数据相关的非正交变换可以在保持 kernel 效率的同时降低量化误差。对基座研究员有两个启发：一是 outlier 处理不一定只能靠训练期正则或 activation smoothing，也可以在校准阶段闭式解决；二是低精度友好性应同时看权重、激活和矩阵乘输出误差，而不是只看单边量化误差。
summary.technical_approach: WUSH 从线性层输出误差出发，目标是在量化后近似保持 W^T X。论文把输入通道切成与量化 group 对齐的 block，对每个 block 独立选择作用在 weight 和 activation 上的变换 T_W、T_X，并使用 RTN AbsMax block quantizer。方法先用权重和校准激活的 second moment 构造 Cholesky 因子，再通过一个 SVD 得到数据相关的缩放与旋转成分，最后和 Hadamard backbone 组合成 WUSH。这个变换通常是非正交的，这一点不同于纯 Hadamard 或其他 rotation-only 方法。它也不同于 SpinQuant、FlatQuant 这类通过梯度下降学习变换的方法：WUSH 是 calibration-driven closed-form transform，避免迭代优化，同时保留 blockwise Hadamard 风格的 fused GPU 实现。理论上，论文给出 FP block quantizer 下的最优性，以及 INT block quantizer 下在温和条件下的渐近最优性。
summary.experiments: 主要实验显示，WUSH 在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的 W4A4 设置下优于 Hadamard-based baseline。使用 MXFP4 RTN 时，平均精度最多提升 2.8 分；与 GPTQ 结合时，在 MXFP4 GPTQ 上仍有 0.7 分提升。论文还报告 WUSH 能缩小 NVFP 与 MXFP 格式之间的性能差距，并且和 GPTQ 具有互补性。系统侧结果表明，虽然每个 block 使用数据相关变换，fused GPU kernel 的吞吐可以匹配优化过的 blockwise Hadamard kernel；借助 FP4 matmul，单层速度最高可比 BF16 快 5.8 倍。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。先看 Introduction，明确它要解决的是 fixed Hadamard 是否最优的问题。方法部分重点看 transformed weight-activation quantization objective、block-independent constraint，以及 WUSH 构造公式，尤其是 Cholesky second moment、SVD 和 Hadamard backbone 如何组合。理论部分可只抓结论：FP 最优、INT 渐近最优。实验表格重点看 W4A4、MXFP4 RTN、MXFP4 GPTQ，以及与 GPTQ 结合后的结果。若关心落地，建议看 fused GPU kernel 与 throughput 对比；若只关心预训练研究，可把它作为低精度友好性和 outlier 处理的参考读物。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies outlier-driven error in low-bit LLM weight-activation quantization. A few extreme values enlarge the AbsMax scale and reduce the effective resolution of 4-bit formats. Existing Hadamard rotations spread variance and work well in practice, but they are fixed and data-agnostic. The paper asks what linear blockwise transform is near-optimal under standard RTN AbsMax quantizers.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is useful for researchers who care about low-precision model design. It turns Hadamard-style rotations from an empirical recipe into an analyzable output-error minimization problem. The main lesson is that quantization robustness should be optimized jointly for weights and activations at the level of matrix-multiplication output error, not only by smoothing one side of the computation. It also shows that calibration-time, data-dependent transforms can reduce quantization error without giving up efficient kernels.
summary_en.technical_approach: WUSH formulates the goal as preserving the linear-layer output W^T X after quantizing transformed weights and activations. The input channels are partitioned into blocks aligned with quantization groups, and each block is optimized independently under an RTN AbsMax block quantizer.
