paper.title: Budget Constraints as Riemannian Manifolds
paper.abstract: Assigning one of K options to each of N groups under a total cost budget is a recurring problem in machine learning, appearing in mixed-precision quantization, non-uniform pruning, and expert selection. The objective (model loss) depends jointly on all assignments and does not decompose across groups, which prevents combinatorial solvers from optimizing the true objective directly and limits them to proxy objectives. Evolutionary search evaluates the actual loss but lacks gradient information, w

summary.core_problem: 解决带总预算约束的离散配置优化问题，例如混合精度量化、非均匀剪枝和专家选择中，如何在满足预算的同时直接优化真实模型损失。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是模型压缩和资源分配中的优化方法。它不是预训练论文，但对量化、剪枝、MoE expert allocation 等效率问题有方法参考，特别是把硬预算约束放进可微优化几何中。
summary.technical_approach: 作者观察到在 softmax relaxation 下，预算约束在 logit space 中形成一个几何结构简单的 Riemannian manifold：法向量有闭式形式，沿 cost vector 平移 logits 会单调改变期望成本，因此可用 binary-search retraction 回到预算面，vector transport 也只需一次内积。基于此构建满足预算的流形优化方法，避免 penalty tuning 和 proxy objective。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验结果。任务动机覆盖 mixed-precision quantization、non-uniform pruning 和 expert selection，但未说明具体模型规模、压缩率、baseline 或实际 loss/accuracy 改善。
summary.authors_note: Dan Alistarh 是分布式优化、稀疏训练和模型压缩方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies discrete assignment under a total budget, as seen in mixed-precision quantization, non-uniform pruning, and expert selection, while optimizing the true model loss.
summary_en.importance: This is an optimization method for model compression and resource allocation. It is not a pretraining paper, but it may be useful for quantization, pruning, and MoE allocation problems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Under a softmax relaxation, the authors view the budget constraint as a simple Riemannian manifold in logit space: the normal vector has a closed form, shifting logits along the cost vector changes expected cost monotonically, retraction can be done by binary search, and vector transport reduces to one inner product. This avoids penalty tuning and proxy-only combinatorial solvers.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide detailed results. The motivating settings include mixed-precision quantization, non-uniform pruning, and expert selection, but model sizes, compression targets, baselines, and numerical gains are not specified.
summary_en.authors_note: Dan Alistarh is known for work on distributed optimization, sparse training, and model compression.

recommendation.zh: 把预算约束做成 manifold 是干净的优化视角；先看几何推导，是否打过强 LLM 压缩还不清楚。
recommendation.en: The manifold view of budget constraints is clean; read the geometry first, but it is unclear whether it beats strong LLM compression baselines.

paper.title: QFlash: Bridging Quantization and Memory Efficiency in Vision Transformer Attention
paper.abstract: FlashAttention improves efficiency through tiling, but its online softmax still relies on floating-point arithmetic for numerical stability, making full quantization difficult. We identify three main obstacles to integer-only FlashAttention: (1) scale explosion during tile-wise accumulation, (2) inefficient shift-based exponential operations on GPUs, and (3) quantization granularity constraints requiring uniform scales for integer comparison. To address these challenges, we propose \textit{QFlas

summary.core_problem: 解决FlashAttention的在线softmax依赖浮点运算导致无法实现端到端整数量化的问题
summary.importance: 工程创新，首次实现纯整数域运行的端到端量化FlashAttention Triton内核
summary.technical_approach: 针对tile累积尺度爆炸、GPU上移位指数运算效率低、量化粒度约束三个障碍，设计纯整数域softmax，合并为单Triton kernel运行
summary.experiments: 在ViT、DeiT、Swin的7种注意力负载上测试，相比I-ViT最高提速6.73倍，Swin上最高提速8.69倍，能耗比FP16 FlashAttention低18.8%，ViT/DeiT精度无损失，Swin精度持平
summary.authors_note: 韩国科学技术院、电子通信研究院、釜山大学、全北大学团队，无大模型领域知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Solve the problem that FlashAttention's online softmax relies on floating-point arithmetic, which prevents end-to-end full integer quantization
summary_en.importance: Engineering innovation, first end-to-end quantized FlashAttention Triton kernel running entirely in integer domain
summary_en.technical_approach: Address three obstacles: scale explosion during tile accumulation, inefficient shift-based exponential operations on GPUs, and quantization granularity constraints, design integer-only softmax and package into a single Triton kernel
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 7 attention workloads of ViT, DeiT and Swin, achieves up to 6.73x speedup over I-ViT, 8.69x speedup on Swin, 18.8% lower energy consumption than FP16 FlashAttention, no accuracy loss on ViT/DeiT, competitive accuracy on Swin under per-tensor quantization
summary_en.authors_note: Teams from University of Science and Technology Korea, ETRI, Pusan National University, Jeonbuk National University, no well-known LLM researchers

recommendation.zh: 整数量化FlashAttention的实现思路可参考，但仅针对ViT，无需深读正文
recommendation.en: Integer-only FlashAttention implementation ideas are referable, but only target ViTs, no need to read full text

institutions: University of Science and Technology Korea

paper.title: Coverage-Based Calibration for Post-Training Quantization via Weighted Set Cover over Outlier Channels
paper.abstract: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) compresses large language models to low bit-widths using a small calibration set, and its quality depends strongly on which samples are chosen. We identify a failure mode in which calibration samples fail to activate outlier channels, hidden dimensions with unusually large activations, causing the quantizer to underestimate their dynamic range and producing per-channel reconstruction errors that dominate layer-wise loss. Motivated by this observation, we argue th

summary.core_problem: 现有后训练量化（PTQ）的随机采样校准样本经常无法激活激活值异常大的异常值通道，导致量化器低估这些通道的动态范围，产生主导层损失的重构误差。
summary.importance: 为PTQ校准样本选择提供了新视角，不再依赖通用样本分布代表性，转而关注异常值通道覆盖，可大幅降低校准样本用量，降低量化部署成本，方法后端无关、 overhead 极低，对预训练模型落地有实际应用价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将校准样本选择形式化为异常值通道上的加权集合覆盖问题，每个通道按其对量化误差的贡献加权，目标函数为单调次模，使用贪心算法COVERCAL选样本，基于预计算的激活掩码运行，选样过程不需要GPU资源，自带(1-1/e)的近似最优保证。
summary.experiments: 在LLaMA-3-8B上使用AWQ做INT4量化的场景下，64个COVERCAL选择的校准样本就能达到随机采样256个样本的效果，测试覆盖3个模型家族、2种PTQ后端、4种校准预算、5个下游基准，性能提升直接对应异常值通道覆盖度的提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3章的问题建模、第4章的COVERCAL算法实现、第6章的实验结果，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Randomly sampled calibration sets used in existing post-training quantization (PTQ) often fail to activate outlier channels (hidden dimensions with abnormally large activations), leading quantizers to underestimate the dynamic range of these channels and produce reconstruction errors that dominate layer-wise loss.
summary_en.importance: Provides a new perspective for PTQ calibration sample selection, shifting focus from general sample distribution representativeness to outlier channel coverage, reduces required calibration sample count and quantization deployment cost. The proposed method is backend-agnostic with negligible overhead, and has practical value for pre-trained model deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formulates calibration sample selection as a weighted set cover problem over outlier channels, where each channel is weighted by its contribution to quantization error. The objective is monotone submodular, so a greedy algorithm named COVERCAL is used for sample selection. It runs on precomputed activation masks, no GPU resource is needed during sample selection, with a (1-1/e) approximation guarantee.
summary_en.experiments: On LLaMA-3-8B with AWQ INT4 quantization, 64 calibration samples selected by COVERCAL achieve the same performance as 256 randomly sampled calibration samples. Tests are conducted across 3 model families, 2 PTQ backends, 4 calibration budgets, 5 downstream benchmarks, performance improvements directly correlate with increased outlier channel coverage.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3 for problem formulation, Section 4 for COVERCAL algorithm implementation, Section 6 for experimental results. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 看方法和 outlier-channel 消融；把 PTQ 校准从代表性采样改成覆盖问题，适合做内部量化复现实验。
recommendation.en: Read the method and outlier-channel ablations; reframing PTQ calibration as coverage rather than representativeness is worth reproducing internally.

paper.title: BitRL: Reinforcement Learning with 1-bit Quantized Language Models for Resource-Constrained Edge Deployment
paper.abstract: The deployment of intelligent reinforcement learning (RL) agents on resource-constrained edge devices remains a fundamental challenge due to the substantial memory, computational, and energy requirements of modern deep learning systems. While large language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful architectures for decision-making agents, their multi-billion parameter scale confines them to cloud-based deployment, raising concerns about latency, privacy, and connectivity dependence.   We introduce

summary.core_problem: 多十亿参数语言模型作为 RL agent 时，内存、算力和能耗限制了边缘设备上的本地学习与推理。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是量化部署框架与资源受限 RL 系统实验：把 1-bit/ternary LLM 架构用于 RL agent，给出内存和能耗收益。它更偏 efficient deployment，不是预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: BitRL 基于 BitNet b1.58 风格的三值权重表示（-1、0、+1），结合优化推理栈来构建 RL agent。论文还声称分析量化误差对策略学习的影响，并在受限资源场景下评估策略性能保留率。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告相对 full-precision baseline 有 10-16 倍内存降低、3-5 倍能效提升，并在多个 benchmark 上保留 85-98% 的任务性能。摘要未说明具体模型规模、RL 环境、训练 token 或硬件设置。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 BRAC University、Missouri State University、Prime University、German University Bangladesh 等。

summary_en.core_problem: Billion-scale language-model agents are hard to deploy on edge devices because of memory, compute, and energy constraints.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an efficient-deployment and quantized-agent paper: it applies 1-bit or ternary language models to RL agents and reports memory and energy savings. It is not a pretraining-method contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: BitRL uses a BitNet b1.58-style ternary weight representation with values {-1, 0, +1}, plus an optimized inference stack for RL agents. The paper also claims a theoretical treatment of quantization effects on policy learning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 10-16x memory reduction, 3-5x energy-efficiency gains, and 85-98% task-performance retention against full-precision baselines across benchmarks. It does not specify model scale, environments, token budgets, or hardware details.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with BRAC University, Missouri State University, Prime University, and German University Bangladesh.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设置和量化误差分析；若 benchmark 太小，这更像 BitNet 迁移到 RL 的工程备查。
recommendation.en: Read only the setup and quantization-error analysis; if the benchmarks are small, treat it as an engineering note on moving BitNet-style models into RL.

paper.title: SpikingBrain2.0: Brain-Inspired Foundation Models for Efficient Long-Context and Cross-Platform Inference
paper.abstract: Scaling context length is reshaping large-model development, yet full-attention Transformers suffer from prohibitive computation and inference bottlenecks at long sequences. A key challenge is to design foundation models that maintain performance and long-context efficiency with minimal training overhead. We introduce SpikingBrain2.0 (SpB2.0), a 5B model that advances both architecture and training efficiency of its predecessor.   Our contributions are two-fold. (1) Architectural Innovation: We

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题不是再训练一个全新长上下文模型，而是在有限训练预算下，把已有 Transformer / VLM checkpoint 迁移成更适合超长上下文和跨平台推理的 hybrid 架构，同时尽量保住原模型能力。作者把问题拆成两部分：一是长序列下 attention 成为主要瓶颈，如何用混合稀疏机制降低 TTFT、TPOT 和显存占用；二是架构迁移通常代价高、恢复难，如何通过 continued training 和 distillation 把迁移成本压到可接受范围。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的意义主要不在“脑启发”叙事，而在一个更务实的方向：架构迁移是否可以成为 pretrain-posttrain 闭环的一部分。论文展示了一条 Transformer-to-Hybrid conversion 路线，从 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-4B-VL-Instruction 出发，用相对有限的 token 和 GPU 小时，把模型改造成长上下文更高效的 hybrid 版本，并在通用能力上尽量接近原模型。这个思路对持续预训练、mid-train 架构替换、长上下文 annealing 都有参考价值。真正的贡献量级更接近“工程上可行的迁移 recipe + 一套混合注意力设计”，而不是新的预训练范式。论文的大部分亮点也集中在推理效率和 conversion pipeline，而不是从零开始训练时的 scaling 规律。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上有两条主线。第一条是架构设计：Dual-Space Sparse Attention，简称 DSSA。作者把两种稀疏机制按层交替组合，比例约 1:3。一种是 Sparse Softmax Attention，文中用的是 MoBA，直接在未压缩的精确 KV cache 上做稀疏 softmax attention；另一种是 Sparse Linear Attention，文中用的是 SSE，在压缩状态表示上做稀疏线性注意力。作者的意图很明确：MoBA 保留一部分“精确检索”能力，SSE 提供更低成本的长程建模，两者交替以平衡质量和效率。这个设计不是单纯把 full attention 换成 linear attention，而是保留少量精确注意力层作为锚点。

第二条是 activation coding / 推理实现。作者针对两类硬件给出不同路径：在神经形态或事件驱动硬件上，用整数化加 spike-sequence expansion，把 dense MatMul 改成稀疏整数累加；在 GPU 上则采用 FP8，利用 Hopper Tensor Core 加速矩阵乘法。这里“跨平台”更多是部署视角，不是预训练目标本身。

更值得预训练研究员关注的是 conversion pipeline。LLM 路线从 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 出发，采用多阶段训练：先做短上下文蒸馏，让 hybrid 架构先学会模仿原模型；再做三阶段长上下文扩展，把上下文拉到 512k；之后做 general SFT 和 reasoning-oriented SFT，并补充探索 on-policy distillation。VLM 路线更短，主要是知识蒸馏加 instruction SFT。这个 pipeline 的关键不是单个 loss，而是训练顺序：先恢复 base capability，再拉长上下文，再做指令与推理对齐，避免一开始就在长上下文和新架构上同时承受过大分布漂移。

从方法取舍看，作者没有选择从头训练一个 hybrid 5B 模型，而是明确押注 continued training / distillation。这说明他们认为在当前阶段，架构效率收益足以支撑一次中等成本的模型迁移，但还不足以让人放弃已有高质量 Transformer checkpoint 的知识积累。
summary.experiments:
实验结果分三块看。第一块是效率。作者报告，在 HuggingFace sequence-parallel inference 下，4M 上下文长度时 TTFT 相比 base Transformer 最多提升 10.13x；在 vLLM tensor-parallel inference 下，512k 长度时 TTFT、TPOT、端到端延迟分别提升 4.5x、1.12x、4.3x。由于显存占用更低，8 张 A100 配合 chunked prefill 可以服务超过 10M token 的序列。这里可以看出，收益主要集中在 prefill/长上下文阶段，TPOT 提升相对有限，这和大多数长上下文优化工作一致。

第二块是能力恢复。LLM 侧，作者称 SpB2.0 在一组通用 benchmark 上平均达到 Qwen3-4B 的 95% 以上，并稳定超过 Qwen2.5-3B；经过 SFT 后，性能接近 Qwen3，也超过更大的 SpB1.0-7B。VLM 侧，SpB2.0-VL 的整体表现接近 Qwen2.5-VL-3B，并较好恢复 Qwen3-VL-4B 的能力。这里的关键信息不是绝对分数，而是“在架构替换后，能力恢复到什么程度”。

第三块是训练成本。LLM conversion 总成本约 4,656 A100 GPU 小时，使用约 14B continued pretraining tokens；作者拿它和 SpB1.0 的 150B CPT tokens 做对比，强调迁移成本显著下降。VLM conversion 约 1,977 A100 GPU 小时。两者合计不到 7k A100 GPU 小时，可在 32 张 A100 上约 9 天完成。这个数字对工业界很有现实意义，因为它把“换架构”从一个重训练项目，压缩成一个可操作的 continued training 项目。

不过从研究判断上，也要看到证据边界。论文更像系统工程展示，缺少一些基座研究员会关心的细节：例如 DSSA 各层比例是否在不同长度区间稳定最优，distillation 与非 distillation 的恢复差距有多大，长上下文 extension 各阶段的数据配比和 curriculum 如何影响遗忘，FP8 与稀疏机制是否存在训练稳定性交互。这些如果正文里没有充分展开，就意味着方法可复现性和可迁移性还需要更多材料支撑。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议按“迁移 recipe → 架构 → 效率结果”的顺序看。先读 introduction 和训练流程图，确认作者真正贡献的是 conversion pipeline，而不是单个新算子。然后看 DSSA 设计，重点理解为什么要把 MoBA 和 SSE 按 1:3 交替，而不是只用一种稀疏注意力。接着看长上下文扩展和蒸馏部分，尤其是多阶段训练顺序。最后再看推理 benchmark，区分 TTFT、TPOT、end-to-end latency 分别改善了什么。

如果只给 40 分钟，建议优先看：模型结构图、LLM conversion pipeline、效率表、能力恢复表。若要进一步判断其对预训练的启发，重点找三类消融：一是没有 distillation 是否还能恢复；二是 DSSA 比例变化是否影响质量-效率平衡；三是 14B continued tokens 的每一阶段分别贡献了多少恢复效果。若正文没有给全，这篇就更适合作为工程路线参考，而不是直接照搬的训练法则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not mainly about training a new long-context model from scratch. Its central problem is how to migrate an existing Transformer or VLM checkpoint into a more efficient hybrid architecture for ultra-long context and cross-platform inference, while preserving as much of the original capability as possible under a limited training budget. The authors address two linked issues: attention becomes the dominant bottleneck at long sequence lengths, and architecture migration is usually expensive and fragile unless the training recipe is carefully staged.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model pretraining, the main relevance is practical rather than conceptual. The paper treats architecture migration as part of the pretrain-to-posttrain loop: start from a strong pretrained checkpoint, convert it through continued training and distillation, then recover instruction and reasoning ability after the architectural change. That is useful for continual pretraining, mid-training architecture replacement, and long-context extension. The contribution is best understood as an engineering-feasible conversion recipe plus a hybrid sparse-attention design, not as a new pretraining paradigm. Most of the evidence is about inference efficiency and capability recovery after conversion, rather than scaling behavior from scratch.
summary_en.technical_approach:
There are two main technical components. The first is the architecture, called Dual-Space Sparse Attention (DSSA). It alternates two sparse mechanisms across layers at roughly a 1:3 ratio. One is sparse softmax attention, implemented with MoBA, which operates over the exact uncompressed KV cache. The other is sparse linear attention, implemented with SSE, which works over compressed state representations. The design intent is straightforward: keep some exact retrieval capacity through sparse softmax layers, while using cheaper sparse linear layers for long-range modeling. This is not a pure replacement of full attention with linear attention; it is a hybrid where a small number of more precise layers act as anchors.

The second component is activation coding for deployment. For event-driven or neuromorphic hardware, the model uses integer quantization plus spike-sequence expansion so that dense matrix multiplications can be approximated by sparse integer accumulation. For GPUs, it uses FP8 to exploit Hopper Tensor Cores. This part is mostly about inference portability rather than pretraining objectives.

The more interesting part for pretraining researchers is the conversion pipeline. The LLM path starts from Qwen3-4B-Instruct and uses a multi-stage recipe: short-context distillation to transfer the base model into the hybrid architecture, then a three-stage long-context extension up to 512k, followed by general SFT and reasoning-oriented SFT, with some exploration of on-policy distillation. The VLM path is shorter, mainly knowledge distillation plus instruction SFT. The sequencing matters. The model first recovers base capability under the new architecture, then extends context length, then restores instruction and reasoning behavior. That ordering reduces the amount of distribution shift the model has to absorb at once.

An important design choice is that the authors do not train a new 5B hybrid model from scratch. They explicitly bet on continued training and distillation. That suggests they view architecture efficiency gains as large enough to justify migration, but not large enough to abandon the knowledge already stored in strong Transformer checkpoints.
summary_en.experiments:
The results are best read in three groups. First, efficiency. Under HuggingFace sequence-parallel inference, the model reports up to 10.13x TTFT speedup over the base Transformer at 4M context length. Under vLLM tensor-parallel inference at 512k length, it reports 4.5x, 1.12x, and 4.3x improvements in TTFT, TPOT, and end-to-end latency, respectively. Because of the lower memory footprint, the system can also serve sequences beyond 10M tokens on 8 A100 GPUs with chunked prefill. The pattern is familiar: the biggest gains are in long-context prefill, while TPOT improves more modestly.

Second, capability recovery. On the LLM side, the paper claims that SpB2.0 reaches more than 95% of Qwen3-4B performance on a broad benchmark average and consistently outperforms Qwen2.5-3B. After SFT, it approaches Qwen3 and surpasses the larger SpB1.0-7B. On the multimodal side, SpB2.0-VL is reported to be competitive with Qwen2.5-VL-3B and to recover much of Qwen3-VL-4B’s overall capability. The key point here is not the absolute score, but how much capability survives the architecture swap.

Third, training cost. The LLM conversion uses about 14B continued-pretraining tokens and costs roughly 4,656 A100 GPU hours, compared in the paper against 150B CPT tokens for SpB1.0. The VLM conversion costs about 1,977 A100 GPU hours. Together, both conversions stay under 7k A100 GPU hours and can be completed in about 9 days on 32 A100s. That is operationally meaningful because it turns architecture replacement from a full retraining project into a manageable continued-training project.

That said, the evidence is still more system-oriented than scientific. Important questions remain if the full text does not answer them in detail: whether the 1:3 DSSA ratio is robust across context lengths, how much distillation matters relative to plain continued training, how the long-context curriculum affects forgetting, and whether FP8 interacts with sparse attention in training stability. Those details matter for reproducibility and for deciding whether the recipe generalizes beyond this specific conversion.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A good skim order is: conversion recipe first, architecture second, efficiency results third. Start with the introduction and the training pipeline figure to see that the main contribution is the migration recipe, not just a new sparse operator. Then read the DSSA section and focus on why MoBA and SSE are alternated at a 1:3 ratio instead of using a single sparse mechanism. After that, read the long-context extension and distillation sections, especially the stage ordering. Finally, read the inference benchmarks and separate TTFT, TPOT, and end-to-end latency, since they reflect different bottlenecks.

If you only have about 40 minutes, prioritize the model diagram, the LLM conversion pipeline, the efficiency tables, and the capability-recovery tables. If you want to judge its relevance for pretraining, look for three ablations: whether the model can recover without distillation, how sensitive the quality-efficiency trade-off is to the DSSA ratio, and how much each stage of the 14B-token continued-training budget contributes. If those are missing or thin, the paper is more useful as an engineering route for architecture migration than as a general training law.

recommendation.zh: 只看 DSSA 与 T2H 消融；若转换损失低，它会改变长上下文模型不必从零训的 prior。
recommendation.en: Skim the DSSA and T2H ablations; low conversion loss would weaken the prior that long-context hybrids must be trained from scratch.

paper.title: MCAP: Deployment-Time Layer Profiling for Memory-Constrained LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Deploying large language models to heterogeneous hardware is often constrained by memory, not compute. We introduce MCAP (Monte Carlo Activation Profiling), a load-time per-layer importance estimator that enables dynamic precision and memory placement decisions on the target device. MCAP produces a lightweight per-layer signal that drives both precision dispatch (W4A8 vs. W4A16) and residency tier (GPU, RAM, SSD), allowing a single set of weights to operate across diverse memory budgets. Our sys

summary.core_problem: 解决异构硬件和严格内存预算下的大模型推理部署问题，重点不是算力而是如何按层做精度与驻留位置分配。
summary.importance: 这是推理系统与部署优化工作，不属于预训练本身，但对理解模型层重要性、部署时的精度分配和 memory hierarchy 有一定参考价值。贡献类型主要是系统创新与工程策略，而非新的建模方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MCAP（Monte Carlo Activation Profiling），在模型加载时估计每层的重要性信号，再据此联合决定两类部署动作：一是精度派发（W4A8 或 W4A16），二是权重驻留层级（GPU、RAM、SSD）。系统 NVE 的核心思想是用单份权重在不同内存预算下动态适配，而不修改模型参数。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告在 NVIDIA T4 上，相比 llama.cpp Q4_0 可获得 1.5-1.8× 的 decode throughput，并能在此前不可行的内存区间运行模型。摘要未给出具体模型族、参数规模、序列长度、batch、prefill/decode 拆分和精度损失，因此结果更适合作为工程信号，而不是可直接迁移的通用结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets LLM inference under tight memory budgets on heterogeneous hardware, focusing on deployment-time precision and residency decisions rather than raw compute.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems paper, not a pretraining contribution, but it offers some useful signals about layer importance, precision allocation, and memory hierarchy behavior. The contribution is mainly engineering and systems design.
summary_en.technical_approach: MCAP (Monte Carlo Activation Profiling) estimates a lightweight per-layer importance signal at load time, then uses it to jointly decide precision dispatch (W4A8 vs. W4A16) and residency tier (GPU, RAM, SSD). The NVE system aims to make one set of weights adapt to different memory budgets without changing the model itself.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 1.5-1.8x higher decode throughput than llama.cpp Q4_0 on NVIDIA T4, and the ability to run models in memory regimes that were previously infeasible. However, the abstract does not specify model family, parameter scale, sequence lengths, batch settings, prefill/decode split, or quality degradation, so the result should be treated as an engineering signal rather than a broadly transferable conclusion.

recommendation.zh: 典型部署工程论文，对 pretrain 价值不大；若你关心层重要性是否足够稳定到能指导 mixed-precision，只看 profiling 信号定义和吞吐-质量权衡即可。
recommendation.en: A deployment paper with limited pretraining relevance; only check the profiling signal and the throughput-quality tradeoff if you care whether layer importance is stable enough for mixed-precision decisions.

paper.title: From Signal Degradation to Computation Collapse: Uncovering the Two Failure Modes of LLM Quantization
paper.abstract: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) is critical for the efficient deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs). While 4-bit quantization is widely regarded as an optimal trade-off, reducing the precision to 2-bit usually triggers a catastrophic ``performance cliff.'' It remains unclear whether the underlying mechanisms differ fundamentally. Consequently, we conduct a systematic mechanistic analysis, revealing two qualitatively distinct failure modes: Signal Degradation, where the computational patter

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答的不是“量化后性能掉了多少”，而是“为什么 4-bit 和 2-bit 会表现出两种看起来完全不同的失效形态”。作者聚焦 PTQ 下常见的性能断崖，尤其是 2-bit 从可用直接跌到几乎失效这一现象，试图从模型内部机制而不是数值误差表面去解释：4-bit 的退化是否只是更轻的 2-bit，还是两者已经进入不同的故障区间。论文给出的答案是后者：4-bit 主要是信号退化，2-bit 则是计算坍塌。
summary.importance: 这项工作的价值在于把量化问题从“压缩算法调参”推进到“模型内部功能是否还在工作”的层面。对基座研究员来说，最有用的地方有三点。第一，它把 4-bit 可用、2-bit 常失效这件事解释成两种不同机制，而不是同一条误差曲线上的不同点，这会直接影响后续量化算法和恢复策略设计。第二，它说明仅靠最终任务分数或平均量化误差，无法判断模型到底是‘还能算但算糙了’，还是‘关键模块已经不工作’。第三，这种分析框架对预训练和压缩接口也有启发：如果某些知识回忆路径、归一化结构或表示几何对低比特极其脆弱，那么训练阶段就可能需要更量化友好的表示、激活分布或结构约束。就量级看，这不是提出新 PTQ 算法的论文，而是给低比特量化研究补了一层机制诊断框架。
summary.technical_approach:
作者提出 Two Failure Modes Hypothesis，并围绕它搭建了一套机制分析流程。核心区分是：

1. Signal Degradation：模型的计算路径仍然存在，关键组件还能执行原来的功能，但量化误差像噪声一样沿层累积，导致信息精度下降。此时正确答案往往不是完全消失，而是 logit 排名下滑，模型还保留部分知识信号。

2. Computation Collapse：量化误差已经大到破坏关键组件的功能，信息在早层就无法被正确处理，后续层拿到的是已经失真的表示，因此正确答案的排名会从前列直接掉到极低位置，输出退化成高频停用词或近似随机猜测。

为验证这一点，论文不是只看最终精度，而是追踪层间信息流、因果路径、关键模块功能，以及表示空间结构。正文给出的分析对象包括 Llama-3.1-8B，并在 Qwen3-8B、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3、Gemma-2-9B-it 上验证泛化。主要量化基线是 GPTQ，同时在附录中检查 AWQ。任务选择 factual recall，用 Pararel 的关系模板做 next-token prediction，因为这种任务 token 位置固定，便于精确定位知识信号在哪一层、哪一类组件被破坏。

一个设计上很好的点，是作者把样本按 FP16 与 4-bit 表现划分为 Robust Subset 和 Failure Subset。这样可以把“模型本来就不会”和“量化导致不会”分开，避免机制分析被原始能力不足污染。随后他们比较 4-bit 与 2-bit 在这些子集上的内部行为差异，得出 4-bit 更像保留结构但降低分辨率，2-bit 更像结构性损坏。

论文还做了 mechanism-aware intervention。结论是：如果属于 Signal Degradation，可以用有针对性的、免训练修复策略做一定恢复；如果属于 Computation Collapse，低秩补偿之类的后处理也救不回来，因为问题不是局部误差，而是功能结构已经坏掉，需要 fine-tuning 这类结构重建。这个结论比“2-bit 更难”更具体，它指出了为什么常见补偿法在极低比特下经常失效。
summary.experiments:
实验主轴很清楚：比较 FP16、8-bit、4-bit、3-bit、2-bit 在 factual recall 上的行为差异，并把 4-bit 与 2-bit 的失效形态拆开看。主分析模型是 Llama-3.1-8B，外加 Qwen3-8B、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3、Gemma-2-9B-it 做验证。量化方法以 GPTQ 为主，AWQ 用于算法泛化检查。

最关键的结果有两个。第一，性能曲线存在明显 cliff：从 FP16 到 4-bit 是渐进下降，模型仍可用；到 2-bit 时准确率几乎掉到 0。作者明确指出这不是简单的更低精度，而是进入另一种失效状态。第二，输出分布层面，4-bit 主要表现为正确答案 rank drop，正确 token 仍常留在 top tier，例如 Top-5 附近；2-bit 则是 rank collapse，正确答案排名掉到数千名，输出常退化为“the”“.”这类高频 token，说明知识信号已在早期被破坏。

论文还验证了结论不只局限于 Pararel。附录中提到在 MMLU、GSM8K 上也观察到相似趋势。更重要的是干预实验：对 Signal Degradation，targeted、training-free repair 有效果；对 Computation Collapse，即便使用 advanced low-rank compensation 也基本无效。这组结果把‘该修补还是该重训’这个工程判断落到了可观察机制上。

如果从预训练研究者视角看，最值得注意的实验不是 benchmark 分数，而是层间信号追踪、表示空间结构分析、关键组件功能测试，以及不同 bit-width 下这些诊断量如何发生相变。它们共同支持“4-bit 和 2-bit 不是同一种坏法”的主张。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先读 Introduction 和 Two Failure Modes Hypothesis，确认作者不是在做又一个量化算法，而是在解释 failure mechanism。然后直接看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2：一个展示 performance cliff，一个展示 answer rank drop 与 rank collapse 的差别，这两张图基本定下全文主线。接着重点看层间信息流追踪、关键组件功能分析、表示空间结构分析这几部分，尤其要留意作者如何证明 2-bit 的问题发生在早层，以及哪些模块最先失效。之后再看 intervention experiments，理解为什么 training-free repair 只对 degradation 有效，而对 collapse 无效。附录里 AWQ、MMLU、GSM8K 的泛化验证也值得扫一遍，用来判断结论是不是只依赖 GPTQ 和 factual recall。泛读大约 30 分钟；如果你做量化、低比特训练或量化感知预训练，建议精读机制分析和干预部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharper question than standard PTQ evaluation: why do 4-bit and 2-bit quantization fail in qualitatively different ways? The focus is the well-known performance cliff in post-training quantization, especially the jump from usable 4-bit models to nearly broken 2-bit ones. Instead of treating this as a larger numerical error, the paper investigates whether the internal computation itself changes regime. The answer is yes: 4-bit mainly causes signal degradation, while 2-bit triggers computation collapse.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is diagnostic rather than algorithmic. It reframes low-bit quantization from a pure compression problem into a question of whether the model’s internal functional pathways still operate. That matters for foundation-model work in three ways. First, it explains the 4-bit versus 2-bit gap as two different mechanisms, not two points on the same smooth curve, which changes how one should design recovery methods. Second, it shows that end-task accuracy or average quantization error is not enough to tell whether the model is still computing correctly or has lost critical functionality. Third, it suggests a bridge back to pretraining: if factual recall pathways, normalization behavior, or representation geometry are especially fragile under extreme quantization, then training-time choices may need to become more quantization-aware. This is not a new PTQ algorithm paper; it is a mechanistic diagnosis framework for low-bit failure.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper proposes the Two Failure Modes Hypothesis and builds a mechanistic analysis pipeline around it.

1. Signal Degradation: the computational pattern remains largely intact. Key components still perform their intended role, but quantization error accumulates like noise and reduces information precision. In this regime, the correct answer is often still present in the output distribution, but with lower confidence.

2. Computation Collapse: quantization error becomes severe enough to break the functionality of critical components. Information is corrupted in early layers, so later layers operate on already damaged representations. The correct answer rank collapses, and outputs degenerate into frequent stop words or near-random guesses.

To validate this distinction, the paper goes beyond final accuracy and studies layer-wise information flow, causal pathways, component functionality, and representation-space structure. The main analysis is on Llama-3.1-8B, with validation on Qwen3-8B, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, and Gemma-2-9B-it. GPTQ is the primary PTQ baseline, with AWQ checked in the appendix. The task is factual recall using Pararel templates cast as next-token prediction, which gives fixed token positions and makes it easier to localize where knowledge signals are preserved or destroyed.

A strong design choice is the dataset partitioning. The authors split examples into a Robust Subset and a Failure Subset based on FP16 and 4-bit behavior, so they can isolate quantization-induced failures from examples the base model never knew. They then compare internal behavior across 4-bit and 2-bit on these subsets and show that 4-bit mostly preserves structure with reduced precision, while 2-bit causes structural breakdown.

The paper also includes mechanism-aware interventions. The conclusion is precise: signal degradation can be partially repaired with targeted, training-free methods, but computation collapse cannot be fixed by low-rank compensation or similar post hoc patches. Once the functional structure is broken, reconstruction through fine-tuning is required. That is a more useful statement than simply saying 2-bit is harder.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story is clean. The paper compares FP16, 8-bit, 4-bit, 3-bit, and 2-bit behavior on factual recall, then dissects the difference between 4-bit and 2-bit failure modes. The main model is Llama-3.1-8B, with Qwen3-8B, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, and Gemma-2-9B-it used for generalization. GPTQ is the main quantizer, and AWQ is used to test whether the conclusions depend on the quantization algorithm.

Two results stand out. First, there is a clear performance cliff: the move from FP16 to 4-bit causes gradual degradation and the model remains usable, while 2-bit drives accuracy essentially to zero. The paper argues this is not just lower precision, but a different failure regime. Second, at the output-distribution level, 4-bit mostly causes answer rank drop: the correct token often remains near the top, for example within the top few candidates. In contrast, 2-bit causes answer rank collapse: the correct answer falls to ranks in the thousands, and the model often emits high-frequency tokens such as “the” or “.”, indicating that the knowledge signal has already been destroyed.

The appendix reportedly shows similar trends on broader tasks such as MMLU and GSM8K, so the phenomenon is not limited to Pararel. The intervention experiments are especially useful: targeted training-free repair helps in the signal-degradation regime, but even advanced low-rank compensation fails in the computation-collapse regime. That gives a practical criterion for when patching is worth trying and when structural retraining is necessary.

For a pretraining-oriented reader, the most informative experiments are not the benchmark scores themselves, but the layer-wise signal tracing, representation-geometry analysis, and component-function tests, and how these diagnostics change sharply with bit width. Together they support the claim that 4-bit and 2-bit do not fail in the same way.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the Two Failure Modes Hypothesis section. The paper is not proposing yet another quantizer; it is explaining why quantization fails. Then go straight to Figure 1 and Figure 2. One establishes the performance cliff, and the other distinguishes answer rank drop from answer rank collapse. Those figures set up the whole argument. After that, focus on the sections analyzing layer-wise information flow, critical component functionality, and representation-space structure. Pay special attention to how the authors show that 2-bit failure happens early and which modules break first. Then read the intervention experiments to understand why training-free repair works for degradation but not for collapse. The appendix is worth skimming for AWQ, MMLU, and GSM8K to judge how dependent the conclusions are on GPTQ and factual recall. A useful skim takes about 30 minutes. If you work on quantization, low-bit training, or quantization-aware pretraining, the mechanistic analysis and intervention sections deserve a close read.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它把“2-bit 为什么死”从经验现象拆成两种可诊断故障；先看 failure taxonomy 和 repair 实验，别只盯最终量化分数。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it turns the vague “2-bit just breaks” story into two diagnosable failure modes; read the failure taxonomy and repair section, not just the final accuracy table.
